descricao: Hands-on architecture leadership for EY Fabric, EY’s global technology platform This is an architecture role for someone who combines strategic judgement with practical engineering delivery. The successful applicant will shape direction and define robust designs, while staying close to implementation through prototyping, code and design reviews, technical problem-solving and direct collaboration with engineering teams. The opportunity and EY Fabric EY Fabric is EY’s global foundational technology platform for building, running and scaling technology solutions. It brings together reusable cloud, data, intelligence, developer and business-enablement capabilities, supported by self-service workflows and built-in governance, so teams can deliver secure products faster and more consistently. In this role, you will be part of the Client Technology Architecture function and will work within a team leading key aspects of the architecture of EY Fabric, part of the wider Fabric engineering function. You will work across business, product, architecture, security, platform and engineering teams to translate outcomes into pragmatic technical direction and successful delivery. The role spans the full delivery lifecycle. You will help shape product vision and roadmaps, develop architecture options and detailed designs, support planning and investment decisions, and remain actively engaged hands-on as solutions are built, tested, operated and improved. You will be expected to move comfortably between senior stakeholder conversations and detailed technical work with engineers, doing hands-on coding and engineering where needed to progress work through to production. Key responsibilities Partner with Product Managers and other stakeholders to understand business needs, clarify requirements and translate them into pragmatic product and platform architecture. Lead aspects of the EY Fabric architecture, owning or guiding the technology and design direction for assigned platform capabilities from early concept and option analysis through delivery, adoption, operation and evolution. Ensure designs work coherently across EY Fabric, including its platform APIs, developer workflows, portal and user experience, reusable cloud capabilities, identity and access patterns, data services, observability and integration points. Produce clear architecture blueprints, designs, architectural decision records, reference patterns and implementation guidance, using your judgement as to what is required. Design secure, scalable and reusable services, APIs, integration patterns, datastores, user-facing capabilities and common platform components. Work directly with engineering teams to turn architecture into working software, including hands-on prototyping, proof-of-concept development, code review, pair design, troubleshooting and design assurance. Solve complex problems where an established solution may not exist by evaluating technologies, testing assumptions, considering build-versus-buy options and presenting evidence-based recommendations. Provide technical leadership throughout delivery, ensuring implemented solutions remain aligned with the intended architecture, quality expectations and enterprise standards. Participate in product and delivery planning, estimation and forecasting; manage architecture work and technical debt; balance cost, risk, quality, security, maintainability and time to market. Mentor engineers and architects, encourage experimentation and knowledge sharing, and contribute to architecture and engineering communities. Monitor relevant technology and industry trends, including AI-assisted engineering, and apply them responsibly where they provide measurable value. Required Skills And Experience Significant experience in solution or technical architecture within complex, large-scale product or internal developer platform environments, with a strong record of successful implementation and adoption. Demonstrable hands-on software engineering capability in at least one modern language such as C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript or Python, together with confidence reading, reviewing and improving production code. Broad architecture experience across cloud-native applications, integration, data and security, with the judgement to balance governance, technical quality and delivery pace. Practical Microsoft Azure or other cloud experience across compute, storage, networking, security and identity, including Entra ID, RBAC, Key Vault, Azure Policy and tenant-aware identity patterns. Expertise designing distributed and scalable products and platforms using APIs, microservices, containers and Kubernetes, preferably AKS, across cloud or hybrid environments. Experience with CI/CD, automated testing and DevSecOps practices. Knowledge of modern API design and API Management, including topics such as security, versioning, discoverability, etc. Understanding of secure-by-design practices, compliance expectations, in-application security and operation within enterprise technology standards. Experience designing for reusability, reliability, maintainability, observability, performance, cost optimisation and effective technical debt management. Working knowledge of architecture and design patterns, including microservices, containerised systems, event-driven architecture, data streaming and data platforms. Strong analytical, collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex decisions to senior stakeholders and work effectively across globally distributed teams. Desirable experience InnerSource, internal developer platforms, reusable engineering assets, platform marketplaces or shared-services models. AI-assisted and agentic engineering tools and workflows, with an understanding of appropriate security, quality and governance controls. Low-code or no-code capabilities, workflow automation, enterprise user-experience patterns, data management or data governance. Architecture or security certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Security Engineer, TOGAF, SAFe or comparable credentials. A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience in engineering, computer science, information technology or a related discipline. What we are looking for A self-starting, collaborative architect who enjoys solving difficult problems and taking responsibility for outcomes. You should be equally credible with senior stakeholders and engineering teams, comfortable operating across multiple initiatives, and willing to engage directly in design and implementation detail. This role suits someone who views architecture as an active delivery discipline and who can lead through both influence and practical contribution.

descricao: ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a seasoned Data Architect to own the data architecture and product delivery strategy for our retail and downstream business. Operating at the intersection of local business insight and global IT strategy, you will design scalable, well-governed data platforms that translate commercial needs into robust, business-ready data products. You will work closely with both business and IT stakeholders bridging local operational context with the global data landscape and remain accountable for the architectural quality, reliability, and business relevance of every data product you deliver. TECHNOLOGY STACK Must-have: Databricks (Lakehouse, Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables), AWS (S3, Glue, Redshift, Lake Formation), Azure (ADLS, Synapse, ADF, Purview), Apache Airflow, Apache Kafka, dbt, SQL and Python. Nice to have: Snowflake and other modern data platform and orchestration tooling WHAT YOU WILL DO Design and own end-to-end data architecture for retail and downstream data products from ingestion to consumption layer. Define data modeling standards, platform patterns, and architectural principles across the data ecosystem. Lead the design and delivery of data products, ensuring they are reusable, well-documented, and fit for business consumption. Translate local business requirements into architecture decisions aligned with the global IT strategy and data governance framework. Act as the technical bridge between business stakeholders and global IT, ensuring local context is reflected in platform design. Drive data quality, lineage, and cataloguing practices across the full data landscape. Evaluate and recommend new data technologies, architectural patterns, and tooling approaches. Mentor and guide data engineers and analysts, setting architectural guardrails and best practices. Engage with global data and IT teams to align on standards, tooling roadmap, and delivery priorities. MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS 10+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or data platform roles, with at least 5 years in a senior architecture capacity. Deep hands-on expertise with Databricks: Lakehouse design, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and data pipeline orchestration. Strong cloud platform experience across AWS and Azure storage, computing, orchestration, and governance services. Proven track record designing and delivering data products governed, business-ready data assets, not just pipelines. Solid command of data modeling techniques: dimensional modeling, Data Vault, or equivalent. Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow, designing, deploying, and maintaining complex workflow orchestration at scale. Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka event streaming architecture, topic design, producers/consumers, and real-time data pipeline patterns. Solid dbt experience data transformation layer design, testing frameworks, documentation practices, and integration with modern data stacks. Strong SQL expertise, complex query writing, performance tuning, and data modeling applied directly in analytical and operational contexts. Python proficiency for data management, scripting, pipeline development, data wrangling, and automation across the data stack. Experience working across global and local IT structures, navigating enterprise standards while addressing regional business needs. Strong stakeholder engagement skills, able to communicate architectural decisions clearly to both technical peers and business leaders. Demonstrated delivery in complex, multi-stakeholder environments with measurable, business-oriented outcomes. NICE TO HAVE Hands-on Snowflake experience: data sharing, warehousing patterns, or hybrid Snowflake/Databricks architectures. Familiarity with data mesh principles and domain-oriented data product ownership models. Knowledge of data governance frameworks and cataloguing tools (e.g., Azure Purview, Collibra, Alation). Experience in retail, trading, energy, or commodity-intensive industries. Background in BI/analytics layer delivery (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau) and the data architecture that supports it.

descricao: Who We Are At MAS Global Consulting, we are a premium digital engineering partner trusted by innovative startups and Fortune 100 companies, delivering high-impact solutions through agile delivery, deep technical expertise, and a strong people-first culture across the Americas. We build long-term partnerships, not just software. MAS means "more" in Spanish, and that mindset drives our commitment to greater opportunity, inclusion, and impact. Founded by a Latina engineer from Medellín and headquartered in Tampa, Florida, MAS Global Consulting is a 100% Hispanic and woman-owned company, recognized as a Great Place to Work and one of the Fastest-Growing Companies in the US. Who You Are You are a senior Data Architect who will own the technical design of a governed data platform on Microsoft Fabric for a US-based industrial manufacturer. The client runs on more than a dozen systems with no shared keys between them. The platform has two parts: a medallion lakehouse for analytics in Power BI, and a master data hub that keeps one golden record per key entity and syncs corrected values back to the operational systems. The first domain is Workforce: one trusted employee record across Workday HCM, payroll, Epicor ERP and the physical security system. You lead a small team, a Data Engineer and a Power BI Developer. You turn the client's data ownership into rules the platform applies, and you explain decisions in business terms to IT, business owners and leadership. The role is remote from LATAM with US time-zone overlap, client-facing through MAS Global. What You'll Do Define the Fabric architecture: environments, one lakehouse with bronze, silver and gold schemas, and the master data hub in a Fabric SQL database. Design the enterprise data model, and classify each entity as master data or domain data. Design the Employee master: golden record, cross-reference of every system ID, attribute lineage and audit. Define the matching rules (shared ID, exact and probabilistic, plus blocking), with thresholds the business can tune in configuration tables. Turn system ownership into survivorship rules per attribute. For example, Workday wins job and compensation data and Epicor wins labor rates. Design the stewardship model and the sync back to Epicor, payroll and security, through Fabric pipelines or MuleSoft. Secure sensitive employee data with Entra ID and row-level security. Set the engineering standards: Git, deployment pipelines, tests built from known match cases, and documentation. Lead the build-vs-buy evaluation for MDM. What You Bring 8+ years in data, including 3+ as architect or technical lead on Azure. Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience, or deep Synapse or Databricks on Azure plus active Fabric adoption. Designed a medallion architecture in production. MDM or entity resolution design: matching without shared keys, survivorship, stewardship. Data modeling for Power BI and for operational hubs. Integration patterns: APIs, file extracts, and write-back to source systems. Hands-on MuleSoft experience designing integrations. Governance and security for sensitive data. English C1, comfortable presenting to executives. Nice to Have Profisee, Informatica MDM or Reltio. Workday, payroll or Epicor data. Microsoft Purview. Manufacturing data. DP-600, DP-700 or AZ-305 certification.

descricao: Job Requirements BUILD SOMETHING BIGGER THAN YOURSELF The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise with the following business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, Disney Parks, and Experiences and Products. We're hiring the founding engineering team for this AI framework. One theme unifies every engineering role on D-Fi: autonomy and trust. You build the agents that act autonomously — designing how they execute finance processes end-to-end and knowing exactly when to hand off to a human instead. You'll own the agentic workflow layer: the core of D-Fi's autonomous finance capability. This means designing, building, and maintaining the multi-agent orchestration framework that enables touchless execution of real finance business processes. The Lead Machine Learning Engineer (Agentic Workflows) will be responsible for: Own the agentic workflow layer. Design, build, and maintain the multi-agent orchestration framework that enables touchless execution of finance business processes — close cycle automation, variance analysis, forecast change routing, report generation, and anomaly response. Own agent architecture decisions. Determine how agents are structured, how they hand off to each other, how they handle failure modes and exceptions, and how human-in-the-loop escalation is triggered when autonomous action isn't appropriate. Consume and enforce delegated identity in agent execution. Ensure every agent action executes under the identity and entitlements of the user (or process) it's acting on behalf of — propagating that identity context correctly through every agent-to-agent handoff, and never allowing an agent to execute an action the underlying human wouldn't be authorized to take directly. Set the prompt and context engineering standard for the team. Lead the discipline of how LLMs are instructed, constrained, and evaluated across every agent on the platform, not just your own. Partner directly with finance domain experts. Map real finance processes into agentic workflows that can run with minimal human intervention, translating process knowledge into system behavior. Design for graceful failure, not just success. Build exception handling and escalation paths so that when autonomous action isn't safe or appropriate, the system routes to a human cleanly and traceably. What we need from you to be part of this story: 7+ years of software or ML engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of complex systems end-to-end. Advanced level of English (must). Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree a plus but not required. Hands-on experience designing and shipping multi-agent or agentic LLM systems in production — not prototypes or demos. Strong judgment for failure-mode design: knowing where autonomy should stop and human review should start. Comfort setting technical standards other engineers follow, even without formal management authority. Genuine curiosity about finance processes — you don't need a finance background, but you'll need to learn how forecasting, variance analysis, and approval workflows actually work. You'll be architecting, designing and writing production code. Ai/Llm Production experience building multi-agent systems — agent-to-agent handoff, task decomposition, and orchestration patterns. Strong prompt and context engineering skills, including designing constraints and guardrails for autonomous LLM-driven actions. Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent) and major model providers/APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or equivalent). Understanding of evaluation methodology for agentic systems — task success rate, failure mode analysis, and regression testing as prompts and workflows evolve. Experience designing human-in-the-loop escalation patterns for AI systems operating with partial autonomy. Understanding of how agents should consume data from a governed semantic layer rather than querying raw sources directly. Programming Languages & Engineering Python fluency required — this is the primary language for agent and orchestration logic. Experience with event-driven or workflow orchestration systems (e.g., Temporal, Airflow, or equivalent) is a strong plus. Familiarity with testing strategies for non-deterministic systems (LLM outputs, agent decisions). Automatización y Eliminación de Toil: Codificar herramientas, scripts y soluciones de autoservicio (self-service) para eliminar tareas manuales recurrentes en el ciclo de vida del software. Experiencia en integración continua (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD) e implementación de estrategias de despliegue avanzadas (canary, blue/green, rollback automático). Bases de Datos & Caching: Conocimiento técnico sobre el comportamiento, ajuste de rendimiento y resolución de fallas en MySQL, MongoDB y Redis. Colaboración Técnica: Disposición para compartir soluciones técnicas, documentar runbooks y guiar a otros ingenieros mediante el ejemplo técnico (pair programming, revisiones de código y post-mortems). Moverte a la velocidad de tus ideas y emprender. Aprender, desarrollarte y reinventarte: Permitirte equivocarte, aprender haciendo, iterar y adaptarte a los cambios. descricao: The opportunity Security Technology Services (STS), part of Information Security, enables more than 425,000 people across 150+ countries to access systems and information securely. As the Information Security IT Cloud Service Owner, you will operate with a Product Owner mindset and be accountable for the vision, roadmap, adoption, performance and value of enterprise cloud security posture and workload protection services delivered through cloud SaaS technologies such as Wiz, Microsoft Defender for Cloud and Aqua Security. You will define customer outcomes, prioritize the backlog, align investment to enterprise risk and cloud strategy, and partner with engineering and operations teams to deliver secure, reliable and easy-to-consume capabilities across multi-cloud environments. The role connects business customers, cloud and DevOps teams, architecture, strategy, risk, compliance, internal audit and vendors to move the service from strategy through delivery and continuous improvement. Your key responsibilities Own the product vision, roadmap and end-to-end lifecycle for cloud security posture and workload protection services, including CSPM, CNAPP, CWPP, KSPM, infrastructure-as-code scanning and automated guardrails. Define customer outcomes and measurable value, linking roadmap investments to risk reduction, coverage, adoption, resilience, customer experience and cost efficiency. Maintain and prioritize the product backlog using business value, customer need, regulatory commitments, strategy, risk and delivery capacity. Translate stakeholder needs into product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, release priorities and adoption plans in partnership with strategy, engineering, and operations. Lead customer discovery, product evaluations, RFPs, proof-of-value engagements, pilots, launches and feedback loops that make services easier to consume. Act as the single point of accountability for the service, balancing demand transparently and communicating priorities, trade-offs, dependencies and delivery commitments. Define service offerings, onboarding journeys, support models, SLOs, SLAs, KPIs, operational workflows and customer-facing service communications. Monitor service health, reliability, coverage and performance; drive continual improvement, reduce technical debt and ensure incident, problem, recovery and change practices are documented and tested. Oversee onboarding, platform governance, integrations, upgrades, migrations and retirements across Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, cloud workloads, containers and serverless workloads while minimizing disruption. Own service risk, control alignment, audit readiness, exception governance and remediation of service-related findings. Develop business cases, investment asks, budgets and benefits tracking; forecast demand, licensing and capacity; and improve unit cost and platform utilization. Lead vendor performance, roadmap, support, renewal and commercial discussions, while reducing unnecessary capability duplication. Present product performance, risk, roadmap progress, investment needs and measurable outcomes to senior leaders in clear business terms. Drive adoption through clear service offerings, paved paths, documentation, enablement and customer feedback loops. Skills and attributes for success Product ownership expertise, including vision, outcome and roadmap definition, value-based backlog management and transparent prioritization. Strong customer focus, using discovery, feedback and data to improve service usability, adoption and value. Deep understanding of CSPM, CNAPP, CWPP, CIEM, KSPM, containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, vulnerability management and risk prioritization. Experience connecting requirements and releases to measurable adoption, risk, reliability, customer experience and cost outcomes. Ability to define service operating models, onboarding criteria, configuration standards, policies, service levels, KPIs, runbooks and escalation paths. Experience managing service incidents, problems, recovery, changes, risks, findings, exceptions and remediation workflows. Executive communication skills, with the ability to explain product choices, technical risk, performance and investment needs in business terms. Ability to influence without authority and align global, cross-functional teams around shared outcomes and delivery commitments. Commercial acumen across budgets, unit economics, licensing, vendor performance, renewals and return on investment. Data-driven approach to continual improvement using product, operational, financial and customer measures. Ability to assess overlapping cloud security capabilities and product interfaces to strengthen integration, interoperability and cost-effective service decisions. To qualify for the role you must have Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. Five or more years of experience in information security, cloud security, cybersecurity engineering or technology service management. Three or more years owning or managing security products, platforms or enterprise services. Demonstrated experience with CNAPP or cloud security posture platforms; experience with Wiz, Microsoft Defender for Cloud or Aqua Security is strongly preferred. Experience supporting services across Azure, AWS or Google Cloud and cloud-native technologies such as Kubernetes, containers and serverless workloads. Experience owning product or technology roadmaps and delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives in a global environment. Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical risk and product performance to non-technical executives. Ideally, you'll also have Experience as a Product Owner, Service Owner, Platform Owner or Technology Manager in a global, regulated or highly matrixed enterprise. Experience with agile product delivery, backlog management, customer discovery, release planning and adoption measurement. Budget planning, vendor management, capability rationalization and benefits-realization experience. Experience with ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, CMDB integrations, automation, SIEM platforms or executive reporting. Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, ITIL, CSPO, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, or cloud and container security credentials. What we look for Strategic and critical thinking with a structured approach to solving complex problems. Strong product judgment, customer empathy and the ability to make decisions amid ambiguity and change. Excellent communication, facilitation, negotiation and presentation skills. Good judgment, tact and decision-making ability. Experience working effectively across global, virtual and cross-cultural teams. The ability to work autonomously while building alignment and accountability across teams. What we offer You will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. Your recruiter can provide details about benefits available in your country. Continuous learning: Develop the mindset and skills to navigate what comes next. Success as defined by you: Use the tools and flexibility provided to make a meaningful impact. Transformative leadership: Build the insight, confidence and capabilities to lead change. Inclusive culture: Bring your perspective and help others contribute theirs. EY provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals and supports flexible working arrangements. Please contact your recruiter for details relevant to the role and location. If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible. Join us in building a better working world. Apply now.

Con 30 años de experiencia y un equipo multidisciplinario de más de 500 profesionales, nos impulsamos por el compromiso de hacer crecer cada proyecto y cliente con el que trabajamos. ¡Queremos que seas parte de este gran equipo! Buscamos Analistas de Service Desk para un servicio regional de soporte a usuarios en Brasil, México y Chile. El analista es el primer punto de contacto: recibe consultas por teléfono, chat (Teams) y ServiceNow, las registra, las diagnostica y las resuelve en forma remota, o las escala al grupo que corresponda. Se trabaja en un equipo de 11 analistas, con un Coordinador de Servicio dedicado y bajo buenas prácticas ITIL. Registrar incidentes y requerimientos en ServiceNow, clasificándolos y categorizándolos. Realizar el diagnóstico inicial y resolver en forma remota los casos de Nivel 1. Brindar soporte técnico y funcional a los usuarios, aplicando los procedimientos definidos. Escalar los casos que excedan el alcance, documentando las acciones realizadas y el motivo del escalamiento. Mantener actualizado el estado de los tickets, hacer seguimiento de los casos escalados y comunicar el avance al usuario. Contribuir a la base de conocimiento a partir de incidentes recurrentes. Cumplir las políticas de seguridad y los lineamientos operativos. Cuidar los indicadores del servicio: tiempo de respuesta, resolución en la primera llamada y satisfacción del usuario. Requisitos Experiencia mínima de 2 años en mesa de ayuda o soporte técnico de Nivel 1 a usuarios finales, preferentemente en entornos corporativos. Conocimientos de Windows, Microsoft 365 y Teams, gestión de accesos y credenciales, VPN y MFA. Soporte de notebooks, periféricos, impresoras y celulares. Manejo de herramientas de ticketing y de asistencia remota. Experiencia en atención telefónica y por chat, con buena comunicación y orientación al usuario. Disponibilidad para trabajar en turnos rotativos y en guardias de fines de semana y feriados. Se valorará Certificación ITIL v4 Foundation. Experiencia con ServiceNow. Experiencia en servicios regionales para varios países de Latinoamérica. Experiencia en empresas de seguros, finanzas o entornos regulados. Experiencia con softphone y centrales telefónicas de call center. Conocimientos de gestión de dispositivos móviles y Excel. Inglés y portugués a nivel básico. Ofrecemos excelentes beneficios, oportunidades de crecimiento y te acompañaremos en tu desarrollo profesional. En Ecosistemas Global consideramos que la diversidad enriquece nuestra cultura y perspectivas, por lo que fomentamos activamente un entorno inclusivo donde cada individuo, sin importar su origen, género, orientación, habilidades o creencias, no solo es bienvenido, sino también fundamental para nuestro éxito. Valoramos y respetamos todas las voces, y te invitamos a unirte a nuestro equipo, donde la inclusión es un pilar esencial de nuestros valores.

descricao: Estamos revolucionando las finanzas en América Latina 🚀 Fundada en 2017, Ualá nació con la misión de llevar los servicios financieros en América Latina al Siglo XXI. Hoy, ya somos el neobanco de más de 11 millones de usuarios y seguimos creciendo para transformar la industria en la región con soluciones fáciles y accesibles. Con presencia en Argentina, México y Colombia, seguimos expandiendo nuestro ecosistema con productos innovadores en Medios de Pago, Crédito, Inversiones y soluciones para comercios con Ualá Bis. Además, logramos la ronda de inversión más grande de la región en los últimos años y seguimos sumando talento para hacer realidad nuestra visión. Si querés ser parte de un equipo de +1100 personas que desafía lo establecido, trabaja con la mejor tecnología y siempre pone a las personas en el centro, ¡sumate a Ualá! #LoMejorEstáPorVenir En esta oportunidad, estamos en búsqueda de nuestro Technical Lead Backend para la vertical de Cripto cuyo objetivo será liderar técnicamente al equipo de desarrollo backend en Go, guiando la ejecución diaria y el diseño de servicios transaccionales dentro de la vertical y activos digitales. Tendrás El Desafío De Guiar al equipo backend en el día a día, realizando code reviews, despejando bloqueos técnicos y promoviendo buenas prácticas de ingeniería. Diseñar e implementar microservicios escalables en Go, asegurando código limpio, alta disponibilidad y concurrencia eficiente para operaciones financieras en tiempo real. Coordinar la integración del backend con exchanges, protocolos blockchain, proveedores de custodia y servicios de infraestructura cripto, y de compliance (AML, KYT). Velar por el cumplimiento de estándares de seguridad (manejo de llaves, cifrado y firmas) y asegurar una cobertura adecuada de pruebas unitarias e integrales, oncluyendo el manejo seguro del ciclo de vida de llaves (custodia, rotación y firma). Trabajar en conjunto con Product Owners y Scrum Masters para dimensionar tareas, planificar sprints y asegurar entregas técnicas en tiempo y forma. Fomentar el crecimiento técnico de los desarrolladores del equipo mediante constante feedback y acompañamiento. Qué buscamos para este rol Más de 5 años de experiencia en desarrollo backend, con al menos 2 años liderando equipos técnicos o actuando como referente/Tech Lead. Experiencia sólida construyendo y manteniendo microservicios de alto rendimiento con Go (Golang). Experiencia previa o fuerte entendimiento técnico de la industria Cripto, Fintech o Web3 (procesamiento de pagos, custodia, interacción con nodos o protocolos blockchain). Dominio avanzado de Go (Golang), manejo de concurrencia y optimización de servicios. Conocimientos de criptografía aplicada (firmas asimétricas, hashing, PKI) e integración de APIs blockchain. Arquitectura de microservicios, APIs RESTful, gRPC y mensajería orientada a eventos (Kafka, RabbitMQ u homologos). Bases de datos SQL y NoSQL, modelado y optimización de consultas.Manejo de contenedores (Docker/Kubernetes) y flujos de CI/CD. ¿Por qué trabajar en Ualá? Queremos compartir con vos... Ambiente laboral flexible, en crecimiento y con un enorme potencial de desarrollo profesional. Acceso a formación en instituciones educativas de primer nivel con descuentos en capacitaciones, cursos y carreras. Valoramos el equilibrio entre la vida profesional y personal, por eso contamos con tres semanas de vacaciones, licencias extendidas, día libre en tu cumpleaños, políticas de trabajo flexible y más. También brindamos cobertura de medicina prepaga para grupo familiar, descuento en gimnasios, cashback del 70% en tus compras con la tarjeta de Ualá con tope de reintegro, bono por referidos y otros beneficios que te acompañan dentro y fuera del trabajo. Creemos que las mejores ideas nacen de la diversidad de miradas y experiencias, por eso, creamos un espacio seguro y colaborativo, en el que todas las voces cuentan.En Ualá contamos con representantes de 11 nacionalidades, de diversos orígenes y experiencias. El 46% del equipo son mujeres, un hito en una empresa tecnológico-financiera. Si lo comparamos con América Latina, menos del 30% del personal que trabaja en empresas fintech son mujeres. Esa diversidad nos fortalece y es la única manera de desarrollar un producto inclusivo para competir con las mejores empresas de la región y el mundo.Si te motiva transformar la industria y hacer las cosas de otra manera, te estamos buscando. Porque desde el primer día construímos el equipo con una máxima: sólo el mejor equipo puede hacer el mejor producto. Por eso contratar, retener, y apostar al talento es lo más importante que hacemos.#Sumate

descricao: Description Our client is a national provider of industry-leading risk management solutions for the workers’ compensation, auto, health and disability management industries. Founded in 1987 and has been publically traded on the NASDAQ stock exchange since 1991. Our continual investment in human capital and technology enable us to deliver the most innovative and integrated solutions to our clients. We are a stable and growing company with a strong, supportive culture and plenty of career advancement opportunities. This position is for the Intake Development team. Requirements Required Qualifications Deep Technical Expertise: Extensive professional experience as a Senior Full Stack Developer or Technical Lead using C#/.NET and Angular. Database Mastery: Strong proficiency in SQL Server, including complex query writing and performance optimization. Cloud Experience: Hands-on experience architecting, deploying, and maintaining applications in Microsoft Azure. Architectural Vision: Proven ability to manage and simplify high levels of technical and business complexity. Project Management Skills: Demonstrated experience building project plans, estimating effort, and successfully driving projects from white-board design to production deployment. Forward-Looking Engineering: Up-to-date knowledge of agentic development practices, with practical experience or strong theoretical understanding of integrating AI tools into the software engineering lifecycle. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical constraints and opportunities to business stakeholders clearly. Job responsibilities About The Role We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Technical Lead to guide a squad of three developers. In this role, you will take ownership of a highly complex, mission-critical project built on a .NET, Angular, SQL Server, and Azure technology stack. You will act as the bridge between business strategy and technical execution—partnering directly with business stakeholders to understand complex problems and translating them into elegant, scalable technical solutions. This is a strictly hands-on position. You are expected to be deeply involved in the codebase, leading by example through active coding, architectural design, and code reviews. You will own the entire project lifecycle: from conceptual design and project planning to execution, deployment, and monitoring the system’s success in a production environment. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership & Hands-On Development: Actively write clean, scalable, and maintainable code across the entire stack (.NET, Angular, SQL Server). Lead, mentor, and perform code reviews for a team of 3 developers. Complexity Management: Architect and navigate highly complex system requirements, breaking down intricate business logic into manageable, robust technical designs. Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with non-technical business stakeholders to identify pain points, uncover opportunities, and define clear project requirements and deliverables. End-to-End Project Execution: Build comprehensive project plans, establish timelines, and drive the execution of the development lifecycle. Production Ownership: Deploy solutions to Azure, monitor system health, troubleshoot production issues, and ensure the long-term success and performance of the application. What we offer Exciting Projects: Come take your place at the forefront of digital transformation! With clients across all industries and sectors, we offer an opportunity to work on market-defining products using the latest technologies. Collaborative Environment: Expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities! Work-Life Balance: GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules.We offer you the best quality of work life so that you exceed the expectations of our clients, while achieving your professional and personal ambitions. Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes English classes, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings. We also offer the chance to travel internationally Excellent Benefits: We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, extended paternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses. About GlobalLogic GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

descricao: Como Software Technical Leader - Classic Mesh / Traffic Gateways en Mercado Libre, diseñarás y escalarás sistemas innovadores y seguros que resuelven problemas reales y de alto impacto. Trabajarás en un entorno dinámico con tecnología de vanguardia, aplicando buenas prácticas de ingeniería, modelos de IA propios y aprendizaje continuo, con el propósito de democratizar el comercio electrónico y los servicios financieros en América Latina. Imagináte emprendiendo proyectos desafiantes, dinámicos e innovadores y siendo responsable de : • Liderar técnicamente la evolución de Classic Mesh hacia Traffic Gateways, definiendo la arquitectura, la hoja de ruta y los estándares para adoptar de forma gradual la operación e implementación de Gateways de Istio en entornos legados y segmentos. • Conducir la reducción de deuda técnica de fury-controlplane y sus componentes asociados mediante actualizaciones de Envoy y dependencias, modernización de infraestructura como código, soporte multi-arquitectura y simplificación de componentes obsoletos. • Asegurar la confiabilidad del plano de control xDS y de los proxies Envoy que sostienen el enrutamiento de producción, velando por la capacidad, resiliencia multi-región y multi-nube, estrategias de despliegue, observabilidad, pruebas de carga y respuesta a incidentes. • Liderar la evolución del ciclo de lanzamiento del proxy desde el código y los filtros de Envoy, pasando por la compilación y empaquetado multi-arquitectura, hasta el despliegue gradual en la plataforma Fury. • Definir y ejecutar, junto con el equipo de Istio, el plan de transferencia de Gateways, abarcando la colaboración en repositorios compartidos, la operación en modo sombra, el traspaso de backlog y la estabilización de los primeros gateways priorizados. • Guiar técnicamente al equipo elevando estándares de diseño, calidad y revisión de código, acompañando el desarrollo técnico de las personas y conduciendo análisis posteriores a incidentes y mejoras sistémicas junto con ingeniería de confiabilidad. • Actuar como referente técnico para los equipos consumidores de la capa de tráfico, traduciendo necesidades de enrutamiento, seguridad y confiabilidad en soluciones de plataforma simples, seguras y operables. ¿Qué buscamos en vos? • Demostrar experiencia sólida en desarrollo de software y diseño de sistemas distribuidos de alta disponibilidad en plataformas de infraestructura o tráfico. • Dominar lenguajes de programación como Java o Go, junto con experiencia en proxies Envoy, gRPC y patrones de plano de control y plano de datos. • Acreditar experiencia operando o construyendo infraestructura en la nube automatizada sobre Kubernetes, AWS o GCP, aplicando integración y despliegue continuos e infraestructura como código. • Poseer conocimientos sólidos de redes y enrutamiento, incluyendo protocolos HTTP y HTTPS, balanceo de carga, malla de servicios, gateways, seguridad TLS y políticas de tráfico. Contar con experiencia en la aplicación de prácticas de ingeniería de confiabilidad de sitios, abarcando observabilidad, monitoreo, planificación de capacidad, respuesta a incidentes y estrategias de despliegue seguro. • Valorar especialmente la capacidad comprobada de liderazgo técnico para la definición de estándares, diseño de arquitectura, revisión de código y toma de decisiones con impacto transversal, así como conocimientos en Istio, Nginx, C++, Bazel e imágenes distroless. ¿Te animás a dejar huella en la tecnología de América Latina? ¡Postulate y sumate a nuestro propósito! Modalidad de trabajo híbrida. Site Buenos Aires, Argentina.

descricao: Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care. At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives. Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens. Position Summary We are seeking a Director, Platform Engineering & DevOps to lead the development and maturation of our enterprise Platform Engineering organization. This leader will be responsible for building a modern, automation-first platform primarily focused on Microsoft Azure, while supporting remaining legacy workloads in AWS and on-premises data centers during the company's migration to Azure. The Director will lead the Platform Engineering team and partner closely with Network Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Security, and application Engineering to deliver secure, reliable, scalable, and highly automated infrastructure platforms. A key objective of this role is to move the organization toward a self-service Platform Engineering model, enabling application teams to deploy and manage infrastructure using standardized patterns, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and cloud governance. Role And Responsibilities Build, lead, and develop the Platform Engineering organization, including engineering strategy, roadmap, standards, and operating model. Lead the design and evolution of the company's enterprise Microsoft Azure platform, including landing zones, governance, identity, networking, security, observability, and resiliency. Support the migration of applications and infrastructure from AWS and on-premises environments to Azure. Establish Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation as the standard approach for provisioning and managing infrastructure. Develop reusable Terraform modules, CI/CD pipelines, reference architectures, and standardized deployment patterns. Build self-service platform capabilities and "golden paths" that improve developer productivity and reduce manual infrastructure provisioning. Partner with Network Engineering on hybrid cloud connectivity, cloud networking, Private Link, DNS, routing, firewalls, and application delivery. Partner with SRE to establish platform availability objectives, observability standards, resiliency practices, incident improvements, and operational readiness, leveraging Datadog Application Partner with SRE and Application Engineering to establish consistent standards for application and platform telemetry, including metrics, logs, distributed traces, dashboards, alerting, and service-level monitoring. Ensure cloud and platform services are appropriately instrumented and integrated with the enterprise observability platform. Partner with Security to implement secure-by-default platform patterns, cloud governance, policy enforcement, and compliance controls. Establish cloud cost-management and FinOps practices across Azure and remaining AWS environments. Recruit, mentor, and develop engineering leaders and senior technical talent. Provide executive-level communication regarding platform strategy, technology risks, investments, reliability, and cloud transformation progress. Required Qualifications 10+ years of progressive experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, Platform Engineering, systems engineering, or related disciplines, including significant engineering leadership experience. Deep technical knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including enterprise cloud architecture, networking, security, governance, resiliency, and platform services. Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation, particularly Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and Git-based engineering workflows. Demonstrated experience leading complex cloud transformation initiatives, including hybrid environments, enterprise cloud migrations, or modernization of mission-critical infrastructure. Preferred Qualifications Experience building or leading an enterprise Platform Engineering organization or Internal Developer Platform. Working knowledge of AWS and experience supporting or migrating AWS workloads. Experience with Azure Landing Zones, Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework, Azure Well-Architected Framework, and Azure Verified Modules. Experience with Kubernetes and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Experience with GitHub Enterprise, GitLab, GitHub Actions or comparable DevOps platforms. Experience with enterprise observability and APM platforms, preferably Datadog, and technologies such as OpenTelemetry. Experience implementing SRE practices including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, resiliency engineering, and incident management. Experience implementing cloud FinOps and cost optimization practices. Experience operating technology platforms in healthcare, SaaS, financial services, or another regulated environment. Success Metrics for the Role Success will be measured by the Director's ability to build a scalable Platform Engineering organization and improve the speed, reliability, security, and efficiency of infrastructure delivery. Increased percentage of infrastructure deployed and managed through Infrastructure as Code. Increased adoption of standardized Azure landing zones, reusable platform services, and self-service capabilities. Reduced infrastructure provisioning and application deployment lead times. Progress migrating targeted AWS and on-premises workloads to Azure. Improved platform availability and achievement of defined SLOs. Increased adoption and effectiveness of standardized observability and APM practices across platform and application services, including improved service visibility and reduced mean time to detect and restore. Reduction in infrastructure-related incidents, configuration drift, and manual production changes. Improved developer satisfaction and adoption of Platform Engineering services. Improved cloud governance, security compliance, and cost efficiency. Successful recruitment, development, and retention of a high-performing Platform Engineering team. Join a multi-faceted community that celebrates each colleague’s unique perspective and is focused on continually improving, each and every day. In our innovative and inclusive workplace, we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. Teladoc Health respects your privacy and is committed to maintaining the confidentiality and security of your personal information. In furtherance of your employment relationship with Teladoc Health, we collect personal information responsibly and in accordance with applicable data privacy laws, including but not limited to, the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). descricao: This is an opportunity to run the worldwide Telco Field Engineering business, helping customers understand and implement Canonical's open source solutions in public clouds and in their own data centers. We work across the entire spectrum of cloud offerings, from Ubuntu itself to virtualisation and private cloud, Kubernetes, and the implementation of sophisticated open source solutions such as MLops platforms, data platforms and more. The Telco department is composed of three regional teams (APAC, EMEA and AMER). We believe that Engineering Directors should be outstanding engineers themselves. They should feel completely at home troubleshooting technical issues and having technical presales conversations with customers. They should contribute to project delivery themselves, but know that the technical contributions they bring are far less significant than their ability to shape the whole team’s direction, focus and delivery. We grow management skills and train engineers, who are interested in soft skills, to be managers. We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering managers help teams achieve more than they realised they could, and feel proud of the result. The role of a Telco Field Engineering Director at Canonical The Field Engineering department is our team of cloud solutions architects at Canonical, working directly with our customers, designing private and public cloud solutions fitting their workload needs. The portfolio of products includes on-premise cloud solutions such as Openstack, MicroCloud and Ceph, and solutions that could be deployed either on-premises or in public clouds such as Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Spark, PostgreSQL, etc. The team works hands-on with the technologies by deploying, testing and handing over the solution to our support or managed services team at the end of a project. Managers and team members also take part in presales conversations to provide technical advice during the sales process. Within the Field Engineering department, there are multiple focused teams : the Cloud/DC team, the Alliances/Partners team, the IoT team, and the Telco team. The telco industry is moving to software-defined services. This transformation is driven by open source software, cloud computing and the move to VNF / CNF approaches. Canonical Ubuntu is a key platform for telco innovation, and we are growing our team of specialists who work in the industry to accelerate the change. Canonical enables operators and communications service providers to embrace this new world, with a focus on platforms such as Ubuntu, OpenStack, and Kubernetes, and reusable, high quality automation for operations at scale. A Cloud Field Engineering Director is responsible for driving the strategy in presales and delivery for our telco customers. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role. You are also expected to actively participate in technical presales to help our department achieve our quarterly goals. Location: This role will be home based, managing teams in worldwide. titulo: Analista de Planejamento de Facilities II
descricao: Sobre a área: Governança de Facilities. Principais atividades: Atuar na governança financeira das despesas de Facilities, assegurando a integridade das informações, a correta apropriação contábil dos custos, o cumprimento dos ciclos de fechamento e a qualidade das análises gerenciais. Será responsável por acompanhar o realizado, o orçamento e o forecast, identificar e tratar desvios financeiros, apoiar os processos de provisão e reclassificação contábil, elaboração relatórios. Realizar a gestão das contas contábeis e financeiras de Facilities, garantindo a correta apropriação das despesas nos respectivos centros de custo, contas contábeis e períodos de competência. Acompanhar as despesas realizadas em comparação ao orçamento e ao forecast, identificando variações, tendências, riscos e oportunidades financeiras. Investigar as causas dos desvios identificados, interagindo com as áreas responsáveis para obter justificativas, evidências e planos de regularização. Elaborar análises financeiras e justificativas das principais variações entre realizado, orçamento e forecast. Solicitar e acompanhar reclassificações contábeis e provisões, para assegurar a consistência do resultado financeiro. Validar durante o fechamento, se as provisões, reclassificações e demais ajustes solicitados foram contabilizados corretamente. Apoiar a elaboração e a atualização periódica do forecast, considerando o comportamento das despesas, os compromissos assumidos, os contratos vigentes, as sazonalidades e os riscos identificados. Elaborar relatórios gerenciais, apresentações e materiais para suporte à tomada de decisão. Consolidar informações financeiras de diferentes bases, assegurando padronização, rastreabilidade e consistência dos dados. Atuar nas demandas analíticas e operacionais relacionadas ao pacote de Facilities, incluindo fechamento, forecast, atualização de controles e preparação de reportes gerenciais. Monitorar pendências financeiras e contábeis, acompanhando a regularização dos itens até sua conclusão. Manter os controles, procedimentos, bases e documentos da área organizados e atualizados, garantindo rastreabilidade para consultas, auditorias e processos de prestação de contas. Interagir com Facilities, Contabilidade, Controladoria, Finanças, Compras, Contas a Pagar e demais áreas envolvidas nos processos sob sua responsabilidade. Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e automação dos controles e relatórios, reduzindo atividades manuais, riscos de erro e tempo de processamento. Participar de iniciativas de padronização de processos, fortalecimento dos controles internos e melhoria contínua da governança de Facilities. Requisitos: Ensino superior completo ou em fase final de conclusão, preferencialmente em, Administração Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia de Produção, Gestão Financeira; Experiência anterior em finanças, controladoria, planejamento financeiro, contabilidade. Vivência com processos de fechamento mensal. Experiência na análise de realizado versus orçamento e forecast. Conhecimento de provisões, reclassificações. Experiência na elaboração de relatórios e análises gerenciais. Microsoft Excel em nível intermediário ou avançado. Domínio de tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas de busca, funções condicionais, tratamento de bases. Conceitos de orçamento, forecast, competência contábil, provisão e classificação de despesas. Capacidade de analisar grandes volumes de informações e identificar inconsistências. Indicadores financeiros e elaboração de relatórios gerenciais. Capacidade para elaboração de apresentações no Microsoft PowerPoint. Conhecimentos desejáveis: SAP ou outro sistema integrado de gestão empresarial, ERP. Power Query para preparação, consolidação e automatização de bases. Ferramentas de gestão de Facilities. Vivência em ambientes com múltiplas unidades, centros de custo e fornecedores. descricao: A FinDrive nasce como uma spinoff da Triven, uma empresa que, há mais de uma década, impulsiona o setor financeiro e humano, apoiando o ecossistema de inovação no desenvolvimento de um futuro mais eficiente e sustentável. Ao longo dos anos, atendemos mais de 200 startups e identificamos um desafio recorrente: a dificuldade de integrar sistemas, acessar informações financeiras rapidamente e tomar decisões com base em dados atualizados (data driven). Essas barreiras limitam o crescimento das empresas, tornando essencial a criação de soluções que simplifiquem a gestão e promovam eficiência. Foi a partir dessa necessidade que surgiu a FinDrive, uma startup independente com um propósito claro: democratizar e simplificar a gestão financeira por meio da tecnologia com foco em empresas PMEs. Nossa solução foi projetada para conectar o que já existe, reduzindo a complexidade operacional e permitindo que as empresas escalem com inteligência. Na prática, somos o “time financeiro completo” de várias empresas ao mesmo tempo: cuidamos de contas a pagar, contas a receber, faturamento, cobrança, conciliação bancária, fluxo de caixa e relatórios , usando uma plataforma própria que automatiza boa parte do trabalho. Nosso objetivo é simples (e bem desafiador): tirar o dono da empresa do caos financeiro e garantir que ele tenha clareza diária dos números , com processos bem definidos, pessoas especialistas e tecnologia trabalhando juntas. Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para compor esse time de especialistas. Sua missão será executar as rotinas de ponta a ponta (contas a pagar/receber e fluxo de caixa) , assegurando que os processos administrativos funcionem com precisão e agilidade. Como Analista, seu desafio será garantir a integridade e o fluxo contínuo da operação financeira de cada cliente sob sua responsabilidade. O que você irá fazer? Realizar o controle e acompanhamento de contas a pagar, contas a receber e do fluxo de caixa; Dar suporte na elaboração de relatórios financeiros gerenciais (DRE, fluxo de caixa, indicadores e projeções); Apoiar na elaboração e acompanhamento do orçamento (budget) e forecast; Conciliar contas bancárias e analisar variações financeiras; Acompanhar inadimplência e apoiar estratégias de cobrança; Realizar análises de custos, despesas e rentabilidade; Apoiar processos de fechamento financeiro mensal; Interface com contabilidade, fiscal e áreas internas da empresa; Garantir a organização e confiabilidade das informações financeiras; Sugerir melhorias nos processos financeiros e controles internos; Contribuir com a evolução do produto FinDrive, trazendo feedbacks da operação real dos clientes para o time de produto/tecnologia. descricao: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data and Integration Architect (Arquiteto de Dados e Integração) based in Brazil. In this remote role, you will design and implement scalable data architectures, integration frameworks, and automated pipelines that support modern data-driven solutions. You will work with technologies such as Google BigQuery, Cloud Storage, dbt, and Prefect to build reliable data ingestion and transformation processes. Your responsibilities will also include establishing DevOps and DevSecOps practices, strengthening data governance, and ensuring security across the data ecosystem. You will help integrate artificial intelligence and machine learning capabilities into the platform while resolving complex technical challenges and improving performance. Collaborating with product owners and multidisciplinary teams, you will contribute to agile planning, technical decision-making, and continuous delivery. This opportunity is ideal for a technically strong professional who enjoys architectural challenges, knowledge sharing, and developing innovative, secure, and efficient data solutions. Design, develop, maintain, and optimize data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Google BigQuery, Google Cloud Storage, dbt, and Prefect. Establish and promote DevOps and DevSecOps practices, including continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD), source control, code reviews, and secure secrets management. Implement data governance and security controls using technologies and practices such as Identity and Access Management (IAM), Policy Tags, Dataplex, and metadata management. Ensure data quality, consistency, security, and traceability throughout the data lifecycle. Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues, pipeline failures, performance bottlenecks, and technical debt, implementing sustainable improvements. Collaborate with product owners and development teams to plan sprints, prioritize deliverables, manage dependencies, and align technical execution with business objectives. Prototype, evaluate, and integrate artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions into the data platform to expand its capabilities and improve operational efficiency. Provide technical mentorship to less experienced professionals, sharing architectural knowledge, coding standards, and engineering best practices. Promote continuous improvement across data architecture, integration processes, automation, governance, and platform reliability. Postgraduate qualification or certifications: A postgraduate degree is required; alternatively, candidates must hold six valid certifications. ITIL qualification: ITIL Foundation certification or documented training in ITIL Foundation version 3 or higher. Professional experience: Demonstrable professional experience in data architecture, data engineering, data integration, or a closely related area. Advanced SQL: Strong command of SQL, including query optimization, performance tuning, and efficient data processing. Python: Practical experience developing scripts and data processing solutions using Python. Google BigQuery: Experience designing, implementing, and optimizing data solutions using Google BigQuery. dbt: Hands-on experience with dbt for data transformation, modeling, and managing data workflows. Version control and CI/CD: Experience with Git or GitHub and the implementation or maintenance of CI/CD pipelines. Data modeling: Solid knowledge of data modeling principles and the ability to design reliable, scalable data structures. Data architecture and integration: Ability to establish architectural standards, develop integration strategies, and maintain data pipelines across new and legacy environments. Security and governance: Understanding of DevOps and DevSecOps practices, access controls, metadata management, secrets management, and data governance principles. Problem-solving: Strong analytical skills and the ability to investigate technical failures, resolve performance issues, and reduce technical debt. Collaboration and leadership: Effective communication, teamwork, and technical mentoring skills, with the ability to collaborate with product owners and multidisciplinary teams in an agile environment. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. About BCG Platinion BCG Platinion's presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. We achieve digital excellence for clients with sustained solutions to the most complex and time-sensitive challenge. We guide clients into the future to push the status quo, overcome tech limitations, and enable our clients to go further in their digital journeys than what has ever been possible in the past. At BCG Platinion, we deliver business value through the innovative use of technology at a rapid pace. We roll up our sleeves to transform business, revolutionize approaches, satisfy customers, and change the game through Architecture, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Application and Risk functions. We balance vision with a pragmatic path to change transforming strategies into leading-edge tech platforms, at scale. Practice Area BCG Platinion launched in Germany in 2000 to add deep technical expertise to the Boston Consulting Group’s existing capabilities. Today, our presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. Our New York-based North American team began in 2014 and in 2017 acquired MAYA Design, a Pittsburgh-based digital design and innovation lab, to grow our capabilities around technology and design. We support our clients’ total digital transformation through technology, design, cybersecurity, and risk management & financial engineering capabilities. And together with BCG, BCG Platinion’s interdisciplinary team of technical experts enable customized technical solutions and accelerate delivery value through new business platforms, application consolidations, and major system implementations. What You'll Do As a BCG Platinion Lead AI Tech Architect, you will help clients turn the potential of AI into scalable, production-ready technology solutions. You will work closely with client technology leaders and BCG teams to understand complex business and technology challenges, define AI and technology strategies, and design architectures that enable meaningful change. You will provide technical direction and architecture leadership across complex AI initiatives, with particular focus on agentic processes and agentic product development lifecycles (PDLC). Drawing on deep architecture expertise and a strong understanding of hands-on implementation, you will guide teams through critical technology decisions and, when needed, provide hands-on support to validate approaches, solve complex technical challenges, or accelerate delivery. Lead the architecture of production-grade AI and agentic solutions, from initial design through implementation. Design agentic architectures incorporating orchestration, tool use, context and memory, guardrails, observability, and human oversight. Advise clients on architecture choices, technology trade-offs, integration patterns, scalability, security, resilience, and operational requirements. Lead complex technology architecture workstreams, translating business needs into clear architecture decisions, roadmaps, and implementation approaches. Guide initiatives involving agentic processes and agentic PDLC, drawing on experience leading comparable technology programs. Evaluate emerging AI technologies, platforms, frameworks, and architectural patterns and determine their suitability for specific client contexts. Provide technical direction to multidisciplinary teams while contributing with hands-on expertise when needed to validate designs or resolve complex challenges. Partner with client technology leaders and BCG colleagues to communicate architecture recommendations, build alignment, and support successful implementation. What You'll Bring 10+ years of experience in technology architecture, software engineering, digital delivery, or technology consulting. Proven experience leading and/or designing complex architecture projects involving agentic processes and/or agentic product development lifecycles (PDLC). Deep technical expertise across cloud architecture, distributed systems and microservices, APIs and integration, and modern software engineering – including platform engineering concepts. Hands-on experience with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel) and multi-agent design patterns, including tool use, RAG, and context/memory management. Experience designing guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and human-in-the-loop oversight for agentic systems, along with familiarity with LLM observability and tracing tools (e.g., LangSmith, Arize, Langfuse). Strong knowledge of production architecture considerations, including security, resilience, observability, scalability, and architecture governance. Expertise with major cloud AI/ML platforms (AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry/OpenAI Service, Google Vertex AI), containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure-as-code. Hands-on technical foundations – including proficiency in at least one modern programming language (Python, Java, TypeScript/Node.js etc.) – that enable you to challenge designs, guide engineering teams, and contribute directly when needed. descricao: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job: We are seeking a highly skilled DevOps Specialist to architect, implement, and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, with a strong focus on test-driven deployment, automated release management, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices. The ideal candidate will containerize services using Docker, manage build, compilation, and publishing workflows for JavaScript, TypeScript, and C++ packages, and design robust multi-language build pipelines leveraging CMake or similar build tools. The role also includes automating build, tagging, and publication processes across web, desktop, and mobile platforms to ensure consistent and traceable releases. Deep expertise in Linux system administration, networking, and IaC tools is essential to deliver scalable, secure, and highly available deployments. Responsibilities Lead the design, architecture, and management of CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions (and similar tools), ensuring fast, reliable, and reproducible software delivery. Implement and enforce test-driven deployment systems, integrating automated testing, validation, and monitoring to maintain code quality and accelerate feedback cycles. Containerize applications and microservices with Docker, optimize image builds, and manage deployment pipelines for distributed environments. Oversee the build, packaging, and publishing lifecycle for JavaScript, TypeScript, and C++ packages, including versioning, semantic tagging, and NPM or internal registry publication. Develop and maintain cross-platform build pipelines using CMake or equivalent tools, ensuring consistent compilation and release workflows across web, desktop, and mobile. Automate end-to-end release processes, including tagging, building, signing, and distributing mobile, web, and desktop applications. Define and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to provision and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure environments. Collaborate closely with development, QA, and operations teams to troubleshoot deployment issues, optimize performance, and improve release reliability. Continuously improve observability and feedback loops, leveraging monitoring and alerting systems to maintain operational excellence. Mandatory: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. 3+ years of hands-on experience architecting and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent tools at scale in a production environment. Strong proficiency in test-driven deployment methodologies, including writing and maintaining automated test suites for integration and end-to-end validation. Expertise in containerization technologies such as Docker, including image creation, registry management, and basic orchestration patterns. Experience managing package lifecycles for JavaScript and TypeScript, including versioning, compilation, semantic tagging, and publishing workflows to NPM. In-depth knowledge of C++ build systems, specifically CMake, with proven experience optimizing native build and deployment pipelines. Advanced Linux system administration and networking skills, including shell scripting, package management, performance troubleshooting, firewalls, and VPN configuration. Excellent communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in globally distributed teams. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, AWS CDK or AWS CloudFormation. Experience with mobile CI/CD automation, including build, tagging, and publication for iOS and Android applications Advanced knowledge of release management practices, including automated versioning, signing, and artifact distribution. Preferred: Exposure to observability and monitoring systems, leveraging tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK for deployment health tracking. Experience working in high-availability, security-sensitive environments, especially in fintech, blockchain, or distributed systems contexts. Experience deploying and managing blockchain-based applications. Exposure to AI/ML pipelines, including automated model training, evaluation, and deployment using frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Join our Future Talent network and you'll be one of the first people we reach when the right opening appears. We make around 160 hires a year, so it happens often. The role As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer , I help modernize and scale production platforms, most recently a customer-data caching platform that serves 20–25+ consuming applications at about 3,000 requests per second. I work across SRE, DevOps, engineering and architecture to improve resiliency, automation, observability, deployment practices and overall platform reliability. I work independently, set technical direction and do well in small engineering teams. Your Day-to-day Design, build and operate highly available, fault-tolerant distributed systems and caching platforms. Evaluate the existing architecture and identify opportunities to scale the platform toward 6x current traffic while maintaining performance and resiliency. Improve caching strategies, including TTLs, refresh patterns, cache placement, performance and downstream dependency management. Help evolve the platform toward active-active resiliency and validate failure, recovery and capacity scenarios. Design and implement automated CI/CD pipelines, including rolling, blue/green or canary deployment strategies, automated checks and quality gates. Establish infrastructure, configuration, secrets and application deployment practices using an everything-as-code approach. Build performance and load-testing capabilities and establish meaningful performance gates for releases. Develop monitoring, alerting and observability for cache latency, throughput, availability, errors and other key reliability indicators.
