descricao: Descrição Procuramos uma liderança técnica altamente qualificada e inovadora para capitanear o desenvolvimento do zero (greenfield) da nossa nova Plataforma de Renda Fixa. O principal diferencial deste desafio é que todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento será construído e otimizado sobre uma esteira focada em Inteligência Artificial, utilizando ferramentas avançadas de GenAI (como Google Gemini e Anthropic Claude).Você será responsável por unir a solidez da arquitetura de sistemas financeiros em Java com a eficiência sem precedentes proporcionada pela engenharia impulsionada por IA. Responsabilidades e atribuições Definição da Arquitetura e Visão Técnica: Projetar arquiteturas escaláveis, resilientes e seguras com foco em integração de APIs, transformação de dados e automação end-to-end de processos financeiros. Traduzir requisitos em design e implementação, otimizar a modularidade, escalabilidade, desempenho e segurança do software. Garantia de Padrões, Qualidade e Documentação: Estabelecer diretrizes claras de Clean Code, arquitetura de software, cobertura de testes e documentação técnica viva. Liderança de Code Review: Atuar como guardião da qualidade do código produzido tanto por desenvolvedores quanto por modelos de IA, assegurando confiabilidade técnica e conformidade. Mentoria e Desenvolvimento do Time: Elevar o nível técnico da equipe, capacitando os engenheiros no uso eficiente de ferramentas de IA para desenvolvimento e promovendo um ambiente de aprendizado contínuo. Resolução de Problemas Complexos: Diagnosticar e solucionar gargalos de integração complexos entre fornecedores externos de mercado financeiro, sistemas legados e times internos. Estimativa e Viabilidade Técnica: Apoiar o time de Produto e Negócios na mensuração de esforço, análise de viabilidade e priorização das entregas. Intermediação Técnica: Atuar como ponte técnica facilitadora entre o time de desenvolvimento da Renda Fixa, arquitetura corporativa, segurança da informação e demais equipes técnicas do Bullla. Arquitetar e codificar componentes críticos do sistema em Java, garantindo alta performance e tolerância a falhas. Orquestrar e otimizar a esteira de desenvolvimento assistida por IA (prompts de código, validação de outputs, automação de testes). Definir especificações de integração de APIs e barramentos de comunicação com parceiros e provedores de dados de Renda Fixa. Liderar rituais técnicos, como sessões de Architecture Review, refinamentos técnicos e alinhamentos de padrão de código. Assegurar a conformidade com boas práticas de segurança cibernética e requisitos regulatórios do setor financeiro. Participar juntamente com PO/PM da etapa de descoberta, contribuindo para análise macro de esforço técnico. Requisitos e qualificações Linguagem & Ecossistema: Domínio avançado de Java (versões recentes, preferencialmente 11 ou superior) e ecossistema Spring (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Security AI-Driven Development: Conhecimento de ferramentas e LLMs aplicadas ao desenvolvimento de código (Gemini, Claude, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise), sabendo criar rotinas eficientes de prompt engineering para geração de código, testes e documentação. Arquitetura & Design: Sólida experiência em Arquitetura de Microserviços, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Event-Driven Architecture (EDA), REST APIs e Padrões de Projeto (Design Patterns). The developer is expected to have solid working knowledge and experience in Adobe EDS web development or Adobe Experience Manager AEM and in a relevant technology or/and in a business solution/process, combined with good knowledge about AGILE methodology. Design efficient solutions leveraging the standard technologies and techniques of the platform, meeting required non-functional requirements, complying with Volvo architecture guidelines, minimizing specific in-house developments, and ensuring capacity to upgrade the solution. Ensure applicable IT security directives are followed. Develop and test features according to the requirements, using appointed tools and technologies, keeping in mind quality, cost, and timeline. Provide expertise in one or several areas around systems integration, platform architecture, development languages and techniques, tools, including user experience tools. Coordinate and cooperate with multiple stakeholders including front-end and back-end developers; quality engineers; business analysts; architects; solution engineers, consultants, and leaders; marketing teams; content editors; and delivery managers. Design, develop, collaborate, implement the development tasks/activities on a daily and regular basis to create an efficient work delivery Actively participate during requirement collection and system analysis phase along with Agile team members Follow all coding/testing guidelines and best practices. Build, release, and deploy on test, dev, and prod environments. Branching and merging to version control systems using GIT. Support implementations/Rollouts of new features/issue fixes/enhancements in non-prod/Prod environments. As Software Engineer, you are a Team Leader who is self-driven with a problem-solving mindset. Since you are part of a global unit, with global responsibilities, you will need to actively cooperate and communicate with various stakeholders and navigate with ease in a multi-cultural environment. Required Competencies Relevant university degree (Bachelor's and/or Master's degree) Excellent communication, teamwork, and responsibility. Takes initiative in solving problems and making recommendations for efficiencies and improvements Fluent proficiency in English (to communicate with global team) Strong development experience in Adobe EDS or AEM, JavaScript, CSS, SCSS, HTML, JQuery, nodeJS, React, REST APIs, Adobe CJA, OpenSearch, etc; Solid performance working as a Tech Lead & Frontend Developer and continuous improvement is in your mindset; Collaborative work, self-driven studying, analytical and a problem-solver Preferred Competencies Development experience with Adobe, including Adobe AEM, Adobe EDS, Adobe Asset, Adobe CJA and/or Dynamic Media. Experience with Microsoft Azure DevOps, Azure CEP, and Microsoft Sharepoint. Financial Security Profit Sharing Program (PLR); Private pension plan – Vikingprev; Life insurance. Convenience And Quality Of Life Volvo Association Club; Access to a wellness app with partner gyms and fitness studios. * Benefits are granted in accordance with legal eligibility requirements and internal company policies. This selection process will be conducted with the support of Manu Mourão Consulting At Volvo do Brasil, we value the candidate experience and collaborate with approved partners to ensure a professional selection process aligned with our values. We reaffirm our commitment to protecting the personal data of all participants, in full compliance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD). Our goal is to provide a safe and respectful experience at every stage of the process. We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. Who We Are And What We Believe In We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities. Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group . Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. Volvo Group Digital Technology & Operations (DTO) is a new division established to integrate the capabilities of VG Digital & IT and VG Connected Solutions to accelerate the digital transformation in Volvo Group. The organizational set up is structured around domains, digital products with functions for digital excellence to deliver outstanding customer experience. Joining the new DTO division means being part of a fast-moving digital product-oriented organization where teams truly own what they build from idea to delivery. In DTO, we work in agile, cross-functional teams, mastering the latest technology, and creating outstanding digital experiences that make a real difference for our colleagues and Volvo Group customers around the world. titulo: Especialista em Engenharia de Software - Plataforma CRM
descricao: Descrição da vaga Nossa área é o centro técnico estratégico que conecta a estratégia comercial com a execução de vendas, atendendo todas as verticais do ecossistema Porto (Auto, Saúde, Serviços, Bank e Holding). Potencializamos a atuação da Diretoria Comercial, Diretoria de Clientes e Diretoria de Planejamento Comercial, impactando diretamente nossos gestores, a força de vendas e toda a rede de corretores. Somos responsáveis por entregar excelência tecnológica e operacional nas frentes cruciais para o crescimento do grupo: Canais, Canais Diferenciados e Produção Comercial, estruturados em duas grandes tribos: Tribo Plataforma: Responsável pela jornada e ecossistema de vendas via plataforma de CRM; Tribo Fullstack: Responsável pelas aplicações customizadas, serviços/APIs corporativas e malhas de integração. Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista em Engenharia de Software / Arquiteta de Soluções para assumir a liderança funcional e o direcionamento estratégico dos nossos projetos de CRM. Nesta cadeira, você será a referência máxima da squad, com autonomia sobre a arquitetura funcional, visão de processos de ponta a ponta e governança de dados nos módulos de Sales, Service e Contact Center do Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE. titulo: Pessoa Tech Lead FullStack ( Back end )
descricao: NOSSAS PESSOAS, JUNTAS, LIDERAM COM CONSCIÊNCIA. Na Natura, temos potencial para impulsionar transformações significativas. Isso é possível por meio dos produtos inovadores da Natura e Avon; das experiências marcantes dos serviços de beleza da Bluma e da nossa plataforma de educação financeira, a Emana Pay. Marcas e serviços relevantes para quem os utiliza e reconhecidos pelo nosso compromisso com a condução de negócios regenerativos. Função Prazo indeterminado O que você vai fazer por aqui? A pessoa Tech Lead Fullstack na Natura atua como referência técnica hands-on, liderando pelo exemplo e colocando a mão na massa quando necessário ( mas não será o papel principal codar), junto ao time para construir soluções escaláveis em Node.js (TypeScript), React e React Native. É responsável por definir arquiteturas que garantem a sustentabilidade do produto a longo prazo, guiando a modernização de sistemas para a nuvem (AWS Serverless e OCI) e demonstrando versatilidade para navegar entre bases modernas e legados em Java ou PHP. Quais conhecimentos e vivências você vai precisar para compartilhar com a nossa rede? Será a referência técnica de um time (5+ pessoas), responsável por guiar o backlog técnico, definir a arquitetura ao lado dos nossos Arquitetos e garantir que a equipe tenha o caminho livre para inovar. Liderança Hands-on: Guiar, mentorar e destravar a equipe técnica no dia a dia, codando junto com o time para resolver os desafios mais complexos. Arquitetura e Decisão Técnica: Arquitetar soluções escaláveis, seguras e de alta performance, colaborando diretamente com arquitetos e outros Tech Leads. Gestão do Backlog Técnico: Ser o(a) dono(a) da saúde técnica do produto, equilibrando a entrega de novas features com o pagamento de débitos técnicos. Domínio do Ecossistema: Liderar o desenvolvimento de soluções robustas focadas em Node.js, atuando também no ecossistema front/mobile com React, React Native e apps nativos. É fundamental ter versatilidade para interagir, modernizar ou integrar com sistemas legados em linguagens como Java ou PHP. Nuvem e Escalabilidade: Desenhar e evoluir aplicações na nuvem, utilizando as melhores práticas em AWS (forte viés Serverless/Lambda) e atuando também com nossa infraestrutura em OCI (Oracle Cloud). Cultura Ágil: Liderar e orientar equipes multidisciplinares no desenvolvimento de produtos, utilizando Jira e Git, garantindo transparência, prazos e altíssima qualidade de entrega. Quais os requisitos? Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de software e liderança técnica. Domínio em Node.js (TypeScript) para estruturação de back-end. Versatilidade para navegar, dar manutenção e integrar soluções com bases de código legadas e novas (como Java e, por que não, um PHP?). Profundo conhecimento em Arquitetura Serverless e forte vivência com AWS (EC2, Lambda, S3, etc.). Conhecimento em OCI é um grande plus. Experiência em modelagem e consumo de banco de dados relacionais e não-relacionais (SQL, MongoDB, Redis). Vivência com ferramentas de CI/CD (Jenkins, BitBucket Pipelines, Sonar ou similares) e cultura de DevOps. Forte compreensão de práticas de segurança, escalabilidade e conformidade na nuvem. Quais os diferenciais? Certificações em AWS (Solutions Architect, Developer, etc.). Conhecimentos profundos de automação de infraestrutura (Terraform, CloudFormation). Pós-graduação ou especialização na área de Engenharia de Software ou Arquitetura de Sistemas. O que você vai encontrar por aqui? Somos mais do que um lugar de trabalho: construímos e vivemos diariamente o Ecossistema Bem Estar Bem, baseado na relação harmoniosa entre cada indivíduo, as relações ao seu redor e o ambiente em que está inserido. Além de oferecer benefícios voltados ao bem-estar social, físico, financeiro, mental e emocional, promovemos um ambiente de prosperidade, pertencimento e propósito, fortalecendo uma rede sólida de apoio, expansão de consciência e respeito à diversidade, equidade e inclusão. Somos um movimento que transforma a maneira de viver e fazer negócios em 14 países da América Latina, sempre guiados por consciência. Conhece alguma pessoa aqui na Natura? Se sim, peça o e-mail corporativo dessa pessoa e, ao se inscrever para uma vaga, utilize-o para solicitar uma recomendação. É uma excelente oportunidade para fortalecer sua rede de contatos e avançar no seu processo seletivo em nossa empresa! A Natura celebra e abraça a diversidade em todas as suas formas e pluralidades. Convidamos #Mulheres, #PessoasNegras, #PessoasComDeficiência, pessoas da comunidade #LGBTQIA+, #Gestantes e pessoas com #50anos+ a se candidatarem para esta vaga!

descricao: Head of Cloud Platform About HYPR HYPR is a technology company at the intersection of AI, data and location intelligence. It operates a proprietary end-to-end platform that connects physical-world behavior, offline transactions, mobile signals and omnichannel media execution. R$100M+ annual revenue, bootstrapped and profitable, category leader in physical retail media and incrementality measurement in Brazil. Privacy by design: no personally identifiable data is collected anywhere in the platform. What we have built Groundflow : transactional data infrastructure built on fiscal receipts. Over 350 million receipts and 1 billion+ SKUs observed in real physical retail transactions, R$3.16 trillion in GMV processed, 25 million new receipts a month, from the largest chains to the long tail, granular to the SKU. Places Graph : the geospatial layer that turns coordinates, visits and store identity into location intelligence. The IQ suite : geoIQ, revIQ, bidIQ, adsIQ and askIQ, the applications our clients use for measurement, optimization, activation and research. All of them run on four data pipelines: places, transactions, audiences and performance. Demandshift : predictive demand analytics by product, launched in September 2026. Models demand across 500+ product categories in FMCG, auto, real estate and upscale retail on top of the full receipt base. Swarm : an agentic workspace where a brand opens a case in one sentence and a system of AI agents breaks it into hypotheses, investigates them in parallel across the four pipelines, has an independent auditor redo the numbers, and returns ranked hypotheses with confidence levels and actions ready to execute. HYPR Audiences : our audience catalog exposed as a public MCP server and plugin, available to agencies and advertisers inside their own AI tools. The platform HYPR Cloud is where all of this runs: where data is ingested, models are trained, agents reason, decisions are made and products are delivered at scale. It is a hybrid architecture (public cloud plus owned infrastructure for the receipt flow), a vendor-agnostic AI layer that uses more than one foundation model provider by use case, and a modern orchestrated data stack. It is the technical foundation of HYPR’s long-term differentiation. The role You own HYPR Cloud end to end: architecture, development and operation of the data, AI and agent systems that directly support strategy, revenue and competitive advantage. The role reports to the CEO and works directly with the board. It is designed for a founder-grade technical leader: deep enough to design systems personally, with the judgment for high-impact long-term decisions and the credibility to operate as a peer to executive leadership. This is not a research role, a purely managerial role, or a place to build a large organization. It is a build-and-own mandate. Mission Design, build and scale AI-native platforms that turn HYPR’s proprietary data advantage into defensible, monetizable systems, from receipt ingestion to predictive models to autonomous agents, with world-class engineering standards, execution speed and economic discipline. single coherent platform Technical strategy aligned with board objectives and long-term direction Reliability, scalability, performance and cost efficiency of every production system Hiring, titulo: Gerente Executivo de Desenvolvimento de Software
descricao: Company Description Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries. Job Description Sobre a posição Buscamos uma liderança executiva para atuar como Head de Engenharia de Software, responsável pela estratégia, governança e operação da engenharia da unidade de negócios. A posição lidera uma organização de aproximadamente 60 a 70 profissionais entre Engenharia, Desenvolvimento, QA e SRE, com forte atuação na gestão de parceiros terceirizados. O desafio é garantir uma operação de engenharia escalável, eficiente e orientada por indicadores, apoiando a evolução tecnológica da companhia e atuando em estreita colaboração com times globais de Platform, Security e Inteligência Artificial. Principais responsabilidades Liderar a organização de Engenharia de Software, promovendo alta performance, eficiência operacional e alinhamento aos objetivos do negócio. Gerenciar equipes internas e parceiros terceirizados, incluindo definição de escopo, acompanhamento de desempenho, feedbacks, substituições e gestão contratual. Conduzir a governança da engenharia, estabelecendo indicadores de produtividade, qualidade e entrega, como métricas de deploy, rollback, lead time e eficiência operacional. Atuar na gestão financeira da área, com responsabilidade sobre orçamento, Opex, custos de cloud e iniciativas contínuas de otimização. Liderar discussões técnicas com Engineering Leads, apoiando decisões de arquitetura, evolução tecnológica e modernização de plataformas. Coordenar a execução das demandas relacionadas à gestão de vulnerabilidades, traduzindo os backlogs da área de Segurança em planos de ação junto às equipes de engenharia. Representar a unidade de negócios em fóruns globais de Security, AI e Platform, garantindo alinhamento com as iniciativas corporativas. Incentivar a adoção de tecnologias e soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial em parceria com as áreas de negócio e tecnologia. Perfil buscado Buscamos uma liderança que combine profundidade técnica e visão estratégica. É fundamental ter autonomia para conduzir a operação da engenharia, capacidade de priorização em ambientes dinâmicos e postura executiva para influenciar diferentes stakeholders. Valorizamos profissionais orientados por dados, com forte foco em governança, eficiência operacional e melhoria contínua, capazes de transformar indicadores em decisões e resultados para o negócio. Ambiente tecnológico A posição atuará em um ambiente com tecnologias diversas, incluindo Node.js, Java, TypeScript, React Native, Flutter e Swift. Mais importante do que experiência em uma linguagem específica é a capacidade de liderar discussões técnicas e direcionar a evolução da engenharia. Qualifications Experiência consolidada em liderança de organizações de Engenharia de Software de grande porte. Vivência na gestão de fornecedores e fábricas de software. Experiência em gestão financeira de tecnologia, incluindo controle de orçamento, Opex e custos de cloud. Capacidade de conduzir discussões técnicas de arquitetura e engenharia, sem necessidade de domínio de uma stack específica. Conhecimento prático em metodologias ágeis, SDLC, desenvolvimento em cloud e governança de engenharia. Familiaridade com gestão de vulnerabilidades e segurança da informação, atuando como coordenador das iniciativas junto aos times técnicos. Inglês avançado para interação frequente com equipes e executivos globais. Conhecimento sobre Inteligência Artificial suficiente para participar de discussões estratégicas e apoiar a construção de soluções com IA. Additional Information Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why. Experian is also proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity. descricao: ## Job Description Summary Solution Architects on the Genius Point of Sale (POS) team at Global Payments own the technical outcomes for one or more POS platforms, while actively contributing to the convergence of each into a shared architecture ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of payments, commerce, and developer experience, and contributes directly to how AI-enabled capabilities are embedded into merchant-facing products and internal tooling. This is a deeply embedded, delivery-oriented role. ## Summary of This Role This role works directly with product and engineering teams to design and guide the architecture of cloud-native POS systems, payment integrations, and third-party partner ecosystems. The focus is helping teams make good technical decisions quickly, anchoring designs in real-world constraints, NFRs, security, and scalability, and driving cross-domain interoperability so capabilities built in one platform can be shared across the broader organization. A core expectation is leading how Genius POS teams build and adopt AI tooling, from chatbots and agentic workflows to AI-assisted development practices. ## What Part Will You Play? **Embedded architecture ownership:** Participates in sprint ceremonies, roadmap planning, and trade-off conversations as a first-class member of the delivery team. **Payment and integration design:** Leads architecture for payment flows (card-present, card-not-present, semi-integrated, P2PE, tokenization, surcharge/cash discount) and for the integration ecosystem connecting POS platforms to third-party loyalty, delivery, gift, payroll, and fiscal providers. **Convergence through interoperability:** Designs APIs and contracts that enable the POS platforms to share capabilities without forced disruption. Treats every design as an opportunity for cross-platform reuse until proven otherwise. **Unified integration platform:** Contributes to the architecture of a shared integration fabric, including partner onboarding, API management, authentication, schema translation, and shared service design. **AI-enabled solutions:** Designs and contributes to AI-integrated product features: chatbot orchestration, agentic workflows using MCP tooling, operator-facing AI assistants, and RAG-backed analytics. Evaluates and champions AI tools that accelerate team delivery. **NFR ownership:** Owns security, scalability, observability, and compliance requirements as first-class design inputs, not retrofit work at the end of a cycle. **Technical governance without gatekeeping:** Integrates governance into design so that architecture reviews become a byproduct of good work, not a late-stage blocker. **Cross-team enablement:** Represents the POS domain in cross-functional architecture forums. Documents decisions and their rationale. Helps less-senior engineers grow their architectural instincts. ## What Are We Looking For? ### Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience 6+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 3 years in a solution architect, lead engineer, or principal engineer capacity Demonstrated experience designing and shipping payment integrations: card-present, gateway integrations, semi-integrated payment flows, tokenization, or PCI-scoped architectures Hands-on experience building or operating cloud-native systems on AWS or Azure (microservices, event-driven architecture, API design) Strong API design skills across REST and OpenAPI, including authentication/authorization patterns (OAuth 2.0, API key lifecycle) Experience integrating third-party platforms and designing scalable integration patterns (adapters, SPIs, provider-agnostic contracts) ### Preferred Qualifications Experience with point-of-sale systems or commerce platforms Familiarity with payment gateway ecosystems Experience designing or working with unified integration platforms, API gateways (Apigee, Kong, AWS API Gateway), or developer portals Experience building or architecting AI-enabled features: chatbot/conversational AI, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, LLM tool use (function calling, MCP), or AI-assisted developer tooling Experience working across verticals (SMB, mid-market, enterprise) and understanding the architectural tradeoffs each requires ## Desired Skills and Capabilities ### Technical **Cloud platforms:** AWS (ECS/Fargate, EKS, Lambda, SQS/SNS, Aurora, S3, CloudWatch) and/or Azure (App Services, AKS, Service Bus, Cosmos DB) **Backend:** Java, .NET, Node.js, PHP, Go, or comparable; comfortable reading and reviewing across stacks **Data:** Relational (MySQL/PostgreSQL/Aurora), caching (Redis), search (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch), big data pipelines (BigQuery, Athena, S3-based lakes) **Messaging / events:** Kafka, SQS/SNS, or comparable event-driven architectures **Mobile platforms:** Familiarity with iOS, Android, or React Native in the context of commerce client applications **IaC and CI/CD:** Terraform, GitHub Actions, Harness, or equivalent **AI/ML:** Practical experience with foundation model APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, GCP Vertex), prompt engineering, RAG patterns, agent frameworks, or MCP tooling ### Payments and Compliance Working knowledge of PCI DSS scope management and semi-integrated payment architectures Familiarity with P2PE, tokenization, and secure card data handling Understanding of payment tender types: credit/debit, gift card, BNPL, ACH, and alternative payment methods ### Soft Skills and Ways of Working **Skills / Knowledge:** Having wide-ranging experience, uses professional concepts and company objectives to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways. **Job Complexity:** Works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. Exercises judgment in selecting methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Networks with key contacts outside own area of expertise. **Supervision:** Determines methods and procedures on new assignments and may coordinate activities of other personnel. **Action over artifacts:** Ships solutions, not documents. Diagrams exist to align teams, not to substitute for delivery. Value is measured by what teams build and ship, not by the elegance of designs in isolation. **Bias toward decisions:** Makes the call when teams are stuck, documents the why and the risks. **Shared mindset:** Before approving a net-new build, the first question is whether a peer domain already solved it or also has value in it. **Communicates across levels:** Equally comfortable in an engineering design review and a product conversation about tradeoffs. ### Tooling **Project and delivery management:** Jira, Confluence **Architecture and diagramming:** Lucidchart, Miro, draw.io, or comparable **API design and documentation:** Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman, Apigee, or comparable **Observability:** Datadog, CloudWatch, or comparable APM/logging platforms ## The Work You'll Join Global Payments is one of the world's largest pure-play payment technology companies, processing billions of transactions annually across more than 170 countries. Genius POS is Global Payments' suite of merchant point-of-sale platforms, spanning many product lines across several verticals. Solution Architects on this team sit at the intersection of payments infrastructure and POS commerce, with direct access to Global Payments' processing network, gateway platform, and international payment capabilities. The Genius POS architecture team is driving a common technology strategy across these platforms, including shared integration infrastructure, a converging payments architecture, and AI-enabled product capabilities. Initiatives include: **Unified Integration Platform:** Architecture that gives each POS platform production-grade API management, partner lifecycle management, and a shared service layer for high-effort integrations. **AI Chatbot and Agentic Workflows:** An operator-facing AI assistant that evolves from read-only conversational analytics to write-enabled agentic operations against POS systems of record, powered MCP tooling and POS API integrations. **Consistent Payments:** A shared payments decision framework and roadmap across each POS platform, covering when to use each payment flow, and driving PCI scope reduction through semi-integrated architecture. **Shared Services:** Designing reusable capabilities that can be built and owned once and consumed across each POS platform.

descricao: Acerca de Abbott Abbott es líder mundial en cuidado de la salud, que crea ciencia innovadora para mejorar la salud de las personas. Siempre estamos mirando hacia el futuro, anticipando cambios en la ciencia y la tecnología médica. Tendrás acceso a : Desarrollo profesional con una empresa internacional donde podrás hacer crecer la carrera que sueñas. Una compañía reconocida como mejor lugar para trabajar en docenas de países alrededor del mundo y nombrada una de las empresas más admiradas del mundo por Fortune. Una compañía que es reconocida como una de las mejores compañías grandes para trabajar, así como un mejor lugar para trabajar para la diversidad, las madres trabajadoras, mujeres ejecutivas y científicas. En esta división, estamos comprometidos a llevar los beneficios de nuestros medicamentos confiables a más personas en los países de más rápido crecimiento del mundo. Nuestro amplio portafolio de medicamentos genéricos de marca diferenciada y de alta calidad abarca múltiples áreas terapéuticas, incluidas la gastroenterología, la salud de la mujer, los cardiometabólicos, el manejo del dolor / sistema nervioso central y las vías respiratorias. Como Analista de Control de Gestión deberá monitorear diariamente el desempeño financiero de Novasalud mediante el seguimiento de venta, gastos y resultados, así como el control de capital de trabajo. Participar activamente de la elaboración y consolidación de las proyecciones de Novasalud y sus unidades. Principales Responsabilidades Controlar y monitorear el desempeño financiero de Novasalud, realizando seguimiento diario de las ventas, costos y gastos, y analizando las desviaciones respecto al Plan y las proyecciones financieras, con el fin de identificar riesgos y oportunidades de manera oportuna y apoyar a la toma de decisiones del negocio. Elaborar y coordinar plantes de acción junto a las distintas áreas de Novasalud para corregir desviaciones presupuestarias y mejorar el desempaño financiero, asegurando con ello el cumplimiento de los objetivos y compromisos financieros del negocio. Elaborar y mantener reportes de gestión financieros y operacionales, incluyendo análisis de venta, gastos, inventarios, obsolescencia y capital de trabajo, tanto para requerimientos locales como corporativos, proporcionando información confiable, oportuna y relevante para la gestión y la toma de decisiones. Participar activamente en la elaboración y actualización de las proyecciones financieras, incluyendo P&L y Flujo de caja, con el propósito de apoyar la planificación financiera y anticipar el desempeño del negocio. Realizar conciliaciones y validaciones de información de venta entre distintas fuentes y sistemas de información, asegurando la integridad y exactitud de los datos utilizados para la generación de reportes. Realizar evaluaciones económicas y financieras de proyectos y oportunidades de negocio, monitoreando el cumplimiento de los beneficios esperados y midiendo sus resultados, con el objetivo de respaldar decisiones informadas y optimizar la asignación de recursos. descricao: Estamos buscando un/a Data Architect para incorporarse a una compañía de gran escala y alcance regional, asumiendo un rol estratégico en la evolución de su arquitectura y modelos de datos. Liderazgo técnico: Trayectoria comprobable liderando técnicamente a ingenieros de datos y BI en el ciclo completo de vida del dato (design-to-production). From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. 𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗔𝗻𝗮𝗹𝘆𝘁𝗶𝗰𝘀 & 𝗕𝗜 𝘁𝗲𝗮𝗺 We are a small, senior, fully remote team running analytics for the entire company on Snowflake, dbt, Matillion, and Sigma. We move fast and ship things people use daily. What we're missing is a senior technical voice to make the foundational calls — architecture, platform, governance, ML Ops — so that speed compounds instead of accumulating debt. That's this role, and it comes with unusual latitude to decide how the platform should work. 𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗬𝗼𝘂'𝗹𝗹 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲 𝗮𝗻 𝗜𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗰𝘁 As our 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗱 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿 & 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗔𝗿𝗰𝗵𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗰𝘁, you will shape the technical direction, architectural standards, and data governance of our core Data Analytics platform. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will act as our Data Architect—owning logical and physical data modeling, warehouse design, and layered curation (staging → intermediate → mart)—while serving as our Data Engineering Tech Lead. You will help continuously modernize our tech stack, elevating our software engineering discipline across our data pipelines (DataOps/CI-CD), optimizing compute performance and costs, driving MLOps workflows, and reinforcing data quality and security standards. Crucially, you will drive our AI-readiness initiatives—architecting the semantic layers, data structures, and access patterns needed to make our data seamless and reliable for AI agents and automated workflows. You will serve as the technical anchor for a talented team of Analytical Engineers, collaborating closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Data Science / ML and business stakeholders to ensure our data ecosystem is reliable, scalable, and business-ready. Data Engineering Competency: Lead the end-to-end design and execution of data pipelines—owning ingestion, API integrations, custom connectors, ELT/ETL processes, and pipeline orchestration. DataOps & CI/CD Integration: Build upon our existing Git, CI/CD, and Jira workflows by embedding specialized data discipline—such as automated dbt testing on pull requests, environment isolation, automated credential management, and data deployment standards. Governance & Observability Strategy: Build upon and refine the initial foundations of our governance model. Evaluate, select, and implement scalable Data Catalog and Data Observability solutions to track data lineage, ensure freshness, monitor completeness, and automate failure alerting. Platform Efficiency & Cost Control: Continuously tune Snowflake query performance, clustering, and warehouse sizing to optimize execution times and compute spend. Technical Mentorship & Agile Leadership: Raise the technical effectiveness of Analytical Engineers within our Agile planning framework through architectural guidance, design reviews, and constructive challenge. Stack Modernization & Architecture Evolution: Continuously evaluate new tools, frameworks, and architecture patterns to modernize, optimize, and add flexibility to our data stack. 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗦𝗲𝘁𝘀 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗨𝗽 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗦𝘂𝗰𝗰𝗲𝘀𝘀 Senior Hands-On Experience: Proven track record as a Senior Data Engineer, Data Architect, or Tech Lead in cloud data environments. AI & Agent Readiness: Exposure to preparing data structures, semantic models, feature stores, and API/access layers for AI agents, machine learning pipelines, and automated LLM workflows. Snowflake & dbt Mastery: Deep hands-on expertise administering, tuning, and modeling in Snowflake, alongside advanced mastery of dbt (macros, incremental models, custom tests, packages, and dbt-native CI/CD testing). Advanced SQL & Python Skills: Expert analytical SQL skills (query execution plan tuning, window functions, CTEs) and strong Python proficiency for data pipelines, scripting, and MLOps workflows. Orchestration & Tool Evaluation: Practical experience with ingestion and orchestration engines (e.g., Matillion, Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, Fivetran), with a strong ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs, performance, and costs when selecting or migrating platforms. DataOps & Software Engineering Discipline: Experience operating with active Git and CI/CD pipelines, with a track record of extending these systems to include automated data testing, deployment validation, and secure credential rotation. Critical Thinking & Problem Decomposition: Tendency to question assumptions, gather full business context, form hypotheses, and rigorously evaluate outputs (especially for AI/ML outputs) before jumping to technical solutions. Pragmatic Experimentation: Passion for building lightweight MVPs and Proofs of Concept (POCs) to evaluate new technologies, test architectural hypotheses, and modernize the data stack. Communication & Technical Influence: Business-level English fluency with the ability to articulate complex technical trade-offs clearly, mentor teammates, and collaborate effectively in a remote, globally distributed team. descricao: ¡Buscamos Consultor/a SAP BP! ¿Eres Ingeniero/a Civil apasionado/a por la estrategia, el análisis de datos y la innovación comercial? Si te interesa convertir ideas en proyectos de alto impacto, ¡este desafío es para ti! Tendrás que diseñar, liderar y optimizar transversalmente el ecosistema de Datos Maestros en el entorno SAP S/4HANA de Copec, especializándose en el modelo Business Partner (BP) y su integración CVI (Customer Vendor Integration). Entre sus responsabilidades principales destacan: Diseño y configuración de soluciones funcionales Gestión de reglas de gobierno de datos y la implementación de controles de calidad para los dominios de clientes, proveedores y personas. Tener rol activo en la resolución de incidencias críticas, el liderazgo técnico en proyectos de migración de datos, la ejecución de pruebas integrales end-to-end y la automatización de procesos operativos, asegurando que toda la documentación técnica y funcional de los maestros permanezca actualizada y estandarizada. La finalidad de estas funciones es garantizar la integridad, consistencia y trazabilidad de la información crítica durante todo su ciclo de vida, elementos fundamentales para la continuidad operativa de los procesos de negocio (como FI, MM, SD y PM). ¿Qué harás en este rol? Liderar funcionalmente el modelo Business Partner (BP) en SAP S/4HANA, definiendo y controlando roles BP, agrupaciones, categorías, rangos de numeración, relaciones, datos generales y extensiones organizacionales, Asegurar un modelo BP consistente, escalable y alineado al estándar SAP, evitando duplicidades, inconsistencias y diseños que generen impactos transversales. Analizar y gestionar transversalmente la integración de BP con clientes y proveedores mediante Customer Vendor Integration (CVI), considerando dependencias con MM, FI, CO, SD, PM y procesos relacionados, Garantizar la correcta sincronización e integración de datos entre BP, Customer y Vendor, identificando anticipadamente impactos funcionales y de negocio. Diseñar, configurar y/o definir soluciones funcionales para procesos de Datos Maestros y BP, privilegiando capacidades estándar de SAP S/4HANA y principios Clean Core, Maximizar el uso del estándar SAP, reducir desarrollos específicos innecesarios y mantener soluciones sostenibles y actualizables. Diseñar, implementar y monitorear reglas, controles y métricas de Calidad de Datos sobre Datos Maestros y atributos críticos del Business Partner, Detectar brechas de completitud, exactitud, consistencia, duplicidad e integridad, impulsando acciones de remediación y prevención. Implementar y operacionalizar lineamientos de Gobierno de Datos, trabajando con Data Owners y Data Stewards en definiciones, ownership, reglas de negocio, atributos críticos y controles, Asegurar responsabilidades claras y una gestión sustentable de los datos maestros y del modelo BP en todo su ciclo de vida. Analizar causas raíz y liderar la resolución funcional de incidencias complejas asociadas a BP, CVI y Datos Maestros, coordinando equipos SAP, ABAP, integraciones, Tecnología y negocio, Reducir la recurrencia de errores, proteger la continuidad operacional y acelerar la resolución de incidentes de alto impacto. Participar en proyectos, conversiones y migraciones SAP ECC a S/4HANA, definiendo criterios de transformación, mapeo, depuración, carga, reconciliación y validación de BP y Datos Maestros, Asegurar que la información migrada cumpla reglas funcionales y de calidad y que el modelo BP resultante sea consistente con el diseño objetivo. En Copec la Diversidad e Inclusión entre sus trabajadores/as constituye un pilar fundamental para el desarrollo de una propuesta de valor sostenible y la vocación país que la caracteriza. Buscamos fomentar la formación de equipos multidisciplinarios, diversos e inclusivos, donde las distintas opiniones, talentos, características y condiciones sean respetadas y valoradas de manera de fortalecer la Compañía y asegurar el logro de los objetivos estratégicos. ¿Qué necesitamos de ti? Formación: Carrera profesional de 5 años o más completa, preferentemente Ingeniería Civil Informática, Ingeniería Civil Industrial, Ingeniería en Computación, Ingeniería Comercial con especialización tecnológica o carrera afín. Experiencia Laboral: 4 a 8 años Detalle de la Experiencia Laboral: Gestión de Datos Maestros bajo el modelo de Business Partner e integración CVI con un enfoque transversal a los distintos módulos de S4HANA. Haber participado alineando directrices de gobierno y adaptando el modelo de datos del ERP a las necesidades del negocio en el mismo o en sistemas legados. Trayectoria en desarrollo, gestión y monitoreo de indicadores(KPI's) de calidad. Herramientas técnicas: SAP S/4HANA o módulo funcional SAP (altamente deseable) con conocimiento en BP y Metodologías ágiles. Beneficios Becas de estudios para ti y tu familia. Centro de Salud. Posnatal flexible. Posibilidad de optar por un permiso de tres meses sin goce de sueldo. Días de permisos que la compañía te otorgará para que puedas utilizarlos en distintas ocasiones. Convenios con gimnasios, hoteles, alimentos, servicios de telefonía, tecnología, mascotas, entre otros. Programa de beneficios flexibles, el cual te brindará la posibilidad de disfrutar de diferentes experiencias y actividades en tu tiempo libre. Actividades extra programáticas. Y ¡muchos más! En Copec y sus filiales garantizamos la confidencialidad y seguridad de los datos personales de los/as candidatos. La información proporcionada será utilizada exclusivamente para el proceso de selección y será tratada de acuerdo con la normativa de protección de datos vigente. Los datos serán utilizados exclusivamente mientras dure el proceso de selección o por un período máximo de 6 meses, lo que ocurra primero, y serán eliminados una vez finalizado este. Al postularte, aceptas el tratamiento de tus datos con estos fines

local: Las Condes, Santiago Metropolitan Region, Chile
descricao: Buscamos un(a) Coordinador(a) de Proyecto altamente organizado(a) y orientado(a) al detalle para brindar apoyo administrativo, de coordinación, reporte y control a un programa de transformación SAP de gran escala. El cargo contribuirá a mantener un ritmo de trabajo efectivo mediante la coordinación de reuniones y talleres, la administración de la herramienta de gestión de proyectos, la preparación de minutas e informes de estado, el seguimiento de entregables y acciones, y la mantención de registros completos y ordenados. La persona seleccionada trabajará con equipos de negocio y tecnología y deberá desenvolverse profesionalmente tanto en inglés como en español. Principales Responsabilidades · Brindar apoyo administrativo y de coordinación diario al liderazgo del proyecto SAP, la PMO, los líderes de frente de trabajo, los representantes del negocio y los socios de implementación. · Coordinar reuniones, talleres, instancias de gobernanza y sesiones del Comité Directivo. · Preparar minutas precisas, decisiones y acciones; distribuir los registros oportunamente y realizar seguimiento con los responsables para apoyar su cierre dentro de los plazos acordados. · Administrar y mantener la herramienta de gestión de proyectos, incluyendo accesos de usuarios, áreas de equipo, backlogs, paneles, consultas y registros del proyecto. · Apoyar a los líderes de frente de trabajo en la creación y mantención de acciones en la herramienta de gestión de proyectos. Formación y Experiencia · Título universitario en Ingeniería Civil Industrial, Ingeniería Comercial, Ingeniería en informatica, Ingeniería en Control de Gestión o carrera relacionada. · Al menos 3 años de experiencia como Coordinador(a) de Proyecto, Coordinador(a) de PMO, Administrador(a) de Proyecto o cargo similar, idealmente apoyando un programa de tecnología, ERP o transformación empresarial de gran escala. · Se valorará especialmente la experiencia con la herramienta de gestión de proyectos · Manejo avanzado de Microsoft 365, especialmente Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, Teams y SharePoint. · Dominio profesional del inglés y español, tanto oral como escrito, es obligatorio.

Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work. We have a position for a DevOps Engineer with passion for automation and next-gen infrastructure. We are constantly growing both in product and in customers, and you’ll have a leading role getting us there! Responsibilities Work with the latest AWS technologies like Kubernetes (EKS), S3, Postgres, DocumentDB, and more. Manage our AWS production deployments (SaaS) running on AWS EKS. Design and develop tools for managing and applying DevOps principles, such as CI/CD automation and IaC (Infrastructure as Code) on our Cloud-based production systems. Work with the team to enhance production stability, availability, and reliability. Install, configure, update and troubleshoot our product microservices and tools including databases Design and manage different monitoring and observability tools for troubleshooting and resolving production issues. Required Skills And Experience 5+ years of relevant DevOps work experience in Production environments Strong working experience with Docker and Kubernetes Experience with CI/CD tools (Drone, Jenkins, GitHub actions or similar) Strong IT background. A deep understanding and familiarity with: Networking: K8S ingress, services, and Load Balancers AWS services, EKS, Postgres, S3, Mongo, SES, SNS, SQS. Experience in automated deployment and infrastructure. Knowledge and experience with alerting and monitoring tools. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all. Our salary range reflects gross base salary. For commercial roles with commission eligibility, this figure represents On-Target Earnings (OTE), inclusive of base salary and target commission. Salary ranges are quoted in USD as a consistent global reference. Your offer will be localized to your country's currency using a market-aligned conversion. Final pay is based on objective, job-related criteria including experience, skills, and location. We don't ask about salary history. Offers are based on the role and what you bring to it. Unless otherwise agreed, we will communicate with job applicants using Deel-specific emails, which include @ deel.com and other acquired company emails like @ payspace.com and @ paygroup.com . You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page . Deel welcomes persons with disabilities to apply to any of our open roles. We will provide application and/or interview accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities or other needs. If you require application and/or interview accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via email (recruiting@deel.com) and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation. As part of our hiring process, we primarily rely on interviews and role-related assessments. In limited cases, we may also consider informal background information relevant to the role, in line with our privacy and fairness obligations. This application process may utilise Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT) and AI systems to assist in evaluating candidates based on experience level, technical skills and qualifications. descricao: The Senior DevOps Engineer holds strategic and technical responsibility for designing, building, and maintaining the scalable infrastructure that powers the company's products. Their primary mission is to automate the entire software development lifecycle (from code to production), ensuring system availability, cost optimization, security (DevSecOps), and high resilience. Additionally, they act as a bridge between development and operations and provide leadership and mentorship to junior engineers. Key Activities Cloud Architecture and Management: Design and manage critical infrastructure on public clouds. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Define and implement automated provisioning strategies using tools such as Terraform or Ansible. CI/CD Pipelines: Design, optimize, and maintain Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment workflows using modern practices like GitOps (via Jenkins, or ArgoCD). Container Orchestration: Manage enterprise-grade Kubernetes clusters (EKS, GKE) and Docker at scale. Observability and Monitoring: Configure alerts and advanced telemetry dashboards using Prometheus and Grafana stacks. Culture and Security (DevSecOps): Integrate automated vulnerability scanning into pipelines and ensure compliance with company standards Mentorship and Leadership: Guide development teams on infrastructure best practices, document processes, and train junior/mid-level engineers. Core Qualifications Work Experience: A minimum of 5–7 years of experience in systems, development, or infrastructure, with at least 3–4 years dedicated exclusively to DevOps/Cloud roles. Languages: Intermediate-to-advanced English (B2/C1) Programming/Scripting Skills: Advanced proficiency in automation languages such as Python, Bash, or Go. About Comscore At Comscore, we’re pioneering the future of cross-platform media measurement, arming organizations with the insights they need to make decisions with confidence. Central to this aim are our people who work together to simplify the complex on behalf of our clients & partners. Though our roles and skills are varied, we’re united by our commitment to five underlying values: Integrity, Velocity, Accountability, Teamwork, and Servant Leadership. If you’re motivated by big challenges and interested in helping some of the largest and most important media properties and brands navigate the future of media, we’d love to hear from you. Comscore (NASDAQ: SCOR) is a trusted partner for planning, transacting and evaluating media across platforms. With a data footprint that combines digital, linear TV, over-the-top and theatrical viewership intelligence with advanced audience insights, Comscore allows media buyers and sellers to quantify their multiscreen behavior and make business decisions with confidence. A proven leader in measuring digital and set-top box audiences and advertising at scale, Comscore is the industry’s emerging, third-party source for reliable and comprehensive cross-platform measurement. To learn more about Comscore, please visit Comscore.com. Comscore is committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity.

descricao: At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley. Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide. When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success. DevOps Engineer (AWS) at BairesDev As a DevOps Engineer specializing in AWS, you will design and maintain the cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines that power our software delivery. You will act as a link between development and operations, ensuring that systems are scalable, secure, and highly available through advanced automation and cloud-native practices. What You'll Do Architect and manage robust cloud environments using AWS core services to ensure high availability. Develop and maintain scalable CI/CD pipelines to streamline code integration and deployment processes. Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to automate environment provisioning and maintain configuration consistency. Optimize containerized workloads and orchestration strategies to improve resource utilization and performance. Collaborate with engineering teams to enhance system monitoring, logging, and incident response capabilities. Ensure the security and integrity of cloud resources through rigorous IAM management and infrastructure hardening. descricao: Responsibilities Octave is seeking a Technical Lead, a role that is crucial to ensure the successful adoption, expansion, and operational support of Octave solutions, delivering high-quality, scalable services to our customers. The Technical lead is Octave representative at customer business units, overseeing the execution and quality of services in compliance with contractual obligations. The purpose of the Technical Lead is to serve as the primary representative at customer business units. The Technical Lead is responsible for ensuring the effective execution and management of services in compliance with contractual obligations. This role involves acting as a liaison between Octave and the customer, facilitating communication, overseeing the quality and timeliness of service delivery, managing administrative and technical tasks, and ensuring adherence to safety and confidentiality standards. descricao: Company Overview At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future. Department Overview LACR Support and Services Job Description En Motorola Solutions , construimos e integraremos las soluciones de comunicaciones de misión crítica que mantienen conectadas y seguras a las comunidades, empresas e industrias en toda la región. Estamos en la búsqueda de un/a Service Partner Manager (SPM) para liderar la estrategia de soporte, la gobernanza operativa de nuestra red de Servicios Autorizados Motorola (SAM) y el crecimiento de la huella de servicios en nuestro portafolio de telecomunicaciones. En MSI creemos firmemente que la innovación se potencia con la diversidad. Invitamos activamente a las profesionales y líderes del mundo STEM (Ciencia, Tecnología, Ingeniería y Matemáticas) a postular a esta posición de alto impacto regional. Misión Estratégica del Cargo Actuar como la máxima autoridad regional y garante de la satisfacción del cliente en el cumplimiento de garantías, soporte de nivel superior (L2/L3) y gestión de contratos de servicios para todo el portafolio de suscriptores (PCR, ASTRO, DIMETRA) e infraestructura MOTOTRBO. El/La SPM lidera la relación técnica, financiera y operativa con los socios estratégicos (SAMs y Canales) y actúa como un motor de desarrollo de negocios para maximizar los ingresos recurrentes por servicios ( Service Revenue ). Funciones y Responsabilidades Gobernanza y Gestión de la Red SAM (Servicio Autorizado Motorola):Liderar la certificación, auditorías técnicas (presenciales/remotas) y evaluación continua del desempeño de la red de SAMs.Auditar el cumplimiento de normativas internacionales de infraestructura: laboratorios con protección ESD/GND, instrumental de medición calibrado (Service Monitors), herramientas de servicio R56 y protocolos de seguridad.Gestionar la relación financiera con el área de Finance para la aprobación y procesamiento de pagos a la red de partners. Garantía y Defensoría del Cliente (Warranty Advocate):Asegurar el cumplimiento irrestricto de las garantías de fábrica de todo el portafolio de suscriptores.Aprobar casos especiales de alta sensibilidad comercial y técnica (DOA, OOTB, reparaciones Nivel 3 y autorizaciones estratégicas). Soporte Técnico Especializado de Nivel 2 y 3 (L2/L3):Brindar soporte técnico avanzado e interceder en escalaciones complejas involucrando a los equipos globales de TSO (Technical Support Office), US Depot, Supply Chain, Calidad y Finanzas.Gestionar herramientas de licenciamiento (EID SDS), herramientas de taller/depot y resolución de incidencias en terreno o de forma remota. Gestión de Contratos de Soporte y SLA (Systems Customer Support Manager - CSM):Desempeñarse como Contract Manager para todos los sistemas MOTOTRBO y DIMETRA comercializados por partners en su territorio.Garantizar el cumplimiento estricto de los Acuerdos de Nivel de Servicio (SLA) y articular la gestión de turnover desde Presales/Delivery hacia Soporte. Soporte Consultivo a la Red de Canales, Pre-Venta y Ventas:Colaborar directamente con los equipos comerciales (CSE, HTAM, EAM) en la estructuración de propuestas técnicas, ofertas de servicios (SOWs), cotizaciones y levantamiento de requerimientos en licitaciones.Realizar estudios de repuestos (spares) y proponer reemplazos tecnológicos ante procesos de Fin de Vida / Fin de Soporte (EOS). Desarrollo de Negocio y Crecimiento de Ingresos por Servicios (Service Revenue & Footprint):Liderar la estrategia de venta consultiva para incrementar los ingresos por servicios: garantías extendidas, contratos de mantenimiento preventivo/correctivo, capacitaciones técnicas e integración de proyectos completos (Infraestructura + Radios + Aplicaciones).Detectar oportunidades de Up-selling y Cross-selling, y asegurar renovaciones de contratos estratégicos. Basic Requirements Formación Académica Título Profesional: Ingeniería Civil, Ingeniería Civil en Telecomunicaciones, Ingeniería Eléctrica, Electrónica o carreras afines. Experiencia Laboral y Trayectoria Experiencia Total: Mínimo 5 años de trayectoria profesional en el sector de telecomunicaciones. Experiencia Específica: Mínimo 3 años desempeñando funciones de gestión de servicios, mantenimiento de infraestructura, ejecución de proyectos o soporte técnico de campo. Gestión de Clientes y Stakeholders: Experiencia comprobable en atención y trato directo con clientes corporativos B2B, gestión de proveedores y relacionamiento transversal con stakeholders internos/externos. Venta Consultiva: Experiencia deseable en venta consultiva de servicios tecnológicos, contratos de soporte o ingeniería de soluciones. Conocimientos Técnicos Core Dominio teórico y práctico de sistemas de comunicación general, redes e infraestructura de telecomunicaciones. Conocimiento técnico del portafolio de Motorola Solutions: sistemas de radio comercial e industrial (PCR, MOTOTRBO, DIMETRA, ASTRO, WAVE PTX). Experiencia deseable en soporte de campo (Field Engineering) con tecnologías MSI. You will work directly with customer security, audit, risk and compliance teams to help them understand how to confidently utilize AWS, identify risk and design controls, setup ongoing assurance, and establish automated compliance. At AWS, customer obsession is in our DNA. The successful candidate will become a trusted advisor to customers and will work with AWS sales, business development, solutions architecture and product teams to help accelerate adoption by removing compliance and audit as barriers and suggest improvements to our services to meet the customer needs. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Mentorship & Career Growth: We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Basic Qualifications 2+ years of experience working with AI 4+ years of experience in a Cloud Security customer-facing role, such as Cloud Security Architect, Cloud Security Consultant, Cloud Security Technical Sales or technical sales for cloud security solutions or SA specialized in Security (Area of Depth). Hands-on experience securing AWS environments and understanding of architecting on AWS Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences including training, workshops, publications Ability to communicate effectively in English within business and technical settings (Verbal and Written). Preferred Qualifications Security Certifications such as AWS Security Specialty Certification, CISSP, ISSAP, CCSP, or PCI-DSS ISA or similar are valued. Experience presenting on Security conferences Experience Scaling through the creation of assets such as blogposts, articles, videos, podcasts, or engaging with technical communities Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. descricao: Buscamos un/a Technical Lead Senior para liderar técnicamente un proyecto de desarrollo y modernización tecnológica. La persona será responsable de definir y guiar la solución técnica, acompañar al equipo de desarrollo en la toma de decisiones y trabajar de manera colaborativa con áreas de arquitectura y otras partes interesadas. Buscamos un perfil con sólida experiencia en desarrollo de software, arquitectura de soluciones, cloud y prácticas DevOps , capaz de combinar profundidad técnica con liderazgo y orientación a resultados. Find this vacancy on Get on Board. 🛠️ Principales responsabilidades Liderar técnicamente el diseño, desarrollo e implementación de soluciones de software frontend y backend. Desarrollar y supervisar aplicaciones frontend utilizando Next.js y React. Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener servicios backend, APIs y microservicios utilizando NestJS, Node.js y TypeScript. Definir y asegurar buenas prácticas de arquitectura de software, patrones de diseño, calidad de código y estándares de desarrollo. Diseñar e implementar soluciones cloud sobre Google Cloud Platform (GCP), idealmente utilizando Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) y Cloud Run. Diseñar y gestionar integraciones entre sistemas, servicios y plataformas mediante APIs REST y otros mecanismos de comunicación. Identificar oportunidades para reutilizar componentes, servicios y soluciones existentes, optimizando los tiempos de desarrollo y reduciendo la duplicidad de esfuerzos. Evaluar alternativas técnicas y proponer soluciones escalables, seguras, eficientes y alineadas con los requerimientos funcionales y no funcionales. Acompañar al equipo de desarrollo mediante revisiones de código, resolución de problemas técnicos y orientación en la implementación de soluciones. Colaborar con arquitectos, desarrolladores, equipos de infraestructura y áreas de negocio para asegurar la correcta entrega de las soluciones. Identificar riesgos técnicos, proponer mejoras continuas y contribuir a la evolución de la arquitectura tecnológica. Requisitos técnicos Formación profesional en Ingeniería de Sistemas, Informática, Computación o carreras afines. Experiencia sólida en desarrollo de software y liderazgo técnico de equipos o iniciativas de ingeniería. Dominio de Next.js y React para el desarrollo de aplicaciones frontend. Experiencia en desarrollo backend con NestJS, Node.js y TypeScript. Experiencia en diseño, desarrollo y mantenimiento de APIs y arquitecturas basadas en microservicios. Experiencia práctica implementando soluciones sobre Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Conocimientos y experiencia en servicios de contenedores y despliegue cloud, idealmente GKE y Cloud Run. Experiencia en diseño de arquitectura de software, integración de sistemas y definición de soluciones técnicas. Capacidad para evaluar código existente, identificar componentes reutilizables y proponer mejoras sobre soluciones implementadas. Experiencia con control de versiones, revisión de código y buenas prácticas de desarrollo colaborativo. Habilidades de comunicación, análisis, resolución de problemas y toma de decisiones técnicas. Conocimientos técnicos clave Frontend: Next.js, React y TypeScript. Backend: NestJS, Node.js y TypeScript. Cloud: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), idealmente GKE y Cloud Run. Arquitectura: microservicios, diseño de soluciones, patrones de diseño y escalabilidad. Integraciones: diseño y consumo de APIs, especialmente APIs REST e integración entre sistemas. Calidad de software: revisión de código, estándares de desarrollo, mantenibilidad y reutilización de componentes. Despliegue: conocimientos de contenedores y procesos de implementación en ambientes cloud. ⭐ Será valorado adicionalmente Liderazgo técnico y capacidad para orientar a equipos de desarrollo. Enfoque práctico (hands-on) y capacidad para participar directamente en el desarrollo. Pensamiento arquitectónico y visión integral de las soluciones. Autonomía para resolver problemas complejos y tomar decisiones técnicas. Comunicación efectiva y colaboración con equipos multidisciplinarios. Orientación a resultados, calidad y mejora continua. titulo: Solution Architect (.NET/C#) - Cloud Enablement, Remote: Colombia - Costa Rica, Fulltime.
descricao: - This position is open to candidates located in Colombia or Costa Rica only - Solution Architect (.NET/C#) - Cloud Enablement The Solution Architect plays a critical role in shaping and evolving cloud-enabled application architecture to deliver secure, scalable, resilient, and business-aligned solutions. This hands-on role combines technical roadmapping, solution design, independent research, application development, and close collaboration with engineering teams and stakeholders. The ideal candidate combines strong .NET and Azure expertise with practical architecture thinking, modern DevOps and infrastructure-as-code experience, and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly. This person can move between strategic architecture and hands-on delivery, turn ambiguous challenges into wellsupported recommendations, and help define executable work for others. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership and Delivery Define technical roadmaps and architecture strategies for cloud migration, application modernization, and scalable digital solutions. Design secure, scalable, resilient, and highly available systems that align technical decisions with business objectives. Balance long-term architecture direction with hands-on development, prototyping, technical validation, and delivery support. Research architecture options, evaluate tradeoffs and risks, and present clear recommendations to engineering teams and stakeholders. Produce architecture diagrams, decision records, technical plans, and system representations that make complex designs easy to understand. Translate architecture into executable work by helping define epics, features, stories, dependencies, and technical sequencing. Design security-first solutions that protect customer and enterprise data, support compliance, and reduce operational risk. Collaborate with architects, engineering leaders, product partners, and business stakeholders to align solutions with enterprise standards and delivery priorities. Database and Performance Optimization Design data and integration architectures that support scalability, reliability, maintainability, and future growth. Write and review advanced SQL, data models, indexing strategies, and query plans to improve application and database performance. Identify and address performance bottlenecks across applications, services, integrations, and databases. Design APIs, third-party and vendor integrations, and synchronous or asynchronous communication patterns. Define service boundaries, integration contracts, versioning approaches, error-handling strategies, and data integrity controls. Support distributed and event-driven solutions using technologies such as Azure Service Bus, Kafka, or RabbitMQ. Cloud and DevOps Design and support solutions in Microsoft Azure using secure, scalable, and repeatable cloud patterns. Help migrate applications and services from on-premises environments to Azure. Define and improve application onboarding patterns that enable engineering teams to move workloads into the cloud consistently. Use infrastructure-as-code and deployment tooling, including Bicep, Helm, GitHub Enterprise, and GitHub Actions workflows. Apply Agile and DevOps practices to improve delivery quality, deployment reliability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Promote observability, resilience, fault isolation, secure configuration, and operational readiness across cloud solutions. Partner with engineers to troubleshoot architecture, environment, integration, deployment, and operational issues. Full-Stack Development Design and build backend services using C#, .NET, .NET Core, Web APIs, web applications, and servicebased architectures. Remain close enough to the code to validate designs, support implementation, and contribute hands-on when needed. Build and support modern front-end applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, and frameworks such as Vue.js, React, or Angular. Design and evaluate secure authentication and authorization solutions for external users and customerfacing applications through an Identity Provider (IdP), using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, and platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, Duende IdentityServer v8, or OpenIddict. Support customer identity and access management modernization by evaluating and adopting Microsoft Entra External ID, including secure migration paths from Azure AD B2C or other legacy identity platforms. Promote clean, maintainable, testable code and sound engineering practices across the software development lifecycle. Support modernization of legacy applications and the evolution of monolithic systems toward appropriate modular, service-based, distributed, or event-driven designs. Mentorship and Team Development Mentor engineers through pairing, design reviews, code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and technical discussions. Bring ideas forward, encourage constructive brainstorming, and help teams evaluate multiple solution options. Communicate proactively and clearly in a distributed, cross-functional environment. Influence stakeholders and align technical decisions with business objectives, customer needs, delivery constraints, and risk considerations. Research unfamiliar technical areas independently and share findings in a clear, actionable way. Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, curiosity, collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement. Required Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field preferred. 8 to 10 years of software development experience, including technical leadership or architecture responsibilities. 2 or more years of experience creating technical roadmaps and presenting architectural solutions. Strong hands-on experience designing and developing solutions with C#, .NET, .NET Core, Web APIs, and the broader Microsoft technology stack. Strong Microsoft Azure experience, including cloud migration, cloud-native solution design, and application modernization. Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code and delivery automation, including Bicep, Helm, GitHub Enterprise, and GitHub Actions or comparable tooling. Hands-on experience designing and implementing external-user authentication and authorization through an Identity Provider, using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT. Practical experience with at least one relevant identity platform, such as Microsoft Entra ID, Duende IdentityServer v8, OpenIddict, Azure AD B2C, or Microsoft Entra External ID. Experience with distributed systems, asynchronous communication, and event-driven architecture. Strong understanding of API design, third-party integrations, SQL development, data modeling, indexing, and performance optimization. Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and at least one modern front-end framework such as Vue.js, React, or Angular. Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments with a focus on quality, automation, collaboration, and continuous delivery. Demonstrated ability to research unfamiliar technical areas independently, evaluate alternatives, and present clear recommendations. Strong verbal and written English communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences. Proven leadership and collaboration skills, including mentoring engineers, influencing stakeholders, and guiding work without relying solely on formal authority. Preferred Skills Experience implementing Microsoft Entra External ID for customer-facing applications or migrating customer identity workloads from Azure AD B2C. Experience modernizing identity providers or migrating authentication platforms to cloud environments. Experience with Kubernetes-based environments and Helm-managed deployments. Experience with Azure Service Bus, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar messaging platforms. Experience supporting customer-facing applications or solutions operating in security-sensitive or regulated environments. Experience decomposing legacy or monolithic applications into modular, service-based, or event-driven architectures. Azure architecture or development certifications. Exposure to additional cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud. Behavioral and Leadership Expectations Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly explain complex architectural concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to structure and articulate reasoning in a logical, easy-to-follow manner. Collaborative and approachable team player who contributes positively to team culture. Proactive problem solver with curiosity and determination in tackling complex or ambiguous challenges. Customer-focused and security-conscious mindset with strong attention to quality, maintainability, testability, and operational risk. Ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment in complex technical environments. Hands-on leadership style that stays connected to implementation and engineering reality.
