Join our Future Talent network and you'll be one of the first people we reach when the right opening appears. We make around 160 hires a year, so it happens often. The role As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer , I help modernize and scale production platforms, most recently a customer-data caching platform that serves 20–25+ consuming applications at about 3,000 requests per second. I work across SRE, DevOps, engineering and architecture to improve resiliency, automation, observability, deployment practices and overall platform reliability. I work independently, set technical direction and do well in small engineering teams. Your Day-to-day Design, build and operate highly available, fault-tolerant distributed systems and caching platforms. Evaluate the existing architecture and identify opportunities to scale the platform toward 6x current traffic while maintaining performance and resiliency. Improve caching strategies, including TTLs, refresh patterns, cache placement, performance and downstream dependency management. Help evolve the platform toward active-active resiliency and validate failure, recovery and capacity scenarios. Design and implement automated CI/CD pipelines, including rolling, blue/green or canary deployment strategies, automated checks and quality gates. Establish infrastructure, configuration, secrets and application deployment practices using an everything-as-code approach. Build performance and load-testing capabilities and establish meaningful performance gates for releases. Develop monitoring, alerting and observability for cache latency, throughput, availability, errors and other key reliability indicators. Define and improve SLIs, SLOs, error budgets and operational KPIs where appropriate. Automate operational tasks and reduce manual intervention through scripting, tooling and infrastructure automation. Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis and drive reliability improvements through blameless post-incident reviews. Provide technical guidance and establish engineering guardrails for SRE and development teams. Collaborate with Java/Spring Boot engineers, architects, client FTEs and other technical teams to deliver platform improvements. What We're Looking For Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 5+ years of experience working in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, platform engineering or a similar production infrastructure role. Apache Cassandra experience, including data modeling, replication, consistency, tuning and multi-datacenter deployments. Experience operating and scaling distributed systems in production environments. Strong understanding of caching architectures, performance optimization and high-availability systems. Hands-on AWS experience and familiarity with cloud-native architecture. Experience designing and implementing automated CI/CD pipelines and deployment strategies for highly available systems. Experience with infrastructure/configuration/secrets as code and a strong preference for automated, repeatable processes. Strong understanding of observability, monitoring, alerting, performance metrics and production troubleshooting. Experience with performance testing, capacity planning and identifying system bottlenecks. Strong programming or scripting experience for automation and tooling; Java/Spring Boot experience strongly preferred. Ability to work independently, take ownership of ambiguous technical problems and move work forward with limited direction. Ability to provide technical leadership and establish practical engineering standards and guardrails within a small team. Advanced English Level is required for this role, as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons. Strongly Preferred Experience with GraphQL and API gateway architectures. Kubernetes and containerized application experience. GitLab CI/CD experience. Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools. Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog or similar observability platforms. Kafka, Amazon MSK or other event-streaming technologies. Experience designing active-active or multi-region architectures. Experience with enterprise customer-data platforms or high-volume caching systems. How The Process Works Apply and upload your resume. We review your profile and add it to our talent database. titulo: Digital Service Manager SAP GTS  - SKF Automotive Business
descricao: By creating bearings and solutions for everything from industrial applications to vehicles, SKF plays an essential role in our everyday lives. In Q4 2026, SKF intends to spin off its Automotive business and list it as a separate company under the name of SKF Vertevo. A company created to support the future of the automotive market, and to co-drive the future of mobility faster. This role will be a part of that new company. Would you like to join us, and move people further? Digital Service Manager SAP GTS - SKF Automotive Business Are you ready to shape the future of digital customs, trade compliance, and global trade operations? At DSM Logistics & Customs Management, you will have the opportunity to help a global organization strengthen its customs and trade compliance processes using modern digital solutions. In this role, you will work with SAP Global Trade Services (SAP GTS) to ensure compliant, efficient, and automated cross-border trade operations. You will contribute to building and maintaining an integrated landscape where customs processes, trade compliance, logistics, and ERP systems work seamlessly together, providing transparency, speed, and accuracy to global flows of goods. You will collaborate with global business teams, customs specialists, IT partners, and external authorities to drive initiatives that improve compliance reliability, reduce manual work, and enhance digital capabilities across the supply chain. We are looking for someone with hands-on experience from an in-house IT organization, ideally gained as a Service Owner or IT Application Owner responsible for cross-functional solutions and global stakeholders. If you want to influence decisions, take ownership, and support the future of customs and trade compliance in a dynamic organization, this role is for you. What you can expect in the role Solution Ownership Own SAP GTS across customs, compliance, risk, and preference processes. Ensure system stability, data accuracy, and effective lifecycle management, including upgrades and enhancements. System Architecture & Integration Support the integrated architecture across SAP GTS, SAP S/4HANA, logistics systems, and customs authority interfaces. Oversee EDI, API, customs messaging, and connections to satellite applications, including Preferential Origin tools. Customs & Trade Compliance Enablement Enable HS classification, preferential origin, embargo screening, and import/export processes through effective system configuration. Work with customs and business teams to optimize master data, compliance rules, and end-to-end trade processes. Data & Digital Roadmap Drive the digital roadmap for customs automation, data governance, standardization, and regulatory readiness. Project & Budget Leadership Lead GTS implementation, enhancement, and integration projects with global IT teams, business experts, consultants, and customs authorities. Plan and follow up budgets for GTS and customs digitalization activities. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role. You will collaborate broadly across teams, but the position does not include direct personnel leadership. You will enjoy working here if you have: Hands-on experience from an in-house IT organization, ideally as a Service Owner or IT Application Owner managing cross-functional solutions and global stakeholders. A relevant academic background in Information Technology, Computer Science, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field. Proven experience working with SAP Global Trade Services (SAP GTS) in global or regional environments. Strong understanding of customs management, trade compliance, HS classification, embargo checks, and preferential origin processes. Knowledge of integration between SAP GTS and SAP S/4HANA for master data, logistics, and document flows. Experience managing or supporting electronic customs declaration processes and external interface messaging. Solid understanding of process design, integration flows, and regulatory requirements. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to data accuracy and compliance details. Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage. If you want to go further This position will be located on a major SKF site in Tudela (Spain), Puebla (Mexico), Cajamar (Brazil), Buenos Aires (Argentina), Lima (Peru), Montevideo (Uruguay), or Bogota (Colombia). You will report to Alan Pereira Reis, SCM Team Lead, who is located in Gothenburg, Sweden. Please note that we can't accept applications via email. Apply with your CV in English throughout the system, no later than November 1th 2026 . We will screen candidates continuously, so make sure to submit your application as soon as possible. If you want to know more about SKF Automotive business, please visit our webpage. SKF Automotive: Bearings & aftermarket solutions since 1907 Transparency and fairness matter to us At SKF, we see diversity in our workforce as an asset that supports better business results. We are committed to having a fair and inclusive recruitment process where all hiring decisions are based on objective, job-related criteria, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates. To support a fair and transparent recruitment process, the process may include assessments, and before hiring, we may also carry out background checks and verify application information. We will discuss your salary expectations during the first interview, and our final offer will be based on an objective evaluation of your experience, skills, and potential, aligned with the scope of the role and our internal salary guidelines. Our recruitment process may differ from country to country and will always be in line with applicable country-specific laws and regulations. Come as you are – just be yourself. #weareSKF

descricao: Location: LATAM - Remote (Colombia, Bolivia, Chile, Ecuador, Paraguay, Peru, Uruguay, Mexico, Costa Rica, Guatemala, Panama, Honduras, Nicaragua, El Salvador) About Worldly Worldly is the world’s most comprehensive impact intelligence platform — delivering real data to businesses on impacts within their supply chain. Through strategic and meaningful customer relationships, Worldly provides key insights into supplier performance, product impact, trend analysis, and compliance. descricao: Overview Internova Travel Group is one of the largest travel services companies in the world with a collection of leading brands delivering high-touch, personal travel expertise to leisure and corporate clients. Internova manages leisure, business and franchise firms through a portfolio of distinctive divisions. Internova represents more than 100,000 travel advisors in over 6,000 company-owned and affiliated locations predominantly in the United States, Canada and the United Kingdom, with a presence in more than 80 countries. Click here for more information about Internova Travel Group . The travel agencies that are part of Internova Travel Group alone comprise over 30% of all agencies in North America. Our team of leaders – from our expert agents to our executives –– are dedicated to delivering the best travel experience. It’s our heart and soul. Troubleshoot phone issues (with assistance from in-house telecom department as needed). descricao: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce. We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Position Description: As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineering team—it’s core to it. You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turn technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down. You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence. You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing them off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency. Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards. You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal. This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the details. This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction. AI and agentic engineering Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against. Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for. Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed. Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you. Team, resourcing, and accountability Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product. Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments. Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows. Platform and execution Own the architecture end-to-end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows. Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend. In the first week, expect to: Learn Toptal’s model and platform architecture, and meet the leaders you will depend on across Engineering, Product, Industries, and Services. Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO. In the first month, expect to: Assess the engineering function honestly, and assess AI maturity with it: what is really in production, what is measured, what is duplicated, and what should be shut down. Assess the team against the bar this role requires, and bring the executive team a strategy no one asked you for. In the first three months, expect to: Be executing your own plan, with a review cadence and clear accountability at every level, and your resourcing plan presented. Stand up the shared AI architecture and evals, and put one agentic workflow into production with a baseline and a measured result. In the first six months, expect to: Show business impact from agents in production in at least two core workflows, with the evidence behind it. Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most. In the first year, expect to: Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering. Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan. Qualifications and Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred. 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale. Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up. Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work. Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence. Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers. Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for. You create strategy rather than administer it, and you win arguments on evidence rather than authority, including your view on what a team should look like in the age of AI. Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar. Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale. Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield. Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself. You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do. For Toptal Use Only: #canada #southamerica #europe #easterneurope #northerneurope

titulo: Software Engineering Manager - Container and Virtualisation Infrastructure
descricao: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Our mission is to build a next-generation private cloud infrastructure, combining KVM, Ceph, and SDN technologies to create a data center scale cloud that 'just works' and provides a mission-critical cloud for edge and core enterprise deployments. We're hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality microservice architectures and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux kernel, virtualisation, storage and networking. LXD components span the entire software stack from low-level kernel features to the upper level management API/CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system. As an engineering manager at Canonical you must have a solid technical background, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. The successful candidate will have experience leading successful, collaborative engineering teams, and demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems and deep knowledge of Linux. Location : This is a remote position available in EMEA and the Americas. What you will focus on Lead a team of remote engineers Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders Advocate and advance modern software development practices Participate in the engineering process through code and architectural review Engage with teams at Canonical, the open source community and partners Work from home with global travel for 4 to 6 weeks per year for internal and external events What we are looking for in you You understand modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8s You love developing and growing people and have a strong track record of doing it You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree You have strong written and verbal technical communication skills You have experience programming in C and/or Go. What we offer you We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Maternity and paternity leave Employee Assistance Programme Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

descricao: 🚆 Únete a DBCC y construye el futuro del transporte ferroviario en Uruguay. Actualmente buscamos incorporar un/a Jefe de ingeniería de Mantenimiento para sumarse a nuestro equipo y acompañar el crecimiento de nuestra organización.   Principales responsabilidades Liderar y desarrollar el equipo de Ingeniería, promoviendo una cultura de alto desempeño, seguridad, innovación y mejora continua.  Definir y ejecutar la estrategia de ingeniería alineada con los objetivos de negocio, operativos y de mantenimiento de DBCC.  Garantizar la disponibilidad, confiabilidad y mejora del desempeño técnico de locomotoras y vagones. Coordinar proyectos de ingeniería, modificaciones e iniciativas de optimización de planes de mantenimiento, asegurando el cumplimiento de plazos, costos y estándares de calidad. Gestionar riesgos técnicos y desarrollar planes de mitigación que aseguren la continuidad y seguridad de las operaciones.  Actuar como referente técnico frente a clientes, proveedores, autoridades y socios estratégicos, tanto a nivel local como internacional.  Impulsar la incorporación de nuevas tecnologías, metodologías y mejores prácticas internacionales aplicadas al entorno ferroviario. Gestionar presupuestos, recursos y planificación de las actividades de ingeniería, asegurando una utilización eficiente de los mismos. Promover la transferencia de conocimiento y el desarrollo de capacidades técnicas dentro de la organización. Lo que buscamos Título universitario en Ingeniería Mecánica, Industrial, Eléctrica, Electrónica, Ferroviaria o afines.  Experiencia mínima de 8 a 10 años en posiciones de ingeniería dentro de entornos industriales, ferroviarios, logísticos o infraestructura crítica. Al menos 5 de ellos en el mantenimiento de material rodante en el sector ferroviario. Experiencia demostrable liderando equipos multidisciplinarios y gestionando proyectos complejos. Conocimiento en gestión de activos, confiabilidad, mantenimiento, análisis de riesgos y mejora continua.  Capacidad para interactuar con múltiples partes interesadas y gestionar entornos técnicamente exigentes. Inglés medio, con capacidad para participar en reuniones técnicas y coordinar actividades en entornos internacionales. Fuerte orientación a resultados, liderazgo, toma de decisiones y resolución de problemas. Será especialmente valorada la experiencia previa con locomotoras diésel-eléctricas.  ¿Quiénes somos? Buscamos personas que no solo quieran desempeñar un puesto, sino formar parte de una organización que está contribuyendo al desarrollo de una de las operaciones ferroviarias más relevantes de Uruguay y de la región.

descricao: Company Description Founded in 1961, WWF works to help people and nature thrive. As a global conservation organization, WWF operates in more than 100 countries, partnering with communities, companies, and governments to protect wildlife, conserve vital habitats, and advance sustainable solutions. Grounded in science and driven by collaboration, WWF works to help nature by conserving biodiversity, supporting resilient communities, and addressing climate change. Nearly 1 million people in the United States and more than 5 million globally are WWF members. Job Description About This Role Every day, WWF's conservation teams across the globe rely on robust, secure cloud infrastructure to protect wildlife, engage communities, and drive climate action. As our Senior Cloud Engineer, you'll be the foundational force ensuring our technology systems enable this global impact by managing mission-critical infrastructure that directly supports conservation programs. In this position, you'll directly enable WWF-US and our network of Country Offices across South America, Central America, Africa, and Asia to operate seamlessly. Your work ensures that critical systems stay online so our teams can focus on what matters most: protecting nature at scale. What You'll Do Own Our Azure Infrastructure You'll be the architect behind WWF's Azure environment, spinning up subscriptions, provisioning resources, and building/deploying VMs (Windows, SQL, Red Hat, firewalls) from the ground up in both production and staging. Lock Down Security & Identity Configure Microsoft Entra tenants, manage SSO through Azure Enterprise Apps, and keep our RBAC and user groups clean and secure. You'll patch systems proactively and use PowerShell + Graph API to automate the boring stuff so the important stuff runs smoother. Be Our Safety Net Design backup strategies and disaster recovery playbooks that actually work when it matters. You're the reason we sleep at night knowing our systems can bounce back from anything. Keep Everything Connected Troubleshoot networking across VNETs, sites, and tenants. Firewalls, load balancers, DNS (Azure + Cloudflare), you speak the language fluently and fix problems before they become fires. Be the Go-To Expert When Azure, Entra ID, or M365 issues get complicated, you're who the team calls. You'll lead projects end-to-end and keep stakeholders, technical and non-technical alike, in the loop every step of the way. Show Up When It Counts Occasional after-hours or weekend work for critical outages or planned maintenance, because uptime matters, and so does the team that protects it. Qualifications Key Competencies Ability to Multitask. Demonstrates strong technical and operational agility, effectively navigating complex business and cloud environments to deliver tailored, high-quality support across WWF’s Azure and multi-cloud platforms. Solution-Oriented and Strategic Collaboration. Clear, influential communicator who leads projects end-to-end, ensuring alignment, transparency, and active engagement with stakeholders across technical and non-technical teams. Growth Mindset. Demonstrates a strong growth mindset, continually expanding expertise in evolving cloud, automation, and security technologies and applying new knowledge to strengthen WWF’s technical capabilities. Big Picture Thinking. Strategic acumen complemented by robust technical proficiency Collaborative. Proven ability to work effectively as part of a team Project Management. Strong organizational, documentation, and project management capabilities, including development of comprehensive project plans Skills And Abilities Degree in IT or related field AND minimum of 8 years of work experience (including at least 6 years of experience in IT) MUST HAVE Verbal and written fluency in English and Spanish Experience managing large-scale enterprise IT systems Extensive hands-on experience managing highly available and resilient Azure production systems. In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Azure services, cloud architecture, cloud networking, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and Windows and Linux servers Proficient in managing Windows domains and Active Directory Expertise in using PowerShell and Graph API for Azure management, workflow automation, and deployment orchestration Familiarity with provisioning and managing access for technologies such as Fabric, Power BI, and Azure Foundry Experience integrating Microsoft Copilot for M365, Copilot Studio, and Copilot Agents into enterprise Azure/M365 environments, including configuration and governance of data access controls Significant expertise in building, deploying, and managing virtual machines in Azure from inception History of applying structured thinking to diagnose complex cloud or hybrid system issues and develop scalable, sustainable solutions. Well-honed methodologies for diagnosing and troubleshooting technical issues. Broad enterprise scale expertise across infrastructure, Azure cloud architecture, identity and access management with Entra ID, and emerging AI‑ driven‑ automation technologies—enabling the evaluation and recommendation of modernization opportunities, security improvements, and strategic technology replacements. skills in configuring Microsoft Entra tenants and domains, including DNS and VNET setup. Committed to building and strengthening a culture of inclusion within and across teams. Identifies and aligns with WWF’s core values: COURAGE – We demonstrate courage through our actions, we work for change where it’s needed, and we inspire people and institutions to tackle the greatest threats to nature and the future of the planet, which is our home. INTEGRITY – We live the principles we call on others to meet. We act with integrity, accountability and transparency, and we rely on facts and science to guide us and to ensure that we learn and evolve. RESPECT – We honor the voices and knowledge of people and communities that we serve, and we work to secure their rights to a sustainable future. COLLABORATION – We deliver impact at the scale of the challenges we face through the power of collective action and innovation. Additional Information Please note: Candidates must be currently based and authorized to work in one of the following countries to be eligible for this position: Bolivia, Chile, Ecuador, Guatemala, Belize, Honduras, Mexico, Paraguay, Suriname, or Guyana. Remuneration: Salary and benefits for this position will be paid in local currency. Application instructions: Resumes and cover letters must be submitted in English to be considered for this position Please note: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the job's location. Position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. descricao: Who We Are Is What We Do. Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly. Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers. As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are. Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work. We have a position for a DevOps Engineer with passion for automation and next-gen infrastructure. We are constantly growing both in product and in customers, and you’ll have a leading role getting us there! Responsibilities Work with the latest AWS technologies like Kubernetes (EKS), S3, Postgres, DocumentDB, and more. Manage our AWS production deployments (SaaS) running on AWS EKS. Design and develop tools for managing and applying DevOps principles, such as CI/CD automation and IaC (Infrastructure as Code) on our Cloud-based production systems. Work with the team to enhance production stability, availability, and reliability. Install, configure, update and troubleshoot our product microservices and tools including databases Design and manage different monitoring and observability tools for troubleshooting and resolving production issues. Required Skills And Experience 5+ years of relevant DevOps work experience in Production environments Strong working experience with Docker and Kubernetes Experience with CI/CD tools (Drone, Jenkins, GitHub actions or similar) Strong IT background. A deep understanding and familiarity with: Networking: K8S ingress, services, and Load Balancers AWS services, EKS, Postgres, S3, Mongo, SES, SNS, SQS. Experience in automated deployment and infrastructure. Knowledge and experience with alerting and monitoring tools. Additional programming languages like NodeJS - An advantage Results-driven with strong commitment to complete tasks Total Rewards Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all. Our salary range reflects gross base salary. For commercial roles with commission eligibility, this figure represents On-Target Earnings (OTE), inclusive of base salary and target commission. Salary ranges are quoted in USD as a consistent global reference. Your offer will be localized to your country's currency using a market-aligned conversion. Final pay is based on objective, job-related criteria including experience, skills, and location. We don't ask about salary history. Offers are based on the role and what you bring to it. Some things you'll enjoy Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country Optional flexible working office membership, with IWG At Deel, we're an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy or maternity or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Unless otherwise agreed, we will communicate with job applicants using Deel-specific emails, which include @ deel.com and other acquired company emails like @ payspace.com and @ paygroup.com . You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page . Deel welcomes persons with disabilities to apply to any of our open roles. We will provide application and/or interview accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities or other needs. If you require application and/or interview accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via email (recruiting@deel.com) and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation. As part of our hiring process, we primarily rely on interviews and role-related assessments. In limited cases, we may also consider informal background information relevant to the role, in line with our privacy and fairness obligations. This application process may utilise Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT) and AI systems to assist in evaluating candidates based on experience level, technical skills and qualifications. This processing is conducted in compliance with applicable Data Protection, AI Governance and Labour Laws. We ensure human oversight is maintained in all final hiring decisions. Your personal data is not used to train AI models. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Recruitment Privacy Policy. You will help continuously modernize our tech stack, elevating our software engineering discipline across our data pipelines (DataOps/CI-CD), optimizing compute performance and costs, driving MLOps workflows, and reinforcing data quality and security standards. Crucially, you will drive our AI-readiness initiatives—architecting the semantic layers, data structures, and access patterns needed to make our data seamless and reliable for AI agents and automated workflows. Data Engineering Competency: Lead the end-to-end design and execution of data pipelines—owning ingestion, API integrations, custom connectors, ELT/ETL processes, and pipeline orchestration. DataOps & CI/CD Integration: Build upon our existing Git, CI/CD, and Jira workflows by embedding specialized data discipline—such as automated dbt testing on pull requests, environment isolation, automated credential management, and data deployment standards. Governance & Observability Strategy: Build upon and refine the initial foundations of our governance model. Evaluate, select, and implement scalable Data Catalog and Data Observability solutions to track data lineage, ensure freshness, monitor completeness, and automate failure alerting. Platform Efficiency & Cost Control: Continuously tune Snowflake query performance, clustering, and warehouse sizing to optimize execution times and compute spend. Technical Mentorship & Agile Leadership: Raise the technical effectiveness of Analytical Engineers within our Agile planning framework through architectural guidance, design reviews, and constructive challenge. Stack Modernization & Architecture Evolution: Continuously evaluate new tools, frameworks, and architecture patterns to modernize, optimize, and add flexibility to our data stack. AI & Agent Readiness: Exposure to preparing data structures, semantic models, feature stores, and API/access layers for AI agents, machine learning pipelines, and automated LLM workflows. Snowflake & dbt Mastery: Deep hands-on expertise administering, tuning, and modeling in Snowflake, alongside advanced mastery of dbt (macros, incremental models, custom tests, packages, and dbt-native CI/CD testing). Advanced SQL & Python Skills: Expert analytical SQL skills (query execution plan tuning, window functions, CTEs) and strong Python proficiency for data pipelines, scripting, and MLOps workflows. Orchestration & Tool Evaluation: Practical experience with ingestion and orchestration engines (e.g., Matillion, Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, Fivetran), with a strong ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs, performance, and costs when selecting or migrating platforms. DataOps & Software Engineering Discipline: Experience operating with active Git and CI/CD pipelines, with a track record of extending these systems to include automated data testing, deployment validation, and secure credential rotation. Critical Thinking & Problem Decomposition: Tendency to question assumptions, gather full business context, form hypotheses, and rigorously evaluate outputs (especially for AI/ML outputs) before jumping to technical solutions. Pragmatic Experimentation: Passion for building lightweight MVPs and Proofs of Concept (POCs) to evaluate new technologies, test architectural hypotheses, and modernize the data stack. Communication & Technical Influence: Business-level English fluency with the ability to articulate complex technical trade-offs clearly, mentor teammates, and collaborate effectively in a remote, globally distributed team. descricao: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce. We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Position Description: As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineering team—it’s core to it. You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turn technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down. You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence. You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing them off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency. Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards. You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal. This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the details. This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction. AI and agentic engineering Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against. Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for. Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed. Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you. Team, resourcing, and accountability Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product. Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments. Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows. Platform and execution Own the architecture end-to-end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows. Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend. In the first week, expect to: Learn Toptal’s model and platform architecture, and meet the leaders you will depend on across Engineering, Product, Industries, and Services. Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO. In the first month, expect to: Assess the engineering function honestly, and assess AI maturity with it: what is really in production, what is measured, what is duplicated, and what should be shut down. Assess the team against the bar this role requires, and bring the executive team a strategy no one asked you for. In the first three months, expect to: Be executing your own plan, with a review cadence and clear accountability at every level, and your resourcing plan presented. Stand up the shared AI architecture and evals, and put one agentic workflow into production with a baseline and a measured result. In the first six months, expect to: Show business impact from agents in production in at least two core workflows, with the evidence behind it. Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most. In the first year, expect to: Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering. Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan. Qualifications and Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred. 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale. Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up. Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work. Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence. Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers. Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for. Supporting management in the financial decision making process. Reviewing budget proposals from other functions for technical errors or issues. Providing analysis, detail, and explanations on the status of the company's accounts. ✅ What You'll Need A bachelor's degree in business administration with an emphasis on accounting and finance. descricao: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce. We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Job Summary: Toptal prides itself on being a data-driven organization. The primary objective of the Data Analytics Engineer is to help drive business impact and better decision making by laying the data foundation for a world-class analytics function. This role will be critical to fostering trust in our data and confidence in our decisions. Our Data Analytics Engineers focus on creating a data environment that is conducive to analytics and business decision making. You will own and maintain the data transformation layer. This will require data governance (quality, accuracy, coverage, security), data modeling (structure, relationships, integrity), technical communication (data dictionaries, user training), quality control (code reviews, data validation), raw data analysis, and building AI data systems and pipelines. You will be the product owner for our data warehouse and will coordinate closely with our functional Business Analysts on one side, and Data Engineers on the other. This role sits within the Business Analytics Center of Excellence and will ensure trustworthy data is available for all downstream data users. Positive relationships with both Data Engineers and Business Analysts will be key, but you must also think independently and bring your own point of view. To be successful in this role you must live and breathe SQL daily and be a critical thinker, problem solver and self-starter. This role requires an AI-heavy workflow and skillset. We’ve transformed our codebase to be instrumented for agentic development and continue to build our internal AI tooling, and you will be part of this process. Fluency with using LLMs and agentic coding tools is a requirement of this role. The flip side of that is the part machines cannot do: understanding our business and metrics deeply, and making decisions on what matters and what doesn’t in terms of pushing the company’s business objectives forward. This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. Design, write, review and ship SQL models across our repositories that transform raw data into usable data products for all organizational stakeholders. Own and maintain the transformation layer. Proactively work with the Data Engineers to ensure new data sources are added and available, and then modeled and published in our data warehouse. Proactively monitor the data warehouse and extract insights to identify opportunities to improve data operations, data accuracy and quality, coverage, integrity, structure, and general usability. Turn ambiguous business asks into modeled data. Run requirements gathering with stakeholders. Establish the grain, surface the edge cases, write down the business rules, and push back when the request would produce a misleading number. Implement measures and processes to improve data quality, accuracy, coverage, lineage, access and retention across dozens of source production databases. Own the data dictionary. Write table and column documentation that traces each field to its true origin. This documentation is consumed by AI agents as well as humans, and is an integral part of the semantic layer. Diagnose and resolve data incidents. Review your teammates’ code and provide feedback to maintain the hygiene of the data warehouse production environment. Work closely with Business Analysts, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and business process owners to empower data-driven decision making. Enable end users to better use data, understand complexities, nuances, and limitations. Help make the team faster. Improve the agent playbooks, documentation, and tooling the team uses to work with the warehouse. In the first week, expect to: Onboard and integrate into Toptal, and begin learning our history, culture and vision. Get your environment running end to end: GCP access, BigQuery, the Dataform repositories, and our agentic development tooling. Shadow the teams whose data you will own to learn the core of Toptal’s operations and capabilities, including Growth, Talent Operations, Enterprise, and SMB. In the first month, expect to: Understand the data generated through company operations and activities and where/how that data is stored. Understand our ETL processes, timing, tools, monitoring, roadmap, and pain points. Understand our source systems, and where they fit into our business processes. Start receiving and researching inbound data questions from Business Analysts. Build your first Dataform pull request independently and start reviewing your teammates’ PRs. In the first three months, expect to: Develop a mastery of our core data elements and entities. Begin standardizing definitions and creating SQL logic to push definitions into the data layer. Be a first responder for data incidents, diagnosing root cause with evidence and a methodical approach. Begin documenting data flows, definitions, calculation methodologies, and data elements to continuously build and improve the semantic layer. In the first six months, expect to: Contribute architectural ideas that impact our data environment and pipelines. Exercise discretion and independent judgment. Be an integral part of the analytics team that ensures a world-class data warehouse service to our stakeholders. In the first year, expect to: Play a critical part in setting up the Business Analytics Center of Excellence for success. Be the person the organization trusts about what a number means and whether it can be believed. Have made the warehouse meaningfully more usable by both analysts and AI agents. Qualifications and Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree is required, preferably in Engineering or a related technical field. 4+ years of experience in an Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, or Data Analyst role where you personally shipped production data models. Expert-level SQL skills and a working knowledge of Python. Fluency with LLMs and agentic coding tools. You already use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent as part of your daily working practice. You know where they are reliable, where they should not be used, and how to verify their output. Experience with cloud data warehousing, such as BigQuery or Snowflake. Good understanding of a modern transformation framework (dbt, Dataform, SQLMesh or similar). You understand dependency graphs, refs, incremental strategies, tests and environment promotion as concepts, not just as commands. Git fluency. Branching, pull requests, code review, conflict resolution and generally working with a critical production environment. Strong familiarity with orchestration tools such as Airflow, Cloud Composer, Dagster or Prefect. You can read a DAG, understand its schedule and dependencies, and find out why a task failed. Process discipline. Jira, ticket hygiene, and code review etiquette. It’s mandatory you understand how to avoid shipping unverified LLM-generated code. Experience in doing exploratory/raw data analysis, data modeling, and data governance (quality, accuracy, coverage, security, etc.). Experience translating business logic and objectives into SQL code and linking data and analytics to business strategy and operations to drive real impact. Familiarity with BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.). Detail oriented, methodical, and thorough. Team player who builds strong relationships and collaborates with others. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex issues in a simple and intuitive way. Ability to work collaboratively and independently; take ownership of quality, accuracy, and timeliness of deliverables. You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do. For Toptal Use Only: #northamerica #centralamerica #southamerica

descricao: About You You are an experienced Product Manager who enjoys transforming complex business needs into clear, actionable product solutions. You thrive in environments where business priorities and technical considerations must come together. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, facilitating conversations with diverse stakeholders, and making thoughtful decisions about priorities, scope, and product direction. You bring a strong sense of ownership, attention to detail, and curiosity, leveraging AI tools to improve how you research, analyze, document, and communicate product requirements. Senior-level experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or related roles, preferably with 5+ years of relevant experience. Proven experience making product-related decisions, managing priorities, evaluating scope, and balancing business needs with delivery considerations. Strong experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements, including business rules, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements. Experience managing product roadmaps, prioritizing requirements, and supporting product delivery throughout development and User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including facilitating discussions, managing expectations, negotiating scope changes, and aligning business and technical teams. Ability to identify gaps, clarify ambiguous requirements, anticipate edge cases, and assess the impact of changes on scope, dependencies, and priorities. Working knowledge of software development processes, system dependencies, and technical concepts to translate business needs into product requirements. Programming experience is not required. Practical experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or Gemini for research, requirements analysis, user story development, and product documentation. B2+ English proficiency. Nice to Have Experience working in software development companies, software factories, or nearshore environments across multiple clients, products, or industries. Experience with revenue forecasting, financial planning, sales forecasting, demand planning, budgeting, or similar business planning solutions. Experience in aviation, aeronautics, or Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) environments. Familiarity with prioritization frameworks such as MoSCoW or RICE. Experience conducting formal product discovery and creating PRDs or BRDs from scratch. Familiarity with business process mapping and visualization tools such as Miro, Lucidchart, FigJam, or Microsoft Whiteboard. Experience using design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Figma Make, or Claude Design to communicate product concepts and visualize workflows. Experience defining or managing AI-enabled product features, including AI augmentation, predictive capabilities, or machine learning applications. Experience managing products throughout the full lifecycle, from discovery and development through production and continuous improvement. You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand business objectives, workflows, requirements, and expected outcomes. Translate business needs into clear, actionable product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation. Evaluate product requirements and priorities based on business value, stakeholder needs, dependencies, scope, and delivery considerations. Proactively identify missing information, ambiguous requirements, conflicting expectations, business rules, and edge cases before development begins. Maintain accurate and traceable product documentation, including requirements, meeting notes, approved decisions, and scope changes. Facilitate discussions between business stakeholders and technical teams to clarify expectations, resolve questions, and reach agreement on product requirements. Assess change requests, communicate their impact on scope, priorities, dependencies, and delivery expectations, and document agreed decisions. Collaborate with Developers, QA Engineers, and technical stakeholders to clarify expected behavior, investigate blockers, and ensure solutions align with approved requirements. Support product roadmap planning and ongoing prioritization to enable informed decisions about product evolution and delivery. Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by validating business scenarios, reviewing reported defects, clarifying expected behavior, and determining whether issues fall within the agreed scope. Leverage AI tools to improve research, analyze information, refine requirements, develop user stories, and enhance product documentation while validating outputs for accuracy and relevance. Follow up on open questions, pending decisions, dependencies, and action items to maintain stakeholder alignment and support timely delivery. Qualifications Senior-level Product Management or Product Ownership experience, preferably 5+ years. Strong Business Requirements Analysis, user stories, acceptance criteria, and product documentation. Proven experience with product prioritization, scope management, and stakeholder alignment. Experience collaborating with Software Development and QA teams throughout delivery and UAT. Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools. Practical use of AI tools in Product Management workflows. B2+ English proficiency. Additional Information About Us We Are Engineered Different. descricao: About the Role We’re looking for a Snowflake Solution Architect to join a small, agile, and highly technical team responsible for defining, building, and owning our client next-generation data platform. This role is a mix of hands-on architecture, technical leadership, and strategic direction—perfect for someone who wants to shape the foundation, standards, and roadmap of a modern data ecosystem. You will lead the design and implementation of Snowflake-based solutions, influence platform direction, and work closely with stakeholders across engineering, analytics, data science and product to ensure our client data platform enables scale, reliability, and innovation. What You’ll Do Architect end-to-end data solutions leveraging Snowflake, including data modeling, ingestion, transformation, security, and performance optimization. Define the data platform roadmap, standards, and best practices as part of a lean, high-ownership team. Partner with data engineers, analytics engineers, data scientists and business groups to convert requirements into scalable Snowflake solutions. Lead design sessions, perform technical reviews, and guide decisions related to warehousing, pipelines, orchestration, and governance. Evaluate and integrate relevant tools (e.g., dbt, Airflow, Fivetran, Matillion, Azure/AWS services). Implement strong data security, privacy, and access management controls within Snowflake. Troubleshoot and optimize warehouse performance, cost efficiency, and query execution. Mentor teammates and contribute to a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement. Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in data architecture and data engineering, with at least 3 years hands-on in Snowflake. Deep expertise in Snowflake features (Warehouses, Streams/Tasks, Time Travel, RBAC, Clustering, Stages etc.). Strong SQL skills and familiarity with Python. Experience with Azure cloud platform and modern ELT tooling. Strong understanding of data modeling (star, vault, wide tables), CI/CD for data, and scalable architecture patterns. C1 - C2 English level: able to lead technical discussions, write clear documentation, and work directly with US-based stakeholders. Nice to Have Experience with healthcare data and standards like HL7 and FHIR. Experience with dbt for transformations. Background in building event-driven or real-time data pipelines. Prior experience designing greenfield data platforms.
