titulo: Forward Deployed Engineer (Python + AI) - Remote - Latin America
descricao: About FullStack FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence. We’re Most Proud Of Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas. Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies. Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users. Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor. Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average. The Position Forward Deployed Engineers sit inside the client’s problem, not next to it. You embed with an enterprise team, find the work that actually warrants AI, architect the system, build it, and stay long enough to make it survive contact with production. This is a three-way role: consultant, operator, engineer. You should be as comfortable pressure-testing a business case with a COO or VP of Engineering as you are diagnosing why retrieval quality collapsed after a data refresh. The people who succeed here can hold a discovery conversation on Monday and ship what they scoped on Thursday. On this track, your edge is data, retrieval, and model behavior: you make agents trustworthy by getting the data, context, and evaluation right. We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don’t hold up. How We Approach The Work FDEs are trusted to shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for architect-level judgment: Reframes the request. Treats “we need an agent for X” as a hypothesis, not a spec. Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints — before choosing technology. Chooses the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent — and defends why. Owns the architecture decision. Documents trade-offs (ADRs), sets success metrics, pushes back on scope that won’t deliver value. Consultative Discovery Clients rarely arrive with a fully formed problem, and the FDE’s first contribution is helping them see it clearly. You lead discovery with genuine curiosity, moving the conversation from stated requirements to underlying needs, and you build credibility through the depth of your understanding rather than the breadth of your pitch. Uncovers business drivers. What outcome matters, what it’s worth, why now, and what happens if nothing changes. Uncovers personal drivers. What each stakeholder is measured on, what they’re worried about, and what a win looks like for them individually. Surfaces constraints early. Security, compliance, data access, budget, skills, politics, timelines — the things that kill projects in month two. Aligns stakeholders. Spots conflicting goals between business, engineering, and risk, and brings them to a shared definition of success. Asks strategic questions. Follows the answer with “why,” “how do you know,” and “what happens today when…” — without interrogating. Clients leave the conversation understanding their own problem better. Earns authority through depth. Credibility comes from the quality of the questions and the insight in the playback, not from pitching technology. What You'll Do Discover. Run workshops and process discovery with business, data, and engineering stakeholders. Assess data readiness honestly. Separate genuine AI problems from workflow problems wearing an AI costume. Structure the process and the spec. For any business process being automated, map the current state, decision points, data inputs, and exceptions, then turn it into specifications that both people and AI systems can execute against reliably. Architect & design. Design agentic systems end to end with emphasis on context and retrieval architecture — data sourcing, chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, permissions-aware retrieval, knowledge graphs where warranted — plus orchestration, MCP/tool integration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. Build. Ship working systems — agents, retrieval services, evaluation tooling, and the data flows that feed them. Prototypes that prove value in weeks, not slideware. Engineer the delivery system. Own CI/CD for what you build, extended to AI: prompt and context versioning, eval suites that run in the pipeline and gate releases. Operate (Day 2). Own what happens after launch — eval harnesses, groundedness and retrieval metrics, observability and tracing, cost and latency management, drift, and the handoff that lets the client’s team run it without you. Consult. Present to and defend decisions in front of CTOs, VPs of Engineering, CDOs, and business leadership. Quantify impact in their terms. Support pre-sales scoping and proposal work when the deal calls for it. What We're Looking For 5+ years of professional software development experience with core proficiency in Python (or TypeScript/Node.js). Has shipped at least one agentic AI solution, LLM workflow, or RAG architecture to a production environment. Advanced English is required. Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required. Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI developer tools (such as Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or OpenAI Codex) in daily workflows. Track record of leading client-facing discovery calls to translate unstructured business requirements into technical architectures. Hands-on experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs, microservices, or event-driven architectures. Experience building agentic systems using orchestration frameworks or APIs such as LangGraph, LangChain, n8n, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or direct LLM APIs. Proven experience taking full end-to-end technical ownership of features from discovery to deployment. Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed. Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications. Forensic attention to detail. A positive mindset and a can-do attitude. Experience working on Agile / Scrum teams. Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems. Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon. Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them. Strong Plus Production AI operations (Day 2): eval harnesses, observability and tracing, cost and token economics, drift, debugging non-deterministic systems. Prompt- and eval-level regression testing running in CI and gating releases. Delivery in regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing). Pre-sales support: discovery calls, SOW and estimate shaping, technical proposal defense. Process mining, operations analysis, or transformation consulting background. Client enablement and training — building the client team’s capability, not just the system. Prior consulting or agency environment; comfort with ambiguity and multiple accounts. Work Authorization Requirements Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis. FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future. What We Offer Competitive pay. 100% remote work. The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies. Continuing education opportunities. Opportunity to grow and expand your career. Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration. Learn more about our Applicants Privacy Notice.

descricao: Sobre Jelou En Jelou construimos agentes de IA que ayudan a las empresas a automatizar operaciones, mejorar la experiencia de sus clientes y generar resultados de negocio medibles. Nuestra plataforma permite crear, implementar y escalar agentes de IA conversacionales, conectando tecnología, operaciones y revenue. “Say Jelou to the future” no es solo un eslogan: es nuestra forma de unir tecnología con impacto real. Buscamos personas que quieran convertir problemas complejos de negocio en soluciones de IA que generen resultados concretos. El Rol Como AI Solutions Engineer , serás responsable de diseñar, construir e implementar soluciones basadas en inteligencia artificial que resuelvan problemas reales de negocio para nuestros clientes. Tu misión será traducir las necesidades de clientes y partners en agentes de IA conversacionales, integraciones y automatizaciones robustas, escalables y medibles. Trabajarás de manera transversal con Ventas, Customer Success, Producto, Ingeniería y Operaciones , asegurando que cada solución entregue una experiencia de alta calidad y genere impacto tangible. ¿Qué harás? Diseñar y desarrollar agentes de IA conversacionales para automatizar procesos de atención, operación y revenue. Entender los objetivos de negocio, flujos operativos y requerimientos técnicos de cada cliente para proponer soluciones efectivas. Configurar prompts, flujos conversacionales, herramientas, reglas de negocio y bases de conocimiento para optimizar el desempeño de los agentes. Construir integraciones con APIs, CRMs, ERPs, sistemas internos y otras plataformas necesarias para habilitar los casos de uso. Participar en sesiones de discovery técnico y colaborar con equipos comerciales y de Customer Success durante el ciclo de implementación. Prototipar, probar y desplegar soluciones de IA, asegurando su calidad, confiabilidad y escalabilidad. Monitorear el desempeño de los agentes después de su implementación e identificar oportunidades de optimización. Documentar arquitecturas, integraciones, configuraciones y aprendizajes para facilitar la operación y reutilización de las soluciones. Recoger feedback de clientes y usuarios para mejorar continuamente los agentes y la plataforma. Responsabilidades clave Ser owner técnico de la implementación de soluciones de IA para las cuentas asignadas. Convertir requerimientos de negocio en arquitecturas, flujos conversacionales y especificaciones técnicas claras. Asegurar que las soluciones cumplan con los estándares de calidad, seguridad, rendimiento y mantenibilidad. Resolver problemas técnicos durante las etapas de discovery, desarrollo, pruebas y producción. Colaborar con Producto e Ingeniería para comunicar necesidades recurrentes y oportunidades de mejora de la plataforma. Definir y monitorear métricas de desempeño, como tasa de resolución, precisión, contención, conversión y satisfacción del usuario. Contribuir a la creación de patrones, componentes y buenas prácticas que permitan escalar las implementaciones. Comunicar de forma clara el avance, los riesgos y los resultados técnicos a equipos internos y clientes. Buscamos a alguien con 2+ años de experiencia en Software Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Technical Consulting, Implementation Engineering o roles similares . Experiencia construyendo e implementando soluciones tecnológicas para clientes o usuarios finales. Conocimientos sólidos de programación en lenguajes como Python, JavaScript o TypeScript . Experiencia trabajando con APIs REST, webhooks, autenticación e integraciones entre sistemas. Capacidad para entender procesos de negocio y traducirlos en soluciones técnicas simples, escalables y accionables. Experiencia con bases de datos, estructuras de datos y herramientas de debugging. Orientación a resultados, autonomía y mentalidad de owner. Excelente comunicación y capacidad para colaborar con interlocutores técnicos y de negocio. Inglés avanzado, escrito y conversacional. Suma puntos si tienes Experiencia trabajando con inteligencia artificial generativa, LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG o agentes conversacionales . Conocimiento de frameworks y herramientas para construir aplicaciones basadas en IA. Experiencia con plataformas de automatización, chatbots, contact centers o soluciones omnicanal. Conocimiento de servicios cloud, contenedores, CI/CD y monitoreo de aplicaciones. Experiencia integrando CRMs, ERPs, sistemas de pagos o plataformas empresariales. Experiencia en B2B SaaS, fintech, retail, banca, telecomunicaciones, salud o tecnología. Experiencia en ambientes de alto crecimiento o startups. Impacto esperado Implementar soluciones de IA que resuelvan problemas concretos y generen resultados medibles para nuestros clientes. Acelerar el tiempo desde el discovery hasta la puesta en producción de nuevos agentes y automatizaciones. Mejorar continuamente la calidad, precisión y eficiencia de las conversaciones automatizadas. Construir integraciones y componentes reutilizables que permitan escalar las implementaciones. Fortalecer la colaboración entre clientes, equipos comerciales, Producto, Ingeniería y Operaciones. Convertir aprendizajes de cada implementación en mejores prácticas para toda la organización. ¿Te interesa? Postúlate y cuéntanos por qué este rol es para ti. Queremos conocer un ejemplo concreto en el que hayas diseñado o implementado una solución tecnológica, resuelto un desafío de integración o utilizado inteligencia artificial para mejorar un proceso de negocio.

descricao: About MAVI MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies. Founded in 2023 and backed by a $4 million seed round led by Harlem Capital, MAVI was recently featured in TechCrunch. Our professionals join in-house finance teams in full-time, long-term roles, not short-term projects. The companies we work with range from venture- and PE-backed businesses to public companies and CFO advisory firms, including Athena Club, MotherDuck, and Within. The work centers on judgment. As AI takes over more transactional accounting, the people who review the output, question it, and own the result matter more than ever. MAVI professionals work alongside US finance leaders, using AI tools to do more and applying the judgment to catch what those tools get wrong. At one client, an AR dashboard now used across the organization was built almost entirely by MAVI talent. We stay involved throughout, from role alignment and interview preparation to onboarding and long-term career development. The Role We are seeking a Senior Finance Manager to own the close and core financial reporting of a high-growth US consumer brand selling across ecommerce and marketplace channels, and to turn its numbers into planning and decisions, working remotely from Ecuador. Accounting is the core of the role: you will own the close and the financial statements behind it. On top of that foundation, you will build the budget, forecast, and management reporting the business runs on, working directly with the Controller, CFO, or founders. What You'll Own Accounting and the Close The close. Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, including the calendar and quality of output. Financial statements. Prepare the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP, and explain the movements behind them. Controls and audit. Maintain close checklists and approval workflows, and prepare PBC schedules for the annual audit or review. Planning and Analysis Budget and forecast. Build and maintain the budget and a rolling forecast, tied directly to the actuals you close. Management reporting. Deliver a monthly package with budget-versus-actual analysis, KPIs, and clear commentary. Cash and partnership. Maintain the cash forecast and help department heads understand their spend and hiring plans. CPG and Ecommerce Sales and payouts. Reconcile sales and payouts from Shopify, Amazon, Walmart Marketplace, and other storefronts to the general ledger, using tools such as A2X. Inventory. Maintain inventory roll-forwards and reconcile inventory systems (such as Cin7, Finale Inventory, or Fishbowl) and 3PL reports to the general ledger. Margin analysis. Build gross margin analysis by channel and SKU to inform pricing, promotions, and forecasts. What We're Looking For 5+ years of accounting and finance experience, with accounting as the primary foundation Experience in accounting for CPG, ecommerce, or retail businesses, including multichannel sales reconciliation and inventory Hands-on ownership of the month-end close US GAAP or IFRS experience, with substantial exposure to clients or entities in the US, UK, Canada, or Australia Experience building budgets, forecasts, or budget-versus-actual reporting Strong financial modeling skills in Excel or Google Sheets Experience with a major ERP or accounting system, such as NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks Online, or Xero Strong written and spoken English for daily work with US teams Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or an equivalent professional qualification Preferred CPA, Contador Público, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent preferred Experience using AI tools in accounting workflows, with the judgment to review and correct AI-generated output Experience supporting an audit or review Experience with planning tools such as Adaptive, Pigment, or Mosaic Experience with DTC, wholesale, or retail channel planning Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed company Who This Role Is For An accounting professional who has built a strong close and now wants to use those numbers to shape decisions, and who won't settle for a forecast that doesn't tie back to the books. Why Join Through MAVI Own accounting and planning for a high-growth US consumer brand, working directly with finance leadership Combine accounting depth with FP&A experience, a profile that leads to senior finance roles Full-time, long-term placement, with MAVI handling cross-border contracts, compliance, and payroll USD-denominated compensation aligned with experience and scope Progress toward Accounting Manager, FP&A Manager, and Controller opportunities through MAVI Work Arrangement This is a fully remote role with a single client company for the duration of the engagement. Full-time roles require a minimum of 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time (ET); part-time roles require a minimum of 2 hours.

Confirm that all trades have been properly executed, matched, and settled in accordance with trade instructions. Track trade lifecycle events, including execution, settlement, and confirmation. Reconciliation & Control Perform daily and periodic reconciliation of investment portfolios between internal records and custodian bank statements. Identify, investigate, and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner, escalating issues where necessary. Maintain audit-ready documentation supporting all reconciliations and adjustments. Cash Flow & Treasury Coordination Ensure proper flow of client funds into and out of investment accounts, including subscriptions, redemptions, and transfers. Set up and monitor financial transfers between custodian accounts and business operating accounts. Coordinate with Finance and Operations teams to ensure accurate cash positioning and liquidity management. Broker & Custodian Interaction Serve as the operational point of contact with brokers, custodians, and external investment partners for trade execution and settlement queries. Coordinate confirmations, settlements, and operational issues with counterparties to ensure smooth transaction processing. Portfolio Records & Reporting Support Maintain accurate, complete, and up-to-date portfolio records, including transaction history, positions, and cash balances. Ensure proper documentation and record retention for all investment-related activities. Support the preparation of internal reports related to investment activity and portfolio status. Accounting & Financial Reporting Support Provide detailed transaction data and reconciliation support to the accounting team for journal entries and financial reporting. Assist in ensuring alignment between investment records and accounting systems. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs) Reconciliation Accuracy: Timely and accurate reconciliation of portfolios and cash balances. Trade Processing Efficiency: Timeliness and accuracy of trade execution and settlement monitoring. Break Resolution: Speed and effectiveness in identifying and resolving discrepancies. Cash Flow Accuracy: Proper execution and tracking of all fund movements. Data Integrity: Accuracy and completeness of portfolio records and documentation. Operational Compliance: Adherence to internal controls, procedures, and audit requirements. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. 2–5 years of experience in investment operations, middle office, fund administration, or custody-related roles. Strong understanding of trade lifecycle, settlement processes, and portfolio reconciliation. Experience working with custodian banks, brokers, or asset managers. Solid knowledge of cash management and financial controls. Advanced proficiency in Excel; familiarity with financial systems or portfolio management tools is a plus. Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple priorities. Good communication skills and ability to coordinate across internal teams and external counterparties. WORKING CONDITIONS The following job-related working conditions are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential function. WORK ENVIRONMENT The role primarily operates in an in-door, climate-controlled office setting working in close proximity to others. Noise level in the work environment is low to moderate. Light level provides adequate brightness for reading, computer work, and other tasks without causing glare or strain. PHYSICAL DEMANDS The job primarily involves sedentary work with prolonged periods sitting at a desk. While performing the duties of this job, employees may occasionally be expected to: exert up to 10 pounds of force and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. operate standard office equipment such as copiers, computers, telephones, printers, etc. TRAVEL Minimal to no travel required SAFETY HAZARD OF THE JOB Minimal Hazards including potential ergonomic risks from prolonged sitting or repetitive motions. descricao: Departamento: Arquitectura de Data e IA Ubicación: Quito Modalidad de trabajo: Híbrido ¿Quiénes somos? Banco Internacional incorpora continuamente prácticas que fomentan la armonía entre el trabajo y la vida personal de sus equipos, brindando oportunidades equitativas, así como un entorno de trabajo seguro y confortable. Durante más de 50 años, potencia las capacidades de sus colaboradores, a través de la capacitación, el fortalecimiento de roles, responsabilidades y la entrega de herramientas que permitan desarrollar sus habilidades de liderazgo y alto desempeño. Misión del cargo. Diseñar y estructurar arquitecturas de datos e inteligencia artificial que soporten casos de uso analíticos y avanzados, aplicando estándares, modelos y prácticas que aseguren calidad, escalabilidad y seguridad alineadas a la arquitectura definida por el gobierno de Arquitectura, para habilitar soluciones analíticas confiables y estratégicas que apoyen la toma de decisiones y los objetivos del negocio. Un día en la vida de… a. Diseñar, generar propuesta de lineamientos y modelos de referencia para las estructuras de datos en los proyectos del banco, estableciendo criterios y prácticas de diseño orientadas a rendimiento, escalabilidad y alta disponibilidad alineadas a la arquitectura definida, para asegurar plataformas de datos robustas, confiables y preparadas para soportar las necesidades actuales y futuras del negocio. b. Construir arquetipos y plantillas reutilizables para la integración de datos en los proyectos del banco, estableciendo modelos y patrones que guían a los equipos en la conexión de sistemas core con plataformas analíticas, para acelerar la implementación, reducir errores y asegurar integraciones consistentes, escalables y alineadas a la arquitectura de datos definida. c. Construir lineamientos y arquetipos para el despliegue de modelos de IA y Machine Learning, estableciendo prácticas de MLOps que aseguren su adopción, automatización y operación segura y eficiente en conjunto con los científicos de datos, para habilitar el uso productivo, confiable y escalable de modelos de IA alineados a los objetivos estratégicos del banco. d. Colaborar con las áreas de Seguridad y unidades de control en la definición y validación de mecanismos en la arquitectura de datos del banco, estableciendo e incorporando esquemas de protección, acceso y gestión de la información conforme a la LOPDP y a las políticas de ciberseguridad organizacionales, para asegurar el cumplimiento regulatorio, la protección de los datos y una arquitectura de datos segura y confiable para el negocio. e. Diseñar e implementar templates y lineamientos para la documentación técnica y los diagramas de arquitectura de datos e IA, estandarizando criterios de diseño, formatos y prácticas de documentación alineadas a la arquitectura definida, para controlar, validar y mantener actualizada la arquitectura de datos e inteligencia artificial del banco de forma consistente y gobernada. f. Analizar problemas complejos de rendimiento en bases de datos y flujos críticos, identificando causas raíz mediante evaluaciones técnicas y ajustes de arquitectura y configuración, para mejorar el desempeño, la estabilidad y la confiabilidad de las plataformas de datos que soportan los procesos críticos del banco. g. Evaluar y ejecutar pruebas de concepto (PoC) de nuevas tecnologías, analizando su viabilidad técnica, documentando resultados y comparando alternativas conforme a los estándares del banco, para respaldar la toma de decisiones informadas sobre adopción tecnológica y su alineación con la estrategia y arquitectura definida. h. Brindar una guía técnica y soporte a todas las unidades ágiles en la aplicación de los arquetipos y lineamientos del gobierno de Arquitectura, acompañando su implementación y aclarando criterios técnicos de estandarización, para asegurar soluciones de datos e inteligencia artificial coherentes, escalables y robustas alineadas a la estrategia tecnológica del banco. Lo que te hará destacar… 🎓 Formación académica: Profesional graduado - Tercer Nivel. Ingeniería en Sistemas, ing. Informática o carreras afines. Especialización: Diseño, desarrollo y administración de arquitecturas de datos (Big Data, Datawarehousing), integración de datos y bases de datos relacionales/NoSQL 💼 Experiencia: 2 - 3 años 📑 Conocimientos técnicos: Motores de bases de datos (SQL Server, Oracle - muy comunes en banca, PostgreSQL). Herramientas y ecosistemas de Big Data y Cloud (Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks, AWS Glue, etc.) Conceptos de MLOps y despliegue de modelos analíticos. Conocimiento práctico en técnicas de seguridad de datos (enmascaramiento, tokenización para cumplimiento LOPDP). f. Conocimientos propios para el puesto: Modelado de datos, ETL/ELT, Arquitecturas Streaming/Batch, MLOps (Intermedio) Seguridad de datos (Avanzado) g. Conocimientos en sistemas informáticos: Git/DevOps, herramientas de integración, modelado de diagramas. h. Idiomas: Inglés intermedio. Beneficios 🌟 Desarrollo profesional: Oportunidades de capacitación continua y crecimiento dentro de la organización. 🤝 Equilibrio vida-trabajo: Programas que promueven un balance saludable entre tus responsabilidades laborales y personales. 🥗 Alimentación: Acceso a opciones de alimentación saludable para cuidar de ti. ¡Te invitamos a ser parte de nuestro equipo! 🤩 #NoEsperesActua

descricao: 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲𝘀 𝗖𝗹𝗼𝘂𝗱𝗯𝗲𝗱𝘀 𝗨𝗻𝗶𝗾𝘂𝗲 At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started. 𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗔𝗻𝗮𝗹𝘆𝘁𝗶𝗰𝘀 & 𝗕𝗜 𝘁𝗲𝗮𝗺 We are a small, senior, fully remote team running analytics for the entire company on Snowflake, dbt, Matillion, and Sigma. We move fast and ship things people use daily. What we're missing is a senior technical voice to make the foundational calls — architecture, platform, governance, ML Ops — so that speed compounds instead of accumulating debt. That's this role, and it comes with unusual latitude to decide how the platform should work. 𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗬𝗼𝘂'𝗹𝗹 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲 𝗮𝗻 𝗜𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗰𝘁 As our 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗱 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿 & 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗔𝗿𝗰𝗵𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗰𝘁, you will shape the technical direction, architectural standards, and data governance of our core Data Analytics platform. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will act as our Data Architect—owning logical and physical data modeling, warehouse design, and layered curation (staging → intermediate → mart)—while serving as our Data Engineering Tech Lead. You will help continuously modernize our tech stack, elevating our software engineering discipline across our data pipelines (DataOps/CI-CD), optimizing compute performance and costs, driving MLOps workflows, and reinforcing data quality and security standards. Crucially, you will drive our AI-readiness initiatives—architecting the semantic layers, data structures, and access patterns needed to make our data seamless and reliable for AI agents and automated workflows. You will serve as the technical anchor for a talented team of Analytical Engineers, collaborating closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Data Science / ML and business stakeholders to ensure our data ecosystem is reliable, scalable, and business-ready. 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗕𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗼 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗧𝗲𝗮𝗺 Data Architecture & Modeling Ownership: Set and evolve our cloud data architecture on Snowflake. Own data model design across data products and marts, implementing flexible dimensional models (Star Schemas, SCDs, conformed dimensions) and documenting decisions through Architecture Decision Records (ADRs). Data Engineering Competency: Lead the end-to-end design and execution of data pipelines—owning ingestion, API integrations, custom connectors, ELT/ETL processes, and pipeline orchestration. DataOps & CI/CD Integration: Build upon our existing Git, CI/CD, and Jira workflows by embedding specialized data discipline—such as automated dbt testing on pull requests, environment isolation, automated credential management, and data deployment standards. Governance & Observability Strategy: Build upon and refine the initial foundations of our governance model. Evaluate, select, and implement scalable Data Catalog and Data Observability solutions to track data lineage, ensure freshness, monitor completeness, and automate failure alerting. Platform Efficiency & Cost Control: Continuously tune Snowflake query performance, clustering, and warehouse sizing to optimize execution times and compute spend. Technical Mentorship & Agile Leadership: Raise the technical effectiveness of Analytical Engineers within our Agile planning framework through architectural guidance, design reviews, and constructive challenge. Stack Modernization & Architecture Evolution: Continuously evaluate new tools, frameworks, and architecture patterns to modernize, optimize, and add flexibility to our data stack. 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗦𝗲𝘁𝘀 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗨𝗽 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗦𝘂𝗰𝗰𝗲𝘀𝘀 Senior Hands-On Experience: Proven track record as a Senior Data Engineer, Data Architect, or Tech Lead in cloud data environments. AI & Agent Readiness: Exposure to preparing data structures, semantic models, feature stores, and API/access layers for AI agents, machine learning pipelines, and automated LLM workflows. Snowflake & dbt Mastery: Deep hands-on expertise administering, tuning, and modeling in Snowflake, alongside advanced mastery of dbt (macros, incremental models, custom tests, packages, and dbt-native CI/CD testing). Advanced SQL & Python Skills: Expert analytical SQL skills (query execution plan tuning, window functions, CTEs) and strong Python proficiency for data pipelines, scripting, and MLOps workflows. Orchestration & Tool Evaluation: Practical experience with ingestion and orchestration engines (e.g., Matillion, Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, Fivetran), with a strong ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs, performance, and costs when selecting or migrating platforms. DataOps & Software Engineering Discipline: Experience operating with active Git and CI/CD pipelines, with a track record of extending these systems to include automated data testing, deployment validation, and secure credential rotation. Critical Thinking & Problem Decomposition: Tendency to question assumptions, gather full business context, form hypotheses, and rigorously evaluate outputs (especially for AI/ML outputs) before jumping to technical solutions. Pragmatic Experimentation: Passion for building lightweight MVPs and Proofs of Concept (POCs) to evaluate new technologies, test architectural hypotheses, and modernize the data stack. Communication & Technical Influence: Business-level English fluency with the ability to articulate complex technical trade-offs clearly, mentor teammates, and collaborate effectively in a remote, globally distributed team. 𝗕𝗼𝗻𝘂𝘀 𝗦𝗸𝗶𝗹𝗹𝘀 𝘁𝗼 𝗦𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗢𝘂𝘁 Exposure to applied AI tooling (Snowflake Cortex, AI Classify, RAG workflows, LLM agents, MCP servers). Familiarity with modern BI consumption tools like Sigma or workflow engines like n8n. 𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸 𝗔𝘂𝘁𝗵𝗼𝗿𝗶𝘇𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas. About The Role Camunda's Revenue Operations organization is looking for a Senior GTM Systems AI and Automation Engineer to design, build and operate the AI-powered infrastructure that connects our go-to-market systems and removes manual work across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships and Account Development. You will join the GTM Systems team – a small group of builders who own a Salesforce-centric revenue stack – and take ownership of its AI and automation layer: agents, LLM integrations, MCP servers, retrieval pipelines, backend services and workflow orchestration. Own the architecture of the GTM Systems AI layer: MCP servers, APIs, retrieval and context pipelines, reusable agent tools and skills, and serverless or containerized services on Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions). Ship production-grade LLM capabilities – prompt engineering, RAG, function calling, structured outputs, automated evaluations – with the guardrails to match: validation, fallback logic, confidence thresholds, human escalation paths, access controls, audit logging, and cost and latency management. Partner with Revenue Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships and SDR/ADR leaders to identify and prioritize automation opportunities, translate ambiguous requirements into maintainable solutions, and deliver incrementally with clear documentation. Raise the engineering bar for the GTM Systems team: code review, automated testing, CI/CD, security governance, observability and technical documentation; mentor teammates on responsible AI-assisted development. Design and deploy workflows on orchestration platforms such as Camunda and Clay, and create playbooks and enablement so GTM teams can use and operate automations independently. Hands-on command of LLM patterns – prompt engineering, RAG, function/tool calling, structured outputs, model evaluation – and of their failure modes and mitigations (validation, fallback logic, confidence thresholds, human review, cost and latency control). Experience integrating with Salesforce (REST/Bulk/Streaming APIs, data model, platform limits; Apex or Flow a plus) and other business systems via APIs and event-driven patterns, and with a cloud platform (GCP preferred: BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, IAM). Exposure to AI observability and evaluation tooling (LangSmith, Weights & Biases, or custom eval frameworks). Familiarity with orchestration platforms such as Camunda or Clay, and prior work in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, Sales Operations or Marketing Operations in B2B SaaS. titulo: Senior Cloud Security Engineer - Remote Work
descricao: At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley. Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide. When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success. Senior Cloud Security Engineer at BairesDev In this role, you'll design and maintain resilient AWS security architectures across multiple accounts, VPCs, clusters, and edge services, not just operate what someone else built. Tuning edge protection against real attack traffic and leading identity governance as a genuine initiative, you'll drive security decisions rather than execute tickets against them. This is your opportunity to work as an exceptional debugger and architect at once, tracing problems across network, infrastructure, and application boundaries while balancing security posture with system reliability. What You'll Do: - Design and maintain AWS security architecture across multiple accounts, VPCs, clusters, and edge services. - Configure and tune AWS edge protection including WAF, WebACLs, Shield, and CloudFront against DDoS, bot traffic, and credential stuffing. - Continuously assess and optimize network topology, routing, and load balancer configuration for both security and reliability. - Lead IAM and identity governance initiatives, including least privilege enforcement, role hygiene, and secrets management. - Participate in and guide cloud incident response, including log analysis, forensics, and remediation planning. - Troubleshoot and debug issues across network, infrastructure, and application boundaries. What we are looking for: - 7+ years of experience in cloud security engineering. - Strong expertise in AWS security architecture, including VPC networking, IAM, KMS, and secure workload design across multiple accounts and environments. - Proven, production-level experience tuning AWS edge protection including WAF, WebACLs, Shield, and CloudFront under real attack traffic. - Experience with network topology assessment and optimization, balancing security posture and system reliability. - Proven experience leading IAM and identity governance initiatives, including least privilege enforcement, federation patterns, and secrets management. - Hands-on experience with cloud incident response, including log analysis, forensics, and remediation planning. - Strong cross-layer troubleshooting and debugging skills across network, infrastructure, and application layers. - Advanced proficiency in English. Nice to have: - Experience with infrastructure scanning and IaC security review, including Terraform or CloudFormation policy review. - Familiarity with governance and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or NIST CSF. How we do make your work (and your life) easier: - 100% remote work (from anywhere). - Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred - Hardware and software setup for you to work from home. - Flexible hours: create your own schedule. - Paid parental leaves, vacations, and holidays. - Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent. - Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities. Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

descricao: 🚀 ¡Diners Club sigue evolucionando! descricao: Job Description Title: Cybersecurity Specialist Job Family/Level: Information Technology/Specialist Reports To: VP, Corporate Information Security PLEASE NOTE: Must be bilingual (Spanish & English) + submit Cover Letter and Resume in English Major Function The Cybersecurity Specialist is responsible for supporting cybersecurity initiatives, including monitoring, analyzing, and enhancing the security posture of WWF's information systems, endpoints, cloud services, and data environments. The role involves working closely with Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Compliance and Risk Management, and stakeholders to implement and maintain security policies, procedures, controls, and tools. A crucial part of the role is supporting and managing the Information Security Management System (ISMS), ensuring that security policies, procedures, controls, and supporting documentation are aligned with industry standards, organizational requirements, and best practices. The role also serves as a cybersecurity advisor to stakeholders by providing guidance on secure technology use, endpoint protection, security awareness, vulnerability management, and responsible use of data. Key Responsibilities Monitor and analyze security alerts, logs, and events across endpoints, cloud services, networks, applications, and enterprise platforms. Support incident investigations, root cause analysis, evidence review, remediation tracking, and post-incident lessons learned. Support in developing and revising documentation of security procedures, processes, standards, assessment results, incident response activities, and control implementation. Advise on the Information Security Management System (ISMS), ensuring policies, controls, procedures, and supporting documentation remain aligned with industry standards and best practices. Ensure compliance support for regulatory and framework requirements such as CIS, PCI, ISO, GDPR, and other applicable standards. Participate in internal and external security audits, assessments, control reviews, and maturity evaluations, and track remediation activities as needed. Serve as a cybersecurity advisor to country offices, business units, IT teams, and other stakeholders by providing practical guidance on security best practices, risk mitigation, secure technology use, and adherence to organizational policies. Collaborate with WWF offices and teams to identify security vulnerabilities, assess risks, and support implementation of appropriate security controls. Report on cybersecurity maturity, risk posture, control implementation, and alignment with applicable frameworks such as the CIS Critical Security Controls. Stay up to date on cybersecurity trends, emerging threats, attacker tactics, security technologies, industry trends, and regulatory developments. Coordinate and support security awareness training programs, campaigns, and communications that promote a culture of security and responsible use of data. Create or contribute to awareness materials such as presentations, guidance documents, newsletters, videos, online learning content, and staff communications. Collaborate with cross functional teams to ensure secure information systems. Support in evaluating and implementing new security tools, technologies, controls, and mitigations. Performs other duties as assigned. Key Competencies Inclusive Collaboration: Builds and strengthens a culture of inclusion within and across teams by valuing diverse perspectives, encouraging active participation, and collaborating effectively with technical and non-technical colleagues. Growth Mindset and Adaptability: Demonstrates a proven ability to learn and adapt quickly to new technologies and opportunities, applying evolving knowledge in cloud, automation, and security to strengthen WWF’s technical capabilities. Solution-Oriented Problem Solving: Demonstrates strong troubleshooting skills, taking a structured approach to identifying root causes, evaluating solutions, and resolving technical problems across and multi-cloud environments. Qualifications Skills and Abilities REQUIRED: 4+ years of experience in Cybersecurity or equivalent experience is required. (A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Information Technology HILGHY preferred) Bilingual: Strong verbal and written communication skills, in ENGLISH and SPANISH. Proven experience with cybersecurity technologies required. Familiarity with regulatory and compliance requirements such as PCI, CCPA, GDPR. Experience configuring, deploying and using multiple security solutions such as SIEM, SOAR, playbooks and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools. In depth knowledge of cloud services, third party risk management, and application security. Advanced understanding and proficiency with Windows and macOS operating systems. Strong organizational, documentation, project management skills including development of detailed project plans. PREFERRED: Additional security certifications. International travel is possible. Additional Information Identifies and aligns with WWF’s core values: COURAGE – We demonstrate courage through our actions, we work for change where it’s needed, and we inspire people and institutions to tackle the greatest threats to nature and the future of the planet, which is our home. INTEGRITY – We live by the principles we call on others to meet. We act with integrity, accountability, and transparency, and we rely on facts and science to guide us and to ensure that we learn and evolve. RESPECT – We honor the voices and knowledge of people and communities that we serve, and we work to secure their rights to a sustainable future. COLLABORATION – We deliver impact at the scale of the challenges we face through the power of collective action and innovation. Please note: Candidates must be currently based and authorized to work in one of the following countries to be eligible for this position: Bolivia, Chile, Ecuador, Guatemala, Belize, Honduras, Mexico, Paraguay, Suriname, or Guyana. Remuneration: Salary and benefits for this position will be paid in local currency. Application instructions: Resumes and cover letters must be submitted in English to be considered for this position Please note: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the job's location. Position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. World Wildlife Fund (WWF) promotes equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals regardless of age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

descricao: About You You are a Senior Azure DevOps & Platform Engineer with deep hands-on experience building secure Azure platforms and delivering infrastructure and applications through Terraform and CI/CD. You combine Azure Platform Engineering (landing zones, networking, identity, security, governance) with strong DevOps engineering. You thrive in environments where ownership, scalability, and continuous improvement are highly valued. You are adaptable, detail-oriented, and capable of providing technical leadership and operational guidance to support cloud transformation initiatives and enterprise DevOps practices. Note: This role operates under a contractor model and requires availability to work in the U.S. Central Time Zone (CT) . You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field is desired, or equivalent professional experience. 9+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps and cloud environments. Strong experience designing and implementing Azure tenant platforms aligned with Microsoft CAF (Cloud Adoption Framework) . Expertise building and maintaining Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform. Experience implementing Azure landing zones for application and workload migrations. Experience with Azure networking: hub-spoke topology, Azure Firewall, VPN Gateway/ExpressRoute, private endpoints with Private DNS Zones, NSGs, and route tables. Hands-on experience with Terraform state management, imports, drift detection and reconciliation, refactoring live infrastructure (e.g., moved blocks), and secret management with Azure Key Vault, including rotation. Strong automation and scripting skills using PowerShell, Python, or Bash. Knowledge of Azure identity and security: Managed Identities, workload identity federation (OIDC), least-privilege RBAC, and PIM. Hands-on experience with Azure compute services such as AKS, Container Apps, App Service, and Function Apps, including Key Vault integration and Azure Container Registry. Experience implementing Azure Policy (custom definitions, deny/modify effects, tag inheritance). Experience enforcing governance and policy compliance through management group inheritance. Ability to monitor cloud environments for performance, security, and cost optimization. Strong collaboration, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to provide technical guidance and support across cross-functional teams. Strong spoken English (B2+) to discuss technical scenarios live with US-based stakeholders. Experience in financial services or regulated environments is a plus. Nice to have: Azure Data Factory/Databricks, Azure messaging (Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hubs), Azure API Management, Bicep, and AI-assisted engineering tools. You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Design and implement Azure tenant platforms aligned with Microsoft CAF standards. Build, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform. Implement Azure landing zones to support application and workload migrations. Manage and optimize CI/CD pipelines, source control, and project workflows using Azure DevOps to support both infrastructure and application delivery into Azure, including environment approvals, security gates, and container image promotion across environments. Review peers’ pull requests and handle infrastructure requests from application teams in a Kanban workflow. Automate resource provisioning, scaling, and infrastructure management processes. Develop and maintain automation scripts using PowerShell, Python, or Bash. Implement and manage Azure security controls, including IAM configurations. Enforce governance and policy compliance across Azure environments. Monitor infrastructure environments to ensure performance, security, and cost efficiency. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver infrastructure solutions aligned with business requirements. Provide technical guidance, troubleshooting, and operational support to stakeholders. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives related to cloud governance, automation, and operational excellence. Qualifications: Strong experience with Azure Cloud Platform and Microsoft CAF . Hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) . Experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and automation scripting . Strong understanding of Azure networking, identity, and security architecture, combined with Terraform expertise (state, imports, secret management). Strong spoken English (B2+) for US-based stakeholders. About Us We Are Engineered Different. At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable. Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

descricao: WHO WE ARE Seagull Software is a global leader in label management and item-level tracking solutions, providing flexible, connected, and scalable solutions to help organizations label and locate the things their business depends on across today’s most complex supply chains. Through its flagship BarTender® platform, Seagull enables businesses to design, manage, automate, and scale the production of labels, 1D and 2D barcodes, and RFID tags that serve as the digital foundation for traceability, compliance, and operational execution. With a 40-year history of leading in our field, supporting more than 250,000 customers around the globe, BarTender® software provides the accuracy, control, and governance required to connect physical products with digital systems across manufacturing, logistics, retail, healthcare, and food supply chains. By unifying label management with item-level data capture and visibility, Seagull helps organizations transform operational efficiency, reduce compliance and regulatory risk, and realize smarter, more responsive operations. Headquartered in Redmond, Washington, with offices across the United States, Europe, Asia, and Latin America, Seagull Software serves customers worldwide -- empowering businesses worldwide to keep their products moving, traceable, and safe. You’ll work with global, talented, and diverse teams, passionate about what they do and their impact on everyone, everywhere. Join us and help shape the way the world works. For more information, visit https://www.seagullsoftware.com/ LOCATION This direct contract role is based in La Paz, Bolivia under a hybrid work arrangement, with the expectation of working from our La Paz office 4 days per week. JOB SUMMARY This is a direct contract role. As a Senior CloudOps Engineer , you will design, implement, and maintain scalable and robust infrastructure solutions in AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes environments. Your responsibilities will span across several key areas, including cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes orchestration, monitoring, and database management. The role includes a rotation on-call schedule to support the platform 24/7. WHAT YOU WILL DO Cloud Infrastructure Management: Architect, manage, and scale cloud infrastructure across Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Apply and improve best practices for high availability and fault-tolerant infrastructure. Design, deploy, and optimize cloud services, including: AWS: EKS, EC2, Elastic Load Balancing (ALB/NLB), VPC, IAM, Route 53, Auto Scaling, CloudWatch, and related services. GCP: GKE, Compute Engine, Cloud Load Balancing, VPC, IAM, Cloud DNS, and related services. Configure and manage DNS, load balancers, and secure user roles across cloud platforms. Collaborate with teams to optimize cloud environments for security, reliability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency. Kubernetes Orchestration & Management: Design, implement, and operate Kubernetes solutions for both stateless and stateful workloads across Amazon EKS and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE). Manage advanced Kubernetes networking configurations (e.g., Ingress Controllers, Virtual Services, Service Meshes). Automate Kubernetes deployments and manage environments using Helm, Terraform, or Ansible. Monitoring, Alerting, and Optimization: Implement and optimize advanced monitoring and alerting tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Open Telemetry. Develop business-level metrics and proactive alerts to ensure service health, availability, and performance. Improve the reliability, efficiency, and scalability of infrastructure through enhanced observability and SLOs. Database Management: Manage databases, including MongoDB, Redis, and MySQL, across cloud-native and on-premise environments. Set up, monitor, and scale databases while ensuring security and disaster recovery practices are followed. Security & Compliance: Implement secure infrastructure practices, including role-based access controls, encryption, and audits. Implement user federation and single sign-on (SSO) across multiple platforms using standards such as OAuth, SAML, and OIDC. Automation & CI/CD: Develop and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Terraform, Ansible, and Jenkins. Design and manage CI/CD pipelines that automate deployments across AWS and GCP environments. Standardize deployment processes and infrastructure automation to support multi-cloud operations. Networking Expertise: Design, implement, and maintain cloud networking solutions across AWS and GCP, including VPCs, Subnets, Target Groups, NAT Gateways, and Network ACLs. Apply software-defined networking expertise across Virtual Services, Ingress Controllers, and traffic management in microservices. AI-Driven DevOps & Automation: Integrate AI-driven tooling into DevOps workflows, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and AI agents that interface with infrastructure, CI/CD, and observability systems. Design and operate AI-assisted and automated deployment pipelines to accelerate release velocity while preserving reliability and safety controls. Apply AIOps practices, including anomaly detection, predictive alerting, and automated remediation, to strengthen incident response and platform resilience. Evaluate and adopt emerging generative AI tooling for infrastructure automation, runbook generation, and developer productivity. WHAT WE REQUIRE 5+ years of experience in a CloudOps, DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineer role. Strong hands-on experience in both AWS and GCP, including managing Kubernetes platforms (Amazon EKS and GKE), networking, IAM, compute, load balancing, and cloud-native services. Advanced knowledge of Kubernetes and containerized microservices architecture. Experience managing monitoring stacks like Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, with expertise in building actionable alerts and dashboards. Proven experience managing databases such as MongoDB, Redis, and MySQL in production environments. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Ansible, and cloud-native automation services across AWS and GCP environments. Familiarity with AI-driven DevOps practices, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, AI-assisted deployments, and AIOps tooling. Understanding of SSO and federation standards like OAuth, SAML, OIDC. Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across multiple teams. Proficiency in written and spoken English. Results oriented. Passion for working and learning in a fast-growing company. Ability to break down complex problems, strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to collaborate effectively in agile and cross-functional environments to achieve common goals. Proactive learning new technologies, industry trends, and adapting to evolving tools and methodologies. Preferred qualifications: Expertise with Terraform, Helm, and Kubernetes automation across EKS and GKE. Experience designing and operating production multi-cloud environments (AWS and GCP). Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio. Experience implementing cloud security, governance, disaster recovery, and cost optimization strategies. Hands-on experience integrating large language models (LLMs) or AI agents into CI/CD, observability, or automated remediation workflows. descricao: About FullStack FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence. We’re Most Proud Of Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas. Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies. Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users. Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor. Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average. The Position Forward Deployed Engineers sit inside the client’s problem, not next to it. You embed with an enterprise team, find the work that actually warrants AI, architect the system, build it, and stay long enough to make it survive contact with production. This is a three-way role: consultant, operator, engineer. You should be as comfortable pressure-testing a business case with a COO or VP of Engineering as you are diagnosing why retrieval quality collapsed after a data refresh. The people who succeed here can hold a discovery conversation on Monday and ship what they scoped on Thursday. On this track, your edge is data, retrieval, and model behavior: you make agents trustworthy by getting the data, context, and evaluation right. We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don’t hold up. How We Approach The Work FDEs are trusted to shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for architect-level judgment: Reframes the request. Treats “we need an agent for X” as a hypothesis, not a spec. Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints — before choosing technology. Chooses the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent — and defends why. Owns the architecture decision. Documents trade-offs (ADRs), sets success metrics, pushes back on scope that won’t deliver value. Consultative Discovery Clients rarely arrive with a fully formed problem, and the FDE’s first contribution is helping them see it clearly. You lead discovery with genuine curiosity, moving the conversation from stated requirements to underlying needs, and you build credibility through the depth of your understanding rather than the breadth of your pitch. Uncovers business drivers. What outcome matters, what it’s worth, why now, and what happens if nothing changes. Uncovers personal drivers. What each stakeholder is measured on, what they’re worried about, and what a win looks like for them individually. Surfaces constraints early. Security, compliance, data access, budget, skills, politics, timelines — the things that kill projects in month two. Aligns stakeholders. Spots conflicting goals between business, engineering, and risk, and brings them to a shared definition of success. Asks strategic questions. Follows the answer with “why,” “how do you know,” and “what happens today when…” — without interrogating. Clients leave the conversation understanding their own problem better. Earns authority through depth. Credibility comes from the quality of the questions and the insight in the playback, not from pitching technology. What You'll Do Discover. Run workshops and process discovery with business, data, and engineering stakeholders. Assess data readiness honestly. Separate genuine AI problems from workflow problems wearing an AI costume. Structure the process and the spec. For any business process being automated, map the current state, decision points, data inputs, and exceptions, then turn it into specifications that both people and AI systems can execute against reliably. Architect & design. Design agentic systems end to end with emphasis on context and retrieval architecture — data sourcing, chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, permissions-aware retrieval, knowledge graphs where warranted — plus orchestration, MCP/tool integration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. Build. Ship working systems — agents, retrieval services, evaluation tooling, and the data flows that feed them. Prototypes that prove value in weeks, not slideware. Engineer the delivery system. Own CI/CD for what you build, extended to AI: prompt and context versioning, eval suites that run in the pipeline and gate releases. Operate (Day 2). Own what happens after launch — eval harnesses, groundedness and retrieval metrics, observability and tracing, cost and latency management, drift, and the handoff that lets the client’s team run it without you. Consult. Present to and defend decisions in front of CTOs, VPs of Engineering, CDOs, and business leadership. Quantify impact in their terms. Support pre-sales scoping and proposal work when the deal calls for it. What We're Looking For 5+ years of professional software development experience with core proficiency in Python (or TypeScript/Node.js). Has shipped at least one agentic AI solution, LLM workflow, or RAG architecture to a production environment. Advanced English is required. Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required. Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI developer tools (such as Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or OpenAI Codex) in daily workflows. Track record of leading client-facing discovery calls to translate unstructured business requirements into technical architectures. Hands-on experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs, microservices, or event-driven architectures. Experience building agentic systems using orchestration frameworks or APIs such as LangGraph, LangChain, n8n, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or direct LLM APIs. Proven experience taking full end-to-end technical ownership of features from discovery to deployment. Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed. Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications. Forensic attention to detail. A positive mindset and a can-do attitude. Experience working on Agile / Scrum teams. Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems. Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon. Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them. Strong Plus Production AI operations (Day 2): eval harnesses, observability and tracing, cost and token economics, drift, debugging non-deterministic systems. Prompt- and eval-level regression testing running in CI and gating releases. Delivery in regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing). Pre-sales support: discovery calls, SOW and estimate shaping, technical proposal defense. Process mining, operations analysis, or transformation consulting background. Client enablement and training — building the client team’s capability, not just the system. Prior consulting or agency environment; comfort with ambiguity and multiple accounts. Work Authorization Requirements Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis. FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future. What We Offer Competitive pay. 100% remote work. The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies. Continuing education opportunities. Opportunity to grow and expand your career. Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration. Learn more about our Applicants Privacy Notice.

Uncovers business drivers. What outcome matters, what it’s worth, why now, and what happens if nothing changes. Uncovers personal drivers. What each stakeholder is measured on, what they’re worried about, and what a win looks like for them individually. Surfaces constraints early. Security, compliance, data access, budget, skills, politics, timelines — the things that kill projects in month two. Aligns stakeholders. Structure the process and the spec. Hands-on experience integrating Generative AI or Large Language Model (LLM) services into enterprise applications or business workflows. Hands-on experience with APIs, webhooks, middleware, and system integrations Experience with relational databases, SQL, and data modeling. Familiarity with AWS, Azure, GCP, or comparable cloud services. Experience with GitHub, code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD. The primary objective of the Data Analytics Engineer is to help drive business impact and better decision making by laying the data foundation for a world-class analytics function. This role will be critical to fostering trust in our data and confidence in our decisions. Our Data Analytics Engineers focus on creating a data environment that is conducive to analytics and business decision making. You will own and maintain the data transformation layer. This will require data governance (quality, accuracy, coverage, security), data modeling (structure, relationships, integrity), technical communication (data dictionaries, user training), quality control (code reviews, data validation), raw data analysis, and building AI data systems and pipelines. You will be the product owner for our data warehouse and will coordinate closely with our functional Business Analysts on one side, and Data Engineers on the other. This role sits within the Business Analytics Center of Excellence and will ensure trustworthy data is available for all downstream data users. Positive relationships with both Data Engineers and Business Analysts will be key, but you must also think independently and bring your own point of view. We’ve transformed our codebase to be instrumented for agentic development and continue to build our internal AI tooling, and you will be part of this process. Fluency with using LLMs and agentic coding tools is a requirement of this role. The flip side of that is the part machines cannot do: understanding our business and metrics deeply, and making decisions on what matters and what doesn’t in terms of pushing the company’s business objectives forward. This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. Design, write, review and ship SQL models across our repositories that transform raw data into usable data products for all organizational stakeholders. Own and maintain the transformation layer. Proactively work with the Data Engineers to ensure new data sources are added and available, and then modeled and published in our data warehouse. Proactively monitor the data warehouse and extract insights to identify opportunities to improve data operations, data accuracy and quality, coverage, integrity, structure, and general usability. Turn ambiguous business asks into modeled data. Run requirements gathering with stakeholders. Establish the grain, surface the edge cases, write down the business rules, and push back when the request would produce a misleading number. Implement measures and processes to improve data quality, accuracy, coverage, lineage, access and retention across dozens of source production databases. Own the data dictionary. Write table and column documentation that traces each field to its true origin. This documentation is consumed by AI agents as well as humans, and is an integral part of the semantic layer. Diagnose and resolve data incidents. Review your teammates’ code and provide feedback to maintain the hygiene of the data warehouse production environment. Work closely with Business Analysts, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and business process owners to empower data-driven decision making. Enable end users to better use data, understand complexities, nuances, and limitations. Help make the team faster. Improve the agent playbooks, documentation, and tooling the team uses to work with the warehouse. In the first week, expect to: Onboard and integrate into Toptal, and begin learning our history, culture and vision. Get your environment running end to end: GCP access, BigQuery, the Dataform repositories, and our agentic development tooling. Shadow the teams whose data you will own to learn the core of Toptal’s operations and capabilities, including Growth, Talent Operations, Enterprise, and SMB. In the first month, expect to: Understand the data generated through company operations and activities and where/how that data is stored. Understand our ETL processes, timing, tools, monitoring, roadmap, and pain points. Understand our source systems, and where they fit into our business processes. Start receiving and researching inbound data questions from Business Analysts. Build your first Dataform pull request independently and start reviewing your teammates’ PRs. In the first three months, expect to: Develop a mastery of our core data elements and entities. Begin standardizing definitions and creating SQL logic to push definitions into the data layer. Be a first responder for data incidents, diagnosing root cause with evidence and a methodical approach. Begin documenting data flows, definitions, calculation methodologies, and data elements to continuously build and improve the semantic layer. In the first six months, expect to: Contribute architectural ideas that impact our data environment and pipelines. Exercise discretion and independent judgment. Be an integral part of the analytics team that ensures a world-class data warehouse service to our stakeholders. In the first year, expect to: Play a critical part in setting up the Business Analytics Center of Excellence for success. Be the person the organization trusts about what a number means and whether it can be believed. Have made the warehouse meaningfully more usable by both analysts and AI agents. Qualifications and Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree is required, preferably in Engineering or a related technical field. 4+ years of experience in an Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, or Data Analyst role where you personally shipped production data models. Expert-level SQL skills and a working knowledge of Python. Fluency with LLMs and agentic coding tools. Good understanding of a modern transformation framework (dbt, Dataform, SQLMesh or similar). You understand dependency graphs, refs, incremental strategies, tests and environment promotion as concepts, not just as commands. Git fluency. Branching, pull requests, code review, conflict resolution and generally working with a critical production environment. Strong familiarity with orchestration tools such as Airflow, Cloud Composer, Dagster or Prefect. You can read a DAG, understand its schedule and dependencies, and find out why a task failed. Process discipline. Jira, ticket hygiene, and code review etiquette. It’s mandatory you understand how to avoid shipping unverified LLM-generated code. Experience in doing exploratory/raw data analysis, data modeling, and data governance (quality, accuracy, coverage, security, etc.). Experience translating business logic and objectives into SQL code and linking data and analytics to business strategy and operations to drive real impact. Familiarity with BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.). Detail oriented, methodical, and thorough. Team player who builds strong relationships and collaborates with others. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex issues in a simple and intuitive way. Ability to work collaboratively and independently; take ownership of quality, accuracy, and timeliness of deliverables. You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. Documents trade-offs (ADRs), sets success metrics, pushes back on scope that won’t deliver value.
