descricao: About Revel At Revel, we are revolutionizing the way the world's most critical hardware is controlled—across aerospace, automotive, energy, and manufacturing sectors. Our next-generation software stack combines an intuitive command/control interface, a specialized programming language tailored for hardware control, and a high-performance runtime environment. We empower engineers to build, test, and deploy critical systems rapidly, reliably, and safely. About The Role You'll be Revel's first security engineer. There's no existing program to inherit and no legacy decisions to work around. You'll set the foundation for how Revel protects its platform, its infrastructure, and its customers. Revel's software runs test campaigns and controls hardware for teams building rockets, satellites, and energy systems. It deploys across cloud, on-prem, and air-gapped environments, often next to export-controlled programs and sensitive hardware. Our customers trust us with critical work, and you'll be the person who makes sure that trust is earned. This isn't a compliance-only role. You'll spend most of your time building, and you'll be as close to our product architecture as you are to our infrastructure. As Revel grows, you'll have the opportunity to build and lead the security team. What You'll Do Build the program from zero. Define Revel's security strategy, architecture, and roadmap, then roll up your sleeves and build it. You'll decide what matters most now and what can wait. Secure a platform that touches real hardware. Our software doesn't just move data. It commands physical systems. Threat-model the product end to end, from the control software and its interfaces to the hardware it runs against. Then turn that into concrete security requirements, design reviews, and testing that ship with every release. Bring security into product design. Work with product and engineering leads early in the design process, so security is part of the architecture rather than bolted on before a customer review. Own the stack end to end. From the Linux hosts and physical systems that sit alongside real hardware in labs and at customer sites, to cloud accounts, Kubernetes clusters, CI/CD pipelines, endpoints, and SaaS tools, you’ll harden all of it. Treat security configuration as code, and automate wherever you can. Make secure delivery the default. Build scanning, secrets management, dependency controls, and signed, auditable releases into our pipelines, including how we deliver software into restricted and disconnected networks, without slowing engineering down. Stand up detection and response. Build our logging, monitoring, and alerting from scratch, and lead incident response and vulnerability management when things go wrong. Turn compliance into engineering. Lead Revel's approach to ITAR, NIST 800-171, CUI handling, and CMMC. Build compliance evidence and reporting into our systems instead of maintaining spreadsheets. Be the security voice customers trust. Serve as Revel's primary security contact for defense and aerospace customers, from security questionnaires to architecture reviews. Make everyone better at security. Partner with software and embedded engineers on threat modeling and secure design, and help every Revel employee understand their part. Grow the function. As the company scales, help define when and who we hire next in security, and shape what the team becomes. What We're Looking For 7+ years of hands-on security engineering experience, with real depth in infrastructure security across cloud, on-prem, and physical systems Experience in product or application security, including threat modeling, secure design reviews, and securing software that interacts with hardware or embedded systems Production experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK, or similar) and securing CI/CD pipelines Experience securing containerized, cloud-native environments, including Docker and Kubernetes Working knowledge of NIST 800-171, CUI, and related frameworks. You know what the requirements say and how to implement them in modern infrastructure. Experience conducting security architecture reviews and implementing defensive controls across endpoints, SaaS apps, and infrastructure Proficiency in at least one general-purpose language (Python, Go, Rust, or similar). You build tools, not just configure them. Strong production Linux experience The judgment to prioritize ruthlessly and the ownership to see things through without a playbook Nice to Have Previous experience as a first or early security hire Experience leading or managing a security team Experience in defense, aerospace, data centers, or other regulated environments (ITAR, CMMC, RMF, NIST 800-53, DISA STIGs, FedRAMP) Experience with government cloud environments (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government) or delivering software into air-gapped networks Experience with embedded systems security, such as secure boot, firmware signing, key management, or securing hardware-in-the-loop environments Hands-on experience with SIEM and EDR tools (e.g., Splunk, Panther, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne) Experience briefing security architectures to technical government or defense customers Join us to redefine what’s possible in software for hardware. descricao: About FullStack FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence. We’re Most Proud Of Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas. Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies. Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users. Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor. Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average. The Position Forward Deployed Engineers sit inside the client’s problem, not next to it. You embed with an enterprise team, find the work that actually warrants AI, architect the system, build it, and stay long enough to make it survive contact with production. This is a three-way role: consultant, operator, engineer. You should be as comfortable pressure-testing a business case with a COO or VP of Engineering as you are diagnosing why retrieval quality collapsed after a data refresh. The people who succeed here can hold a discovery conversation on Monday and ship what they scoped on Thursday. On this track, your edge is data, retrieval, and model behavior: you make agents trustworthy by getting the data, context, and evaluation right. We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don’t hold up. How We Approach The Work FDEs are trusted to shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for architect-level judgment: Reframes the request. Treats “we need an agent for X” as a hypothesis, not a spec. Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints — before choosing technology. Chooses the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent — and defends why. Owns the architecture decision. Documents trade-offs (ADRs), sets success metrics, pushes back on scope that won’t deliver value. Consultative Discovery Clients rarely arrive with a fully formed problem, and the FDE’s first contribution is helping them see it clearly. You lead discovery with genuine curiosity, moving the conversation from stated requirements to underlying needs, and you build credibility through the depth of your understanding rather than the breadth of your pitch. Uncovers business drivers. What outcome matters, what it’s worth, why now, and what happens if nothing changes. Uncovers personal drivers. What each stakeholder is measured on, what they’re worried about, and what a win looks like for them individually. Surfaces constraints early. Security, compliance, data access, budget, skills, politics, timelines — the things that kill projects in month two. Aligns stakeholders. Spots conflicting goals between business, engineering, and risk, and brings them to a shared definition of success. Asks strategic questions. Follows the answer with “why,” “how do you know,” and “what happens today when…” — without interrogating. Clients leave the conversation understanding their own problem better. Earns authority through depth. Credibility comes from the quality of the questions and the insight in the playback, not from pitching technology. What You'll Do Discover. Run workshops and process discovery with business, data, and engineering stakeholders. Assess data readiness honestly. Separate genuine AI problems from workflow problems wearing an AI costume. Structure the process and the spec. For any business process being automated, map the current state, decision points, data inputs, and exceptions, then turn it into specifications that both people and AI systems can execute against reliably. Architect & design. Design agentic systems end to end with emphasis on context and retrieval architecture — data sourcing, chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, permissions-aware retrieval, knowledge graphs where warranted — plus orchestration, MCP/tool integration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. Build. Ship working systems — agents, retrieval services, evaluation tooling, and the data flows that feed them. Prototypes that prove value in weeks, not slideware. Engineer the delivery system. Own CI/CD for what you build, extended to AI: prompt and context versioning, eval suites that run in the pipeline and gate releases. Operate (Day 2). Own what happens after launch — eval harnesses, groundedness and retrieval metrics, observability and tracing, cost and latency management, drift, and the handoff that lets the client’s team run it without you. Consult. Present to and defend decisions in front of CTOs, VPs of Engineering, CDOs, and business leadership. Quantify impact in their terms. Support pre-sales scoping and proposal work when the deal calls for it. What We're Looking For 5+ years of professional software development experience with core proficiency in Python (or TypeScript/Node.js). Has shipped at least one agentic AI solution, LLM workflow, or RAG architecture to a production environment. Advanced English is required. Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required. Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI developer tools (such as Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or OpenAI Codex) in daily workflows. Track record of leading client-facing discovery calls to translate unstructured business requirements into technical architectures. Hands-on experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs, microservices, or event-driven architectures. Experience building agentic systems using orchestration frameworks or APIs such as LangGraph, LangChain, n8n, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or direct LLM APIs. Proven experience taking full end-to-end technical ownership of features from discovery to deployment. Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed. Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications. Forensic attention to detail. A positive mindset and a can-do attitude. Experience working on Agile / Scrum teams. Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems. Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon. Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them. Strong Plus Production AI operations (Day 2): eval harnesses, observability and tracing, cost and token economics, drift, debugging non-deterministic systems. Prompt- and eval-level regression testing running in CI and gating releases. Delivery in regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing). Pre-sales support: discovery calls, SOW and estimate shaping, technical proposal defense. Process mining, operations analysis, or transformation consulting background. Client enablement and training — building the client team’s capability, not just the system. Prior consulting or agency environment; comfort with ambiguity and multiple accounts. Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen. Operative Steuerung und Koordination unserer Baustellen sowie Sicherstellung einer termingerechten und qualitativ hochwertigen Umsetzung Führung und Weiterentwicklung Deines operativen Teams Verantwortung für die Einsatzplanung, Priorisierung und Nachverfolgung laufender Baustellen Verantwortung für Controlling, Reporting sowie die Analyse relevanter Kennzahlen und Ableitung geeigneter Maßnahmen Sicherstellung eines strukturierten Anlernprozesses neuer Mitarbeitender direkt auf der Baustelle (Training on the job) im Rahmen unserer Akademie für PV- und Wärmepumpenmontage Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsleitung sowie kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung operativer Prozesse und Sicherstellung einer qualitätsgerechten Dokumentation Dein Profil Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Operations, Bauleitung, Logistik oder einem vergleichbaren operativen Umfeld Erfahrung in der Führung von Teams sowie Freude daran, Mitarbeitende weiterzuentwickeln und Verantwortung zu übernehmen Hands-on-Mentalität, ausgeprägte Eigeninitiative und eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise Sicheres Auftreten, klare Kommunikation und Durchsetzungsvermögen im Austausch mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern Hohe Belastbarkeit sowie die Fähigkeit, auch in einem dynamischen Umfeld den Überblick zu behalten und Prioritäten zu setzen Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. titulo: Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer - DevOps & Technical Leadership
descricao: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years About Us We are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects. Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software. AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve. We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company. Job Description We are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them. You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently. Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important. This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend. Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations. Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review. Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria. Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations. Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures. Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting. Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks. Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies. Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners. Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification. Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes. Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies. Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback. Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead. Required Qualifications Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications. Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling. Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs. Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified. Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery. Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience. A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies. Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents. Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills. Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery. Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly. Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams. The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget. Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility. Especially Valuable Experience Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup. Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time. Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness. Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation. Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments. Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation. Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring. Growth, Responsibility And Compensation Joining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team. Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years. For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment. What We Offer A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective. Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives. The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team. Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery. Close collaboration with startup leadership. The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops. Remote Working Arrangement Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process. Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup. How To Apply We are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning. Please submit your CV and a short overview covering: A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions. An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results. Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities. A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes. Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables. Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account. Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

Strong experience designing and implementing Azure tenant platforms aligned with Microsoft CAF (Cloud Adoption Framework) . Expertise building and maintaining Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform. Experience implementing Azure landing zones for application and workload migrations. Hands-on experience with Terraform state management, imports, drift detection and reconciliation, refactoring live infrastructure (e.g., moved blocks), and secret management with Azure Key Vault, including rotation. Strong automation and scripting skills using PowerShell, Python, or Bash. Knowledge of Azure identity and security: Managed Identities, workload identity federation (OIDC), least-privilege RBAC, and PIM. Hands-on experience with Azure compute services such as AKS, Container Apps, App Service, and Function Apps, including Key Vault integration and Azure Container Registry. Experience implementing Azure Policy (custom definitions, deny/modify effects, tag inheritance). Experience enforcing governance and policy compliance through management group inheritance. Ability to monitor cloud environments for performance, security, and cost optimization. Strong collaboration, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to provide technical guidance and support across cross-functional teams. Strong spoken English (B2+) to discuss technical scenarios live with US-based stakeholders. Experience in financial services or regulated environments is a plus. Nice to have: Azure Data Factory/Databricks, Azure messaging (Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hubs), Azure API Management, Bicep, and AI-assisted engineering tools. You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Design and implement Azure tenant platforms aligned with Microsoft CAF standards. Build, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform. Implement Azure landing zones to support application and workload migrations. Manage and optimize CI/CD pipelines, source control, and project workflows using Azure DevOps to support both infrastructure and application delivery into Azure, including environment approvals, security gates, and container image promotion across environments. Review peers’ pull requests and handle infrastructure requests from application teams in a Kanban workflow. Automate resource provisioning, scaling, and infrastructure management processes. descricao: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with substantial growth potential during the first few years About Us We are a startup developing AI-powered solutions, business applications, integrations, and automations across different products and internal initiatives. Microsoft technologies are an important part of our work. We want to turn business requirements into useful AI assistants, reliable workflows, and connected systems that deliver measurable results. Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We are looking for someone who enjoys hands-on implementation, can coordinate external specialists, and wants to help build and lead a growing team. The Role We are seeking an experienced Microsoft AI Engineer with strong practical experience in Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate. You will take responsibility for projects from requirements discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement. Your work will span different business processes and products. Alongside technical delivery, your responsibilities may include project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced contributors. You should be comfortable discussing business priorities, organizing delivery, reviewing technical work, and helping colleagues improve. Ownership of Our Microsoft Environment You will independently manage and develop our company's Microsoft environment across Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform. This includes taking ownership of configuration, access management, operational reliability, governance, documentation, and cost control. We need someone who can identify issues, propose practical improvements, coordinate implementation, and verify that our systems continue to work reliably. You should be comfortable combining hands-on technical work with project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced specialists. Key Responsibilities Build and maintain AI assistants and agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry. Identify practical opportunities for Microsoft 365 Copilot and help teams use it effectively. Connect AI solutions to relevant business knowledge and systems while respecting permissions and data boundaries. Develop Power Automate workflows with reliable validation, exception handling, monitoring, and recovery. Integrate Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, external APIs, and other business systems. Implement custom connectors or supporting code where the project requires them. Evaluate AI output quality, grounding, failure behavior, latency, and operating costs. Establish appropriate human review and approval steps for consequential automated actions. Independently administer our Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform environments, including users, groups, roles, application registrations, permissions, and service connections. Configure and manage GitHub-connected Power Platform solutions, including repositories, authentication, source control, branching, reviews, and deployment workflows. Manage the solution lifecycle across development, testing, and production, including solution dependencies, environment variables, connection references, release verification, and recovery procedures. Maintain secure application identities, credentials, and access configurations with clear ownership and appropriate permissions. Monitor platform health, investigate failures, maintain operational documentation, and control licensing and cloud expenditure. Translate business requirements into clear tasks, delivery milestones, and verifiable acceptance criteria. Manage project scope, priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication. Coordinate outsourced developers, review their deliverables, and maintain clear ownership. Mentor colleagues through practical demonstrations, reviews, and knowledge transfer. Keep solutions maintainable and proportionate to the problem and startup budget. Required Qualifications Demonstrated experience delivering production solutions using Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate. Practical understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot and its use in business workflows. Experience building AI agents or assistants connected to business data, tools, and APIs. Experience evaluating AI-generated answers and actions, including handling unreliable or unsupported output. Strong knowledge of Power Automate cloud flows, connectors, expressions, approvals, and troubleshooting. Experience integrating SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, or comparable business platforms. Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, application permissions, authentication, and secure credential handling. Ability to write and review supporting code or scripts, for example in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or PowerShell. Proven experience independently administering a company's Microsoft environment, with responsibility for reliable operation and ongoing improvement. Hands-on experience configuring and managing Power Platform solutions connected to GitHub. Practical experience with GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD workflows for Microsoft solutions. Strong understanding of environment separation, managed and unmanaged solutions, dependencies, connection references, and environment-specific configuration. Previous responsibility for technical project delivery, including planning and stakeholder communication. Proven experience leading developers, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating distributed contributors. The ability to take ownership of technical problems, communicate their business impact, and carry improvements through to a verified result. Ability to work independently, explain technical decisions clearly, and prioritize within a limited startup budget. Especially Valuable Experience Delivering Microsoft AI or automation projects in a startup or consulting environment. Building retrieval workflows with documented knowledge sources and permission-aware access. Working with Power Apps, Azure services, SQL databases, or Azure DevOps. Experience with Azure API Management and its AI gateway capabilities, including authentication, model routing, usage limits, monitoring, and cost control. Experience with related components such as Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Azure AI Search. Experience building and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards, including Power Query, data modelling, DAX, scheduled refresh, workspace permissions, and row-level security. Experience connecting reporting and analytics to operational workflows and business decisions. Replacing fragile workflows with solutions that are easier to operate and maintain. Coordinating outsourced implementation while retaining internal technical ownership. Using AI development tools effectively and recognizing when generated solutions introduce unnecessary complexity. Growth, Leadership And Compensation This is an opportunity to join early and help shape our Microsoft AI and automation practice. Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed responsibilities. As the business develops and your contribution grows, we aim to offer substantial salary progression during the first few years. Strong contributors may progress into roles such as Microsoft AI Team Lead, AI & Automation Lead, Solutions Architect, or Head of AI & Automation. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. We will discuss expectations and progression milestones openly during recruitment. What We Offer A fully remote role with a long-term perspective. Ownership across AI implementation, automation, and project delivery. The opportunity to mentor colleagues and build a distributed team. Close collaboration with startup leadership. Varied projects with practical business impact. Significant potential for career and compensation growth as the company develops. Remote Working Arrangement Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots. This working arrangement will be explained during recruitment. Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup. How To Apply We are looking to fill this core role promptly and will review applications as they arrive. Applying early provides an opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our AI and automation work. Please submit your CV and a short overview of: A Copilot Studio or Microsoft Foundry solution you delivered, your contribution, and how you verified its results. A Power Automate workflow you implemented and how you handled failures. A Microsoft environment you administered and GitHub-connected solutions you managed. A project you managed or a team you led or mentored. Your experience coordinating outsourced contributors. Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account. Public links and anonymized examples are welcome. Please do not share confidential information or credentials.

descricao: About Hightouch Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible. Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart. At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you. About The Role This role is for someone who wants to own the technical win. As an Enterprise Solutions Engineer at Hightouch, you will partner with your Account Executives to drive the full technical sales motion from deep discovery and architectural solutioning to tailored product demonstrations and rigorous technical validation. You will own relationships with technical champions, co-develop account strategy, and guide customers to our solutions by navigating complex, multi-stakeholder buying committees and running competitive enterprise sales cycles. We leverage a disciplined value-selling motion, and are looking for deep experience in enterprise sales cycles where you have had to earn the technical win, not assume it. Hightouch sits at the intersection of two powerful technological shifts: the rise of agentic AI and the maturation of the cloud data warehouse. We are solving real, complex problems at the intersection of marketing and data. As a senior SE, you will become a product expert, a trusted advisor to enterprise buyers, and a meaningful contributor to a team that is still early in building something significant. What You’ll Do Lead technical discovery to deeply understand a customer’s data architecture, marketing workflows, and business objectives; and translate that into differentiated requirements and a compelling solution design. Design and deliver tailored product demonstrations and architectural solutions spanning Hightouch’s Customer Studio, Identity Resolution, Match Booster, and Agentic Marketing Platform. Run proof-of-concept engagements end-to-end: scoping, designing, executing, and validating with the discipline and rigor required to close complex enterprise deals. Build deep technical relationships with data engineers, architects, and marketing technologists becoming their trusted advisor. Navigate complex buying committees, engaging confidently with technical teams, marketing leaders, and C-suite executives. Serve as a technical advisor to enterprise customers adopting cutting-edge AI workflows, data activation, and decisioning capabilities using agents. Partner directly with Product and Engineering to shape the go-to-market strategy for Hightouch’s emerging AI and agentic products. Leverage modern AI tooling to improve speed, creativity, and customer impact across the Solutions Engineering workflow. What Success Looks Like Quickly build technical expertise, moving from foundational product, use case, and demo fluency in the first three months to independently closing deals and solving complex, multi-product problems within six months. You will begin contributing beyond your own deals and raising the collective bar for the team within a year. Required What We’re Looking For 5+ years of progressive enterprise pre-sales or solutions engineering experience, including complex solution architecture across multi-stakeholder buying cycles. Demonstrated ability to lead technical discovery, architectural whiteboarding, and solution design with both technical and business audiences, including C-suite stakeholders. Deep familiarity with modern data ecosystems: cloud data warehouses, data modeling, data engineering, integrations, and APIs - and the ability to navigate a customer’s data architecture confidently without needing to be a hands-on practitioner. Proven ability to build technical champions and influence complex buying committees across engineering, marketing, and executive levels. Experience in competitive enterprise sales motions. Familiarity with MEDDPICC, Command the Message, or equivalent value-selling frameworks is a strong plus. Intellectual curiosity, high ambition, and humility. You want to keep getting better, and you are honest about what you do not yet know. A team-first orientation where you elevate the people around you, operate within shared frameworks and processes, and measure yourself by more than your own quota. Bonus Hands-on experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Marketing Automation, Data Warehouses, or similar technologies at the integration, architecture, or use case level. Background collaborating with data engineering, science, or analytics teams, either as a customer or in a prior role. Experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS company scaling through a significant inflection point. Travel required for customer and team engagements. Why Hightouch We are building something that has the potential to redefine how companies use data to drive marketing outcomes. We’ve doubled in size each of the last three years, earned recognition as a Gartner Magic Quadrant leader in CDP, and have been acknowledged in the top 10 of the Forbes Best Startups list the last two years. Beyond The Market Position And The Customer List, What Makes This Team Worth Joining Is The Culture And Values. Two Core Values Exemplify How This Team Operates Forever Hungry — We are ambitious and we celebrate wins, but we are never fully satisfied. We are always looking for ways to push further, move faster, and do more for our customers and each other. Raising the Bar — We have high expectations for performance and believe in having exceptional talent in every position. We look deeper than credentials, prioritize trajectory over pedigree, and invest in people who make everyone around them better. As a senior SE at Hightouch, you will have the autonomy to shape your territory, the product complexity to do technically meaningful work, and a team around you that makes it worth showing up for.

descricao: About You You are a Senior Data Engineer passionate about building scalable, production-grade data pipelines and transforming complex data from multiple sources into reliable, business-ready datasets. You thrive when working with Azure Databricks, Python, and Spark to solve data integration challenges and support enterprise data ecosystems. You enjoy connecting data across business platforms, optimizing data transformations, and ensuring accuracy and consistency throughout the data lifecycle. You take ownership of your work, ask the right questions early, and proactively communicate risks and blockers. You value clear documentation, technical discipline, and delivering high-quality solutions that support business needs. You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies: 5+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering, designing, building, and maintaining production-grade data pipelines. Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks. Advanced Python skills for data processing, transformation, and pipeline development. Solid experience with Apache Spark, including PySpark and/or Spark SQL, for processing data at scale. Advanced SQL proficiency, including complex transformations, data validation, and query performance optimization. Strong knowledge of data warehousing and dimensional modeling, including facts, dimensions, and data marts. Experience integrating data from multiple sources, including REST APIs, relational databases, cloud storage, and SFTP. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure data services for data ingestion, storage, processing, and integration. Experience implementing data quality checks and validating consistency between source systems and target data models. Ability to troubleshoot pipeline failures, investigate data discrepancies, and implement reliable solutions. Strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills. Ability to work autonomously, take ownership, and follow established engineering practices and documentation standards. Strong English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with a US-based team. Nice to have: Experience migrating SQL-based data workloads to Azure Databricks. You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain reliable, production-grade data pipelines using Azure Databricks and Python. Develop scalable data transformations using PySpark or Spark SQL to integrate data from multiple business systems. Ingest and process data from APIs, relational databases, cloud storage, and SFTP sources. Integrate data from ticketing, CRM, marketing, retail, and other enterprise platforms into a centralized Data Hub. Develop and maintain data warehouse structures, dimensional models, and data marts aligned with business requirements. Write, optimize, and maintain SQL transformations to ensure data accuracy and processing efficiency. Implement data quality validations and consistency checks between source systems and target models. Build and maintain outbound data feeds for third-party systems according to defined specifications. Investigate data discrepancies, troubleshoot pipeline issues, and implement appropriate corrective actions. Document data pipelines, transformation logic, dependencies, and technical processes. Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to clarify requirements, identify risks early, and deliver reliable data solutions. Communicate progress, blockers, and potential delays proactively, proposing clear next steps to keep deliverables on track. Qualifications Strong proficiency in Azure Databricks, Python, and Apache Spark. Advanced SQL skills and solid knowledge of data warehousing and dimensional modeling. Proven experience developing and maintaining production data pipelines. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure data services and integrating data from multiple enterprise systems. Strong understanding of data quality, validation, and consistency across source and target systems. Strong ownership, autonomy, documentation, and communication skills. Ability to communicate effectively in English and collaborate with a US-based enterprise team. Additional Information About Us We Are Engineered Different. At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable. Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

descricao: Finance & Operations Lead AI & Automation · Odoo · Direct Partnership with the CEO IMMEKA Operations Leadership Track Location: Venezuela — Remote Commitment: Full-time Reports to: CEO Starting compensation: US$1,000 per month, with a performance-based compensation review after 90 days and the possibility of an increase. ABOUT IMMEKA IMMEKA Medical is a U.S.-based medical device company transforming office hysteroscopy. Our mission: Office Hysteroscopy. Made Easy. We are a startup entering a significant growth stage. We are on track to approximately double revenue during our first major year of commercial scale, with the ambition to triple the business over the following 12 months. We are looking for an exceptional professional who wants to build the operating infrastructure behind that growth and develop into a Finance & Operations leader. THE OPPORTUNITY You will work directly with IMMEKA’s CEO, driving AI and automation, owning business systems, and progressively taking responsibility for the entire back office. You will initially be a hands-on individual contributor. Within approximately three to six months, you will help hire and lead an additional team member responsible for daily transactional execution. You will also serve as a thinking partner to the CEO: analyzing problems, challenging assumptions, developing recommendations, and helping turn strategic decisions into execution. You won’t simply execute processes. You’ll improve them. You’ll automate them. You’ll build them. YOUR MISSION Build an AI-first, technology-enabled operating organization that allows IMMEKA to scale. Our priorities for this role are: • AI and automation. • Odoo and business systems. • Finance and operations. • Execution leadership and partnership with the CEO. AI AND AUTOMATION AI is central to how this job should be done. We want someone who actively explores technology and applies it to real business problems. You will: • Identify repetitive work that can be automated, simplified or eliminated. • Implement practical solutions using AI, Odoo, Microsoft 365 and appropriate automation tools. • Improve speed, accuracy, controls and access to information. • Measure results and verify that automated workflows operate reliably. • Build processes that support growth without adding unnecessary headcount. You should constantly ask: Why is this manual? Can we eliminate this step? Can Odoo handle it? Where would AI improve the outcome? How will we detect and resolve exceptions? ODOO AND BUSINESS SYSTEMS Become IMMEKA’s internal business owner for Odoo, working with Miguel, our external Odoo consultant. You will: • Understand workflows across sales orders, purchasing, inventory, receiving, landed costs, deliveries, invoicing, collections and accounting. • Identify gaps and define business requirements. • Prioritize improvements and drive implementation with our consultant. • Build dashboards, reports, alerts and controls. • Document procedures and train users. • Confirm that system changes deliver the intended business results. Prior Odoo experience is valuable, but not required. The ability to learn quickly and take ownership is essential. FINANCE AND OPERATIONS Progressively own the entire back office and ensure that transactions, information and follow-through connect correctly. Order-to-Cash: Customer Order → Inventory → Delivery → Invoice → Collection → Cash Supply and Inventory: Forecast → Purchase → International Logistics → Receiving → Landed Cost → Inventory → Replenishment Your responsibilities include: • Order management and delivery coordination. • Inventory planning, purchasing and replenishment. • International logistics, receiving and landed costs. • Inventory accuracy and reconciliation. • Invoicing oversight, accounts receivable and collections. • Cash visibility and accounting coordination. • Financial reporting, KPIs and executive dashboards. • Vendor management and administrative operations. • SOPs, internal controls and continuous process improvement. You must understand AR, AP, cash, COGS, gross margin, inventory accounting, bank reconciliation and basic financial statements well enough to identify errors and manage the operation. Our accounting and back-office firm will initially continue performing transactional work. You will own whether the processes function correctly and whether exceptions are resolved. Sol will continue physical deliveries; you will own operational coordination and visibility. BUILD AND LEAD THE BACK OFFICE Within approximately three to six months, help recruit and onboard a second team member dedicated to transactional execution. You will lead the transfer of routine activities into IMMEKA, including order confirmation, invoicing, receiving inventory, landed costs and related back-office work. Both roles will have support from our Odoo consultant. External accounting support can then focus on the specialist services the company continues to need. This requires hands-on learning and execution before you can delegate effectively. CEO OFFICE AND THINKING PARTNER Work directly with the CEO as an analytical and operational partner. You will: • Analyze company performance. • Build financial and operating models. • Evaluate investments and business opportunities. • Research strategic questions. • Identify risks and challenge assumptions respectfully. • Prepare recommendations and information for decisions. • Translate agreed priorities into execution. We value someone who says: “I found a problem. Here’s why it matters. Here are the options. This is what I recommend, and here’s how we can execute it.” QUALIFICATIONS Approximately two to five years of relevant professional experience is a strong fit. Exceptional recent graduates may also be considered. Relevant backgrounds include: • Finance, accounting, public accounting or Big Four. • Management or business consulting. • Industrial engineering. • Business administration or economics. • Operations or supply chain. • Financial analysis or business analytics. We value: • Strong analytical ability and financial literacy. • Excellent organization and attention to detail. • Practical enthusiasm for AI and automation. • Resourcefulness and independent problem-solving. • Integrity, accountability and disciplined follow-through. • Humility, coachability and curiosity. • Comfort with ambiguity and increasing responsibility. PROFESSIONAL ENGLISH IS REQUIRED You must be professionally fluent in English and Spanish. You must be able to conduct business meetings in English, write clear professional emails, understand financial and operational discussions, and communicate confidently with U.S. employees, consultants, vendors, customers and partners. STARTUP EXPECTATIONS This is a demanding full-time opportunity for someone who wants to help build a company. We expect ownership, responsiveness and flexibility, including additional effort during critical business periods. Working availability must align with our U.S.-based team. You will encounter problems without established processes. You must be comfortable creating solutions, following through and taking responsibility for results. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE First 30 days: Learn workflows with the CEO, COO, the accounting firm and our Odoo consultant. Document processes, establish visibility into exceptions and progressively assume operational ownership. Days 30–60: Implement prioritized Odoo improvements, introduce practical AI and automation, strengthen controls and reporting, and reduce the CEO’s involvement in routine coordination. Months 3–6: Help hire and onboard the transactional back-office specialist, transfer routine work internally and lead execution. The goal is that, within six months, the CEO no longer needs to personally monitor routine purchasing, inventory, invoicing, reconciliations, operating procedures or normal Odoo implementations. COMPENSATION AND CAREER GROWTH Starting compensation: US$1,000 per month. After 90 days, we will review performance, ownership, execution and demonstrated contributions. Compensation may increase based on that review; an increase is not automatic. You will gain direct CEO exposure and practical experience across finance, operations, technology and strategy. As IMMEKA grows, this role can develop into Finance & Operations Manager, Director or Head of Finance & Operations, and potentially senior operations leadership. Advancement depends on the value you create and the needs of the company. HOW TO APPLY Submit your résumé in English and tell us: • What you have built, improved or automated. • How you use AI today. • Why you want to help build IMMEKA. • Why you are ready to take ownership of this responsibility. READY TO EARN IT.

descricao: Resumen De La Posición El propósito de la posición es realizar actividades de gestión contable y financiera de forma eficiente, precisa y oportuna de la operación y proyectos de la organización, incluyendo el procesamiento y registro contable de transacciones, control presupuestario, análisis, seguimiento y reportes de información financiera y cumplimiento de obligaciones, alineados las políticas y procedimientos establecidos. Funciones Esenciales Participar en el proceso de planeación estratégica de HIAS en Venezuela, aportando desde la perspectiva contable y financiera. Promover y apoyar la implementación y seguimiento de las políticas y procedimientos del área de Finanzas y Operaciones a nivel nacional y en las sub-oficinas. Brindar asistencia técnica, orientación y acompañamiento a las sub-oficinas y departamentos de la organización en procesos administrativos, financieros y contables. Revisar y verificar que la información de las transacciones y sus expedientes de pago (facturas y soportes) es correcta y cumple los procedimientos y lineamientos de la organización, así como la normativa legal y fiscal vigente. Realizar el registro oportuno de las transacciones financieras en el sistema contable de la organización, asegurando la adecuada codificación contable y presupuestaria de acuerdo con los requerimientos organizacionales y de los donantes. Emitir comprobantes de retención de impuestos y gestionar su correspondiente registro y control. Preparar operaciones bancarias relacionadas con los proyectos, luego de verificar el cumplimiento de los lineamientos y de las aprobaciones necesarias/segregación, incluyendo solicitudes de transferencias, seguimiento de pagos, consultas de movimientos y obtención de estados de cuenta. Elaborar las conciliaciones bancarias de manera mensual. Realizar el registro oportuno de ingresos de proyectos y del cálculo de los conceptos relacionados aplicables. Apoyar la preparación y seguimiento del flujo de caja de la organización, identificando necesidades de liquidez y requerimiento de fondos para el pago de operaciones/necesidades. Realizar la preparación de declaraciones tributarias y otras obligaciones fiscales ante los organismos competentes. Realizar actividades de los procesos de cierre contable mensual y anual, de acuerdo con los cronogramas establecidos. Apoyar la atención de auditorías internas, externas y revisiones de donantes, proporcionando la documentación de soporte e información financiera requerida de manera oportuna. Revisar y analizar periódicamente las transacciones registradas en los libros contables (General Ledger) de los proyectos para confirmar el adecuado registro financiero, identificar posibles errores, informar novedades y gestión de reclasificaciones necesarias, apoyando el adecuado uso de los presupuestos. Apoyar la preparación de presupuestos y el análisis de ejecución presupuestaria (Budget vs. Actuals/Presupuestos vs. Gastos), identificando desviaciones, riesgos de sobre o subejecución y oportunidades de optimización de recursos, informando oportunamente a las áreas responsables. Apoyar la preparación de reportes financieros intermedios y finales de proyectos, apuntando a su precisión e integridad en los plazos establecidos. Articular su trabajo con los otros departamentos de la organización (programas/sub-oficinas, recursos humanos, seguridad, etc.) según sea requerido para el cumplimiento de sus tareas. Mantener actualizados y archivados los documentos relacionados con sus actividades. Preparar los informes que sean requeridos Participar en las reuniones de equipo Llevar a cabo los procesos y trámites administrativos necesarios para la realización de sus actividades Adherirse al código de conducta, las políticas de la organización y a sus estándares de salvaguarda y rendición de cuentas. Cualquier otra función inherente a las responsabilidades y objetivos del cargo. Cualificaciones y Requerimientos Licenciatura en Contabilidad. Tres (3) años de experiencia en un puesto relacionado con Contabilidad o Finanzas, con responsabilidades contables y presupuestarias. Experiencia previa en organizaciones no gubernamentales (ONG) y/o sociales es considerado una ventaja. Conocimiento y experiencia en el manejo de Microsoft Dynamics Great Plains Accounting (deseable y relevante) Manejo de Microsoft Office, especialmente Excel a nivel intermedio-avanzado Capacidad para trabajar en equipo y bajo presión. PROCESO DE SELECCIÓN: HIAS está comprometida con un proceso de selección justo y respetuoso, y hace su mejor esfuerzo para responder a cada candidato/a. Priorizamos la comunicación y transparencia con todos/as los/as candidatos/as, incluso aquellos que no avanzar en el proceso. A continuación, se describe un resumen del proceso de selección: Paso 1: Presentar/enviar su aplicación Paso 2: Conversación telefónica inicial con un/a reclutador/a Paso 3: Aplicación de Prueba Técnica o Psicolaboral Paso 4: Entrevista con el/la líder del proceso/Panel de empleados/as de HIAS (virtual o presencial) Step 5: Comprobación de referencias Step 6: Oferta Step 7: Empieza tu viaje profesional con HIAS Nota: Algunos de nuestros procesos de selección y contratación variar y no todos los/as candidatos/as avanzarán a cada paso. HIAS: HIAS es una comunidad de aprendizaje, comprometida con la diversidad y la inclusión. Hacemos nuestro trabajo con integridad, rendición de cuentas, transparencia y con compromiso, con los más altos estándares éticos. VISIÓN: HIAS representa un mundo en el que los refugiados encuentran acogida, seguridad y oportunidades. MISIÓN: Basándose en nuestros valores e historia, HIAS brinda servicios vitales a personas refugiadas y solicitantes del estatus de refugiado en todo el mundo, y aboga por sus derechos fundamentales para que puedan reconstruir sus vidas. VALORES: Acogimiento, Justicia, Empatía, Compañerismo, Coraje, Resiliencia DIVERSIDAD: HIAS está comprometida con un lugar de trabajo diverso e inclusivo. Como empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades, todas las personas calificadas que apliquen serán consideradas para el empleo sin distinción de origen étnico, credo religioso, edad, sexo, género, orientación sexual, discapacidades, condición médica, estado civil u orientación política. SALVAGUARDA: HIAS está comprometida con la protección de niños y niñas, de las personas adultas vulnerables y cualquier otra persona de cualquier daño causado directa o indirectamente por su contacto con HIAS. No toleraremos la explotación sexual, el abuso o cualquier forma de abuso o negligencia infantil por parte de nuestro personal o personal asociado. Se espera que todo/a candidato/a al que se le ofrezca un trabajo en HIAS, firme y se adhiera al Código de Conducta y a las Políticas de Salvaguarda de HIAS. Todas las ofertas de empleo estarán sujetas a referencias satisfactorias y controles de selección adecuados.

descricao: AZKAIT es una empresa mexicana que busca y conecta el mejor talento IT con empresas Latinoamericanas y de Estados Unidos. Estamos en la búsqueda de tu talento como Auxiliar Administrativo y Financiero Jr. (Remoto) Requisitos: Experience: Entre 1 y 3 años en funciones administrativas, facturación, cuentas por cobrar, cobranza o soporte contable. Experiencia trabajando de forma remota y con herramientas digitales. Deseable experiencia atendiendo clientes corporativos o empresas de servicios. Ubicación: Venezuela (100% remoto) Work Modality / Modalidad: Remoto Horario: Tiempo completo, con disponibilidad para colaborar en horario de México. Acompañamiento especializado: Despachos contables y fiscales externos en México, USA y Colombia. Objetivo del puesto Asegurar la ejecución oportuna, precisa y coordinada de los procesos administrativos, de facturación y financieros de AZKAIT en México, Estados Unidos y Colombia. El objetivo principal es centralizar y dar seguimiento operativo a las cuentas por cobrar, cobranza, emisión de facturas/invoices, gestión documental de proveedores y administración de portales de clientes en las tres regiones. descricao: Job Description Position Title: Oficial Nacional de Administración y Finanzas Duty Station City: Caracas Duty Station Country: Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela Grade: NO-A Contract Type: Special Short-Term Recruiting Type: National Officer Vacancy Type: Special Vacancy Notice Initial duration: until 30 april 2027 Introduction Fundada en 1951, la OIM es un Organismo Asociado de las Naciones Unidas y la principal agencia de la ONU en el ámbito de la migración. Trabajando en estrecha colaboración con socios gubernamentales, intergubernamentales y no gubernamentales, la OIM promueve una migración humana y ordenada en beneficio de todas las personas. La Organización salva vidas y protege a las personas en movimiento, impulsa soluciones para el desplazamiento y facilita vías para la migración regular, al tiempo que brinda servicios y asesoramiento a gobiernos y migrantes. La OIM está comprometida con el fomento de un entorno laboral respetuoso, inclusivo y de apoyo, donde todas las personas empleadas puedan desarrollarse profesionalmente y sentirse valoradas. Mediante la creación de este entorno, la OIM busca aprovechar mejor todo el potencial de la migración y fortalecer su apoyo a las personas en movimiento. La OIM invita a postularse a personas candidatas de diversos orígenes y ofrece ajustes razonables durante todo el proceso de contratación cuando sea necesario. Se considerarán candidaturas tanto internas como externas para esta vacante. Para los fines de esta convocatoria, se consideran candidatos internos los miembros del personal con contratos regulares, de plazo fijo o de corto plazo, ya sean clasificados o no clasificados, incluidos los Oficiales Profesionales Jóvenes (JPO), el personal en Licencia Especial Sin Goce de Sueldo (SLWOP), los Voluntarios de las Naciones Unidas con al menos doce (12) meses de servicio continuo en la OIM y el personal en comisión de servicios o préstamo liberado por la Organización, salvo que se especifique lo contrario en su contrato. Los miembros del personal que tengan un contrato regular, de plazo fijo o de corto plazo clasificado no conservarán su tipo de contrato si son nombrados para un puesto no clasificado. Organizational Context and Scope Responsibilities Bajo la supervisión general del Jefe de Misión y la supervisión directa del Oficial de Gestión de Recursos, el Oficial Nacional de Administración y Finanzas será responsable de ejecutar las funciones asignadas en la Unidad, que incluyen contabilidad, control presupuestal, control financiero y demás tareas administrativas inherentes al cargo, que se detallan a continuación: Registrar y controlar todas las operaciones financieras y contables en el sistema WAVE, tanto de la Oficina principal de la Organización como de las Sub-Oficinas en Venezuela. Elaborar, conciliar y reportar el cierre contable a la Oficina Regional. Controlar y monitorear los presupuestos por proyecto, informando al Jefe de Misión y a los Coordinadores de Proyecto. Controlar y monitorear todas las cuentas bancarias de la Organización para mantener la liquidez y solvencia para los compromisos financieros. Elaborar informes financieros para donantes, conforme a las regulaciones de la OIM. Proyectar los gastos de oficina y personal con el objetivo de llevar una correcta ejecución del presupuesto. Elaborar presupuestos para propuestas de proyectos. Trabajar en conjunto con los Coordinadores para la activación de proyectos en la plataforma de PRIMA. Llevar el control financiero de las cuentas de cheques, conciliación bancaria, control de pagos y elaboración de transferencias bancarias y otras formas de pago, observando las regulaciones necesarias para minimizar los riesgos de fraude. Monitorear el registro, bajas, modificaciones, cálculos de nómina, beneficios aplicables al personal y demás trámites internos. Liquidar y verificar gastos de viajes del personal y pagos inherentes a viáticos. Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con otras unidades funcionales internas de la Organización, así como con bancos, donantes, contrapartes gubernamentales y otras partes interesadas, según se requiera en el desempeño de la función administrativa y financiera. Realizar viajes a las Sub-Oficinas, según sea necesario, para el monitoreo de las actividades. Guiar a los Coordinadores a lo largo del ciclo del proyecto para contribuir al cumplimiento de las políticas y procedimientos de la IOM, así como de cualquier requisito interno y específico del donante. Supervisar y coordinar las funciones del staff de la Unidad de Administración y Finanzas. Coordinar trámites ante autoridades gubernamentales, pago de cuotas, visas, acreditaciones y pago de servicios. Monitorear que los acuerdos de colaboración con proveedores se encuentren debidamente aprobados por el área LEGAL. Atender a las necesidades de mantenimiento y servicios necesarios de la Oficina para el uso adecuado del staff. Mantener el sistema de información administrativa/financiera, para garantizar el suministro oportuno de información a las unidades pertinentes dentro de la OIM (HQ, PAC, MAC, Oficina Regional, etc.). En estrecha relación con el área de Tecnologías de la Información, identificar las necesidades de mejoras en cuestiones tecnológicas y garantizar que la adquisición de nuevos activos cuente con las regulaciones establecidas de la OIM. descricao: Overview Student Success Manager Astria Learning is an education-technology company dedicated to delivering high-quality virtual learning experiences through partnerships with colleges and universities across multiple countries. One of the biggest gaps in online learning is the absence of human contact — our Student Success Coordinators (SSCs) exist to close that gap, acting as the bridge between the student and the institution so that no student ever feels alone, unsupported, or left with an unanswered question. We are looking for an experienced student success manager to be the leader, coach, and architect of that support model, leading eCampus operations across a portfolio of partner institutions and directly managing student support supervisors and SSCs. This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role at the intersection of customer success, operations, and people management — ideal for someone with a strong customer service and customer support background who thrives on building service systems, coaching frontline teams, and driving measurable student outcomes: enrollment, engagement, retention, on-time tuition payment, and graduation. --- What you'll do Student support philosophy you'll champion Proactive, not reactive. SSCs reach out before problems become crises — a missing assignment triggers a message, an upcoming exam triggers a reminder, a missed class triggers a check-in call. No student left alone. Every student has a named point of contact and always knows where to turn. No question goes unanswered; no message goes without a timely response. Accountability partnership. When a student's grades slip or attendance drops, the SSC steps in as an encouraging accountability partner — calling, motivating, and building a plan to get back on track. Full-lifecycle support. From onboarding and academic readiness, through assignments, exams, and grades, to tuition payment reminders and graduation — the SSC walks the entire journey with the student. Financial continuity as student care. Timely, empathetic payment reminders and follow-up protect the student's ability to stay enrolled and complete their program. Collections done well is a retention activity, not just a finance activity. Empathy with standards. Warm, human, culturally aware communication — backed by clear service-level standards for response time, follow-up, and resolution. Student experience and customer service leadership Own the end-to-end student support experience across partner institutions, ensuring every student receives timely, proactive, high-quality service throughout their learning journey. Define, document, and coach customer service standards for the SSC team: response-time SLAs, communication quality, escalation handling, and first-contact resolution. Design and run structured touchpoint playbooks — assignment reminders, exam notifications, attendance follow-ups, grade-improvement calls, payment reminders, and graduation support. Monitor service quality through metrics such as response time, resolution rate, contact coverage, and student satisfaction (CSAT/NPS), and intervene when standards slip. Team leadership, coaching and development Directly manage, coach, and mentor Student Support Supervisors and Student Success Coordinators (SSCs), setting clear KPIs and fostering a culture of accountability, empathy, professional growth, and high performance. Run regular coaching sessions, call and message quality reviews, and service-skills training rooted in customer service and customer support best practices. Build capability in proactive outreach, difficult conversations (academic performance, missed payments), and de-escalation. Retention and student outcomes Own key metrics across enrollment, engagement, retention, course completion, and graduation rates. Design early-warning systems that flag at-risk students (missed assignments, absences, falling grades, overdue payments) and proactive intervention plans to bring them back on track. Tuition collections and payment continuity Own the tuition collection process at the student-support level: ensure SSCs execute timely, empathetic payment reminders and structured follow-up so that missed and late payments are minimized. Track collection rates, aging, and payment-risk indicators; escalate and coordinate with Finance on persistent delinquency. Continuously improve the payment-reminder workflow to protect both revenue and student continuity. Institutional oversight and operations Oversee day-to-day eCampus operations across multiple partner universities, ensuring quality, consistency, and compliance in digital academic service delivery. Develop, document, and continuously improve SOPs for the SSC and eCampus teams, covering student onboarding, academic readiness, digital course delivery, and support workflows. KPI monitoring and reporting Build and maintain performance dashboards spanning student success, service quality, retention, and collections; design proactive intervention plans when teams trend below targets. Produce clear, data-driven operational reports covering progress, risks, and recommendations for senior leadership and institutional stakeholders. Partner relations Cultivate strong, trust-based relationships with university partners; resolve operational issues promptly and coordinate institutional requests. Strategic alignment and budget Partner with Astria leadership to translate company-wide priorities into actionable operational plans supporting long-term growth. Support operational budget planning and management, identifying cost-efficiency opportunities. Cross-functional collaboration Coordinate closely with Academics, Admissions, Finance, and IT to ensure a seamless, end-to-end student experience. What we are looking for Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Education, Project Management, or a related field. 4–6 years of experience in program, academic, operational, or customer success management. 3+ years of hands-on experience in customer service, customer support, or customer success roles — ideally including frontline experience and progression into team leadership. Experience managing distributed, remote, or cross-institutional teams. Experience with service quality metrics and frameworks: SLAs, CSAT, NPS, first response time, resolution rate. Experience owning or supporting collections, billing follow-up, payment reminders, or accounts-receivable-adjacent processes in a customer-facing context. Familiarity with LMS platforms (e.g., Moodle, Canvas), CRM systems, ticketing/helpdesk tools (e.g., Zendesk, Freshdesk, HubSpot Service), and student data tools. Experience building or scaling SOPs and service playbooks in a high-growth, multi-institution or multi-country context. Experience working across African higher-education markets or other emerging markets. descricao: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future. CONTEXTO Nuestra organización responde a las peores emergencias humanitarias del mundo y ayuda a las personas afectadas por crisis humanitarias, incluida la crisis climática, a sobrevivir, recuperarse y reconstruir sus vidas. Fundada en 1933 a pedido de Albert Einstein, la organización trabaja en más de 50 países para generar un impacto duradero al brindar atención médica, ayudar a los niños a aprender y empoderar a las personas y comunidades para que sean autosuficientes, siempre buscando abordar las desigualdades que enfrentan las mujeres y las niñas. La crisis humanitaria en Venezuela continúa intensificándose. Los venezolanos enfrentan una hiperinflación, que los pone fuera del alcance de los bienes y servicios básicos, incluida la atención médica y la alimentación. La escasez de suministros médicos hace que sea difícil diagnosticar y tratar las enfermedades transmisibles y las necesidades de salud sexual y reproductiva, entre otros servicios. La falta de alimentos ha provocado hambre y desnutrición. Entre 2015 y 2018, más de tres millones de venezolanos se fueron a buscar bienes y servicios principalmente en países vecinos. Nuestra Organización brinda servicios de respuesta en emergencia en los estados Zulia, Lara, Falcón, Táchira y Apure, trabajando en colaboración con organizaciones de la sociedad civil venezolana, proporcionamos servicios esenciales a personas vulnerables, incluyendo Atención Primaria de Salud (APS), Salud Sexual y Reproductiva (SSR), Nutrición, prevención y respuesta a la Violencia de Género (VBG), prevención y respuesta en protección infantil, Educación en Emergencias, Seguridad Alimentaria y Medios de Vida. Este enfoque estratégico nos permite brindar atención vital a las personas necesitadas en Venezuela, alineándonos con el compromiso de fortalecer la localización y empoderar a los actores nacionales. PROPÓSITO DEL CARGO Brindar soporte técnico oportuno y eficiente a los usuarios de la organización, contribuyendo al adecuado funcionamiento de los equipos informáticos, sistemas, redes y servicios tecnológicos. El Asistente de TI apoyará la implementación, mantenimiento y seguimiento de la infraestructura tecnológica, garantizando la continuidad de las operaciones y el cumplimiento de los estándares y procedimientos institucionales. Responsabilidades Principales Soporte Técnico y Atención a Usuarios Proporcionar soporte técnico de primera línea a usuarios de todas las áreas de la organización. Atender y resolver incidencias relacionadas con hardware, software, correo electrónico, impresoras, dispositivos móviles y conectividad. Registrar, monitorear y dar seguimiento a los tickets de soporte asegurando una respuesta oportuna. Brindar asistencia presencial y remota a usuarios de oficinas principales y de terreno. Apoyar en la configuración y entrega de equipos informáticos a nuevos colaboradores. Escalar oportunamente incidentes complejos al IT Officer o al equipo regional cuando sea requerido. Mantener una excelente atención al cliente interno, promoviendo una cultura de servicio y colaboración.
